speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Agreed. We need to gather intel without being spotted. Let's find a way to sneak past.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Exactly what I was thinking. See those Echoes over there?
Do you have a plan?
Why do I feel you're about to do something stupid…

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Ha, as the saying goes, "At sea, abide by the waves; on land, respect the earth."

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: With these disguises, we're perfectly camouflaged.

anh_en: Let's mingle with the crowd and see if we can uncover any useful information.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Brant, look over there! There's another Lottie Lost.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: No, no, no, no, no, no, we're not the same. That's a sad Lottie Lost. I'm the happy one.

anh_en: Throw in another six-pack!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Don't worry, gentle Lottie Lost. We'll do our best to help you and your friends dance freely in the moonlight again.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Oh, come on. I'm accurately translating everything she's saying.

speaker: NPC #100016
anh_en: Lost…

speaker: NPC #100018
anh_en: Anyway, wh-what did the captain say?

speaker: NPC #100019

speaker: NPC #100019

(Grip the hilt tight.)

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Lo-lottie… Lost…

speaker: NPC #100018
anh_en: Wh-what's that strange noise…

speaker: NPC #100019
anh_en: Ah, never mind. Just a Lottie Lost and a Cuddle Wuddle. You're still shaking in your boots over the Flaming Returned, huh? Ha, there's no need for that!

speaker: NPC #100018
anh_en: Th-that was an accident! If I run into th-that Returned again, I-I'll make him pay. B-besides, you're the one who's shaking li-like a leaf!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Gentlemen, the moment we've been waiting for is finally upon us!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Aldric really hasn't changed a bit.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Get ready. He's about to launch into one of his Aldric speeches.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Gentlemen! Do you still remember the day you boarded the Pilgrim's Sail?

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: As for me, I'll drag those arrogant Ragunna nobles aboard like the mangy curs they are! They'll call me captain and beg to kiss my boots!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Even that noble Laureate will be fetching my tea!

speaker: NPC #100013
anh_en: CAPTAIN! CAPTAIN! CAPTAIN!

I'd like to see him try.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: A dream or not, it's wrong to treat people like that.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: What's gotten into him?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: No wonder we ran into trouble a few days back.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: All our blood, sweat, and tears have finally led us to this coin, our map to untold treasures!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: From that day forward, we were forgotten and spat upon. But that ends now!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Coin, oh coin, reveal to us the location of the treasure! Grant us the Amber Key to fulfill our desires!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Coin! Oh, coin!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Damn it all, why isn't anything happening?!

speaker: NPC #100019
anh_en: Captain, could the nearby Echoes be screwing with the coin's magic?

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Good point… Gentlemen, if you want your dreams to come true, capture every Echo in sight—leave none behind!

speaker: NPC #100013
anh_en: Aye, aye, Captain!

speaker: NPC #100016
anh_en: Lottie… Lost!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Behold! Gentlemen! Held firmly in my hands—
Get ready for a fight.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Enough of your bluster, Aldric! Can't you see your audience is about to doze off?

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Who's there?

anh_en: Lo-Lottie Lost speaks!

Captain Cuddle Wuddle.

anh_en: Remember those dazzling names, for you are about to witness our might in this showdown!

speaker: NPC #100018
anh_en: Cu-cuddle Wuddle also sp…

anh_en: Drake's Coin!

speaker: NPC #100023

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: The very coin that once guided Captain Drake to unimaginable riches!

speaker: NPC #100023

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: With it, we shall claim Drake's riches and take whatever our hearts desire!

speaker: NPC #100013
anh_en: HOORAY!!!

speaker: NPC #100018
anh_en: Ca-captain, wh-why are you just standing there?

speaker: NPC #100018
anh_en: Fl-flame!!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: All yours, Captain!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: KILL THEM!

speaker: NPC #100013
anh_en: Over there!

speaker: NPC #1462

anh_en: Miss, as promised, you and your friends can now dance in the moonlight to your heart's content. Go on, enjoy!

anh_en: If you want the sea's rewards, you have to give something in return. Just like how being a captain doesn't just come with rights, but duties too.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Every reward has its price, and tricking his men into paying it for his own gain is absolutely unforgivable.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Anyway, take a look at this.

Are you after Drake's treasures, too?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Haha, well, who could resist the siren call of Drake's fabled riches? It's tempting, no doubt.
I would've liked to catch him.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: But truth be told, it's not the treasures themselves that draw me in. It's the stories—the legend of Drake himself.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: What did he face? What mysteries did he leave behind? There's no grander performance than that, Captain.

speaker: NPC #1462

anh_en: Ha, that's exactly what I was thinking.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Pirates? No big deal. We'll deal with them like we always do.

At least we saved those innocent Echoes.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Off we go! I'll lead the way.

anh_en: I've got a feeling we'll cross paths with Aldric again soon enough.

anh_en: Lottie… Lost!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Sometimes, we set up a temporary stage on it for impromptu performances. Keeps things lively.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: I've sent the coordinates of the first isle to your Terminal.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Now, all we need to do is sail full speed ahead toward our destination!

speaker: NPC #1462

anh_en: Oh no, Captain, we're not just betting drinks today. Not with {PlayerName} as our guest!

anh_en: How about this? If I win, you give the crew a day off. We all want to hang out with the Carnevale's Laureate again!

speaker: NPC #50098
anh_en: And you, Captain, will handle all the chores. Cooking, cleaning, deck scrubbing—the whole kit and caboodle!

The rod! Reel it in!

speaker: NPC #50098
anh_en: Tsk, this isn't just any drink. I brought the finest brew from Egla Town! Cost me a pretty penny, you know.

anh_en: Deal! It's been too long since I last cooked for the crew. If I lose, I'll show you all what this captain can whip up in the galley!

speaker: NPC #50101
anh_en: By the Sentinel, look at the size of that beast!

anh_en: Do we even have a pot big enough to cook it?

anh_en: Aye! Battier, my good friend, add one more six-pack. Tonight, this deck will be riotous with our revelry!

speaker: NPC #50098

anh_en: If you're playing sailor, then who's gonna be our captain?

speaker: NPC #50098
anh_en: Who do you think?!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: I've got no doubt you'd make a great captain.

anh_en: Absolutely, my friend. We sail straight!

anh_en: They're betting on who will catch the first fish.

anh_en: Hey now, grant this captain his due! I'm working hard to secure some fine libations for us!

anh_en: It's so quiet... like an intermission.

anh_en: Whenever it gets this still, I can't help but anticipate the next act and the surprises it might bring.

Get ready for a brawl.

anh_en: I've seen more fight in a children's theater troupe. Anyway, looks like they were digging over there. Let's take a look.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Hmm... something feels off.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Watch out!

anh_en: Ha, now that was a surprise. Aren't we lucky?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: There's nothing else in this hole.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Sure there is—my trusty shovel and some air.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Alright, alright. No more jokes. Keep digging, Captain!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Here it is.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: It looks like a chunk of amber. Its color is quite beautiful.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Remember the Amber Key Aldric mentioned before?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: This must be it. Let's take it and head to the next isle.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: I can't wait to see what surprises the second isle has in store.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Looks like the fog is rolling in.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Don't worry. This happens often when you're out at sea. Just trust the wheel in your hands and trust me.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Follow their lights, Captain, and we'll safely reach our destination.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As if to chase away any worries, Brant hums softly.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Look at those shipwrecks, Captain.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Are those... Drake's ships?

anh_en: Yes. It's said that Drake's fleet sailed across the entire Stormy Sea. Hard to believe that such a legendary figure could lose his way...

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: But if these wrecks are here, it means we're nearing our destination!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Wonderful, gentlemen! At last, I've found the key! O-of course, your help has been invaluable.

anh_en: …That's Aldric's voice.

anh_en: Do you see those wrecked ships? And with this thick fog... This place is danger incarnate.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: However, as your captain, I'm willing to sacrifice myself, braving all the dangers ahead, for our grand cause!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Stay here and await my return. And if anyone dares to get in our way, make them rue the day!

speaker: NPC #100018
anh_en: Captain! Oh, captain!

anh_en: Hey, you two! Stop right there!

speaker: NPC #100019
anh_en: Yeah! You two.

anh_en: Nonsense! My eyes tell me you're not just passing by.

anh_en: Captain's orders are crystal clear: No one messes with our grand cause. No one's stopping me from soaking in wine and him from decking his teeth in gold!

anh_en: Th-that's right! Y-you know how badly my teeth ache now… Owww…

speaker: NPC #100019

anh_en: Hmm... What does the captain of the Troupe of Fools do in a day?

anh_en: Alright, we yield.

anh_en: Aha, so this is my hidden identity!

anh_en: I'm just as curious as you are. With any luck, it'll be a catchy one for my next performance on stage.

anh_en: Not even the sharpest blade can kill him!

anh_en: Had the guts to raid the Pilgrim's Sails again and again

anh_en: He always ruined our plans!

anh_en: He was hunted time and again

anh_en: Every time we set off to raid those merchant ships

anh_en: This fiery bastard would swoop in, flames blazing!

anh_en: They say he's immortal, for no raging storm—

anh_en: That's quite the legend you've built yourself

anh_en: Haha… Let's see how this plays out

anh_en: Strong as hell, that one was

anh_en: Rescue missions!

anh_en: Anyway

anh_en: B-b-beyond outrageous!

anh_en: A-and I can get a gold tooth...

anh_en: Oh, what a generous captain you serve… truly selfless.

anh_en: And yet somehow, these two were left behind to stop us?

The pirates reveal Aldric's next destination to you.\nTime to pay him a visit.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Oh, right. I am the Flaming Returned, the immortal scourge of the seas. Cross me, and you'll be haunted by the crackle of flames every night!

speaker: NPC #100021
anh_en: Gold, for the love of gold, don't! I'll spill everything!

speaker: NPC #100018
anh_en: B-but, wouldn't that be betraying our captain?

speaker: NPC #100021
anh_en: Fool! Didn't you hear the captain? "If anyone dares to get in our way, make 'em regret it!"

speaker: NPC #100021
anh_en: If we don't give 'em what they want, Captain won't sleep a wink. He'll be plagued with nightmares of this menace!

speaker: NPC #100021
anh_en: Besides, Captain's already off with the key we found. He promised to share the loot with us, and soon I'll be swimming in barrels of wine!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Ah, we're nearly there at last.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: I'm very excited. There's something magical about the end of a journey, don't you think?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: That's when the real excitement kicks in, just before the final curtain call.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: So, Captain… ready for what comes next?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It's Aldric. Right there, just as we thought.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Brant. I didn't think you'd show up so soon.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: You've seen my crew. Those poor souls… I'm doing this for them, to give them the life they deserve. A-a happy, peaceful life.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: What do you say, Captain of the Troupe of Fools? A fair deal, wouldn't you agree?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (He sounds sincere. Can I really trust him?)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Regardless, agreeing to his deal to get ahold of the other key is in my best interest. Even if it's a trap, we can handle it. In that case...)
(Agree with his proposal.)
(Think about it for a bit longer.)
(Look at Brant.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Deal. Hand over the key.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Come on, we don't have all day! Make a decision, or none of us will get the treasure!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Deal. Hand over the key.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: And I didn't think you'd still be here.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Alright, we accept. Hand over the key.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Here you go. The gate's right over there.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Time to claim our treasures... Wait! What's that!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Ahhhh! You, uh, stay here and defend our great cause! Show them the true might of the Fool's Troupe. FAREWELL!

Aldric suggests a truce and a partnership, where he'll hand you the key under a 60/40 split in your favor once the treasure is found.\nYou agree to this partnership while also keeping a close eye on him. You're well prepared by the time he goes back on his words and makes his move.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Hm… where's all that treasure, then? Your crew is itching for the grand return of their selfless, heroic Captain Aldric.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: …Useless fools. Couldn't even slow you down.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Fine, you want the key, don't you? I could give it to you, but—

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Ah, I see! You want an honorable duel with my captain? A proper sea knight's duel, full of valor and—

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: No, no! Must we always resort t-to violence? See that? It takes two keys to unlock!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: You have one, and I have the other.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: We both want the treasures, right? So how about this, I'll give you my key, but we split the treasure. Sixty-forty… No, wait, I-I'll be generous. You take the sixty, and I'll settle for forty.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Well, the gate's closed. Looks like our friend left us with these two Chop Chops for company.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Just what you'd expect from a pirate.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: There's an opening over there. Let's check it out.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Hah! I knew there'd be a way forward.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let's keep moving.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: The Returned sailed through scorching flames, back to the stage's brilliant light… "Hoist the jib and set sail," he cried. "We shall conquer the raging sea..."

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: They're always asking Captain Brant to sing with them. He gets into it too—sometimes he makes up a whole scene right on the spot.
Is that part of the captain's duties?

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Not quite. Just Brant indulging his whims.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Anyway, I'd better get back to composing. I want to have this new song ready for those young buccaneers by dinner.
What's that you're singing?

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Oh, just a little shanty about a tale on the tip of everyone's tongue lately.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: They say a pirate roams the Stormy Sea—an immortal who can walk through fire without a scratch. No one has ever caught him.
Got a name for him?
Sounds like a real mystery.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Ah, the name's not important. It's just a story, after all.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: You know how it is—stories tend to pick up a little extra color as they're passed around.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: Still, the children love this sort of thing. Stories and songs, all woven together.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Is that a picture?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: It's badly eroded. Let's take a closer look.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Looks like... he's a captain.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: You know, there are stories about a place at the edge of the ocean, a nation where people use scales to measure everything.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Souls, wealth... nothing escapes the balance. Perhaps this painting nods to that—everything has a price. Classic quid pro quo.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Fascinating, isn't it? Maybe even Drake had a sense of fairness when it came to treasure. Anyway, let's keep moving, Captain. I have a hunch we'll uncover more soon.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: He's got a scale in one hand and... wait, that coin in his other hand, it looks just like the one we found.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: One side holds treasure, and the other… a broken heart. What do you think it means, Captain?
It's hinting at how to get the treasure.
It's a warning to be cautious.
Art isn't really my forte.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Hmm… so you're saying we may need to trade something precious, like our heart, for the treasure?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Could be. In stories like these, there's always a catch. Treasure hoarders love setting traps for any would-be thieves.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: No worries. We might find more clues ahead to piece it together.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You find distinct carvings, though much has been worn away by time.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Let me out… That's why I wanna leave…

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Oh... Someone was once trapped here.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You find more carvings, but most are illegible.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: No... hope. I pray for this to end… Ghh…

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Lost by seafarers, no doubt. Likely got caught in the sea fog and couldn't find their way out, poor boys.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You find more carvings. They are hard to read, but you can make out a few sentences.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Curses await ahead…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: They lost their minds at the sight of the treasures, fighting like madmen. It was terrifying...

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Curses, huh? I guess that's why no one's ever managed to bring back Drake's treasures.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: It says…

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Exactly. If we want something from the sea, we have to offer something in return.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Ignore that rule, and greed will swallow us whole. Likely with our lives as the main course.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Captain, I know what we need to do. Do you trust me?
Do what you have to do.
Your captain is right by your side.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: That's all I needed to hear. Let's head for the treasure!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Oh sea, curse equally all who dare to steal the treasure!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Remember the law of quid pro quo. Remember the law of quid pro quo…
Curse all who steal the treasure?
Remember the law of quid pro quo?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Looks like to claim Drake's treasure, one must pay a price equal to its worth. Maybe that's why no one's succeeded.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: The treasure demands something in return.
The golden rule…
Every reward comes with a price.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Ah, my dear friends! What a joy to see you both in one piece!
You're just afraid of the curse, aren't you?

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: C-curse? Hahaha! Do I look like the kind of man who fears mere legends? No, no, my offer comes straight from the heart.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: It's okay.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: In accordance with the law of the sea…

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: This is just a teeny tiny curse. Nothing more, nothing less.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: You... you look fine…

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Hahahaha! Curse? Turns out it's as harmless as a kitten!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: I fretted for nothing! Yes, now all this treasure is MINE!
What about your grand cause?
What about your crew?

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: I-I was absolutely quaking back there. Just the thought of that <ano=Chop Chop>monster</ano>… it still gives me the shivers!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Grand cause? My crew? Oh right…

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: I'll toss a modest pouch to each of my loyal mateys, and the rest? ALL MINE! Hahaha!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: When I left the Pilgrim's Sail, there was only one thing that stayed with me—to chase my desires without chains.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: And after all these years, I've cracked the code… Money! Hahaha! That's my one true calling. Hahaha!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: But everything comes with a price, Aldric.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: And now, it's time to pay yours.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Wh-what?!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Watch out, Captain!

You reach the treasure's location and meet Aldric once again.\nAldric plays his old trick, trying to fool you into doing all the hard work of getting the treasure.\nJust as Brant uses the coin to obtain the nautical chart, Aldric snatches the chest, declaring he wants all the treasure for himself. Sure, he's free to claim the treasure for himself, but such freedom always comes with a price.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: When I finally came to my senses, I found myself here, all alone. Quite... quite unsettling, I must say.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: But look at you! You took down that beast faster than I could blink.
Still working on that "grand cause" of yours?

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Grand…? Oh yes! My grand cause! I'm this close to realizing it, you see. Look! Drake's treasure is right there, so brilliant, so-so dazzling…

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: But as a man of principle, I could never hoard such wealth all to myself.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: So, in the spirit of fairness, I'd like to give you the honor of opening it first. Please go ahead, the first pick is yours!
Leave your bluster at the door.

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Wh-what's happening?!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Curse… This is the curse! My gold… My gold is moving!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: No Aldric, this is the price of your greed.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Did you forget? "The law of quid pro quo."

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: You mean that blasted half-coin?!

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: The gold… My gold…

speaker: NPC #100023
anh_en: Treasure… My grand cause… No…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You hear no response, only the sound of waves crashing against the shores.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You toss a Shell Credit into the air, a flicker of hope rising within you.

speaker: NPC #50102
anh_en: The Returned sailed through scorching flames, back to the stage's brilliant light… "Hoist the jib and set sail," he cried. "We shall conquer the raging sea..."

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: We managed to slip away.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: As a captain, you're quite different yourself.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Certainly one I'd be proud to follow.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: You accept your crew for who they are, understanding and respecting their choices.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: I've had my share of adventures, but I must admit—this one with you has been a breath of fresh air.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: By the way, look at this.
Is this... Drake's treasure?
What? It looks like an ordinary scroll.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: This is Golden Captain Drake's map, a record of his life.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: According to this, he and his crew did indeed brave the treacherous Stormy Sea and return with immense wealth, but not without paying dearly.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Heavy fog, disease, getting hopelessly lost, each entry could have sunk an entire fleet. By the time they made it back to the isle, only a handful survived.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: I… I never thought he'd pick those treasures over his own life…

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Most of them never left. In the end, only one sailor remained with this coin.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Remember what that note said? "Remember the law of quid pro quo."

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: I believe it means if you want Drake's treasure, you have to offer something in return. The price I paid for this scroll was that coin.
So, you gave away the coin…
And got this scroll in return?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Yes, but isn't it fascinating? A single coin can lead to both dreadful curses and priceless treasures.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Who would have guessed that Drake's most valuable treasure would be a map worth just one coin?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Honestly, when I made the trade, I wasn't sure what I'd get.
You were betting on it?
That was quite the gamble.
Are you holding up alright?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Hahaha! I had faith in you, my friend, and the spirit of adventure.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: And this story is far more compelling than the saga of the Flaming Returned, don't you think?
Didn't expect that title to come up again…
Tell me what all that is really about.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Ah, you remember those pirates who said I was always on the run?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Every time a bounty was placed on my head, I'd work with my crew. They'd turn me in for the reward, and I'd handle the escape.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: The rumors spread faster than I expected. Hahaha…

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Anyway, if you're up for it, the trip back is long enough for me to tell you all about it.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: So, Captain, the adventure's come to a close. Ready to sail back home?
Let's go!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Back then… When Toscanini first told us about Drake's story, I said I wanted to be a captain who led the crew to countless triumphs so that everyone gets to carve out their own destiny.
After finally making it back to the gondola, Brant shares with you stories of the past, the present, and the nautical chart.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Aldric just laughed, calling it foolish. He said, "You fool! With Drake's treasure, you can crush anyone and make everyone's life better by force!"

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: I never bought into that. For me, it's not about riches or power. It's about freedom—the freedom to sail your own course.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: That's why we parted ways. He left the Troupe of Fools and became a pirate.
The two of you became very different captains.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Amidst all your theatrics, you always remain true to your code.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Ah, what a journey. It feels good to be back.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Oh, and due to your stellar performance, I'm officially naming you our troupe's "Honorary Captain," as witnessed by this map!
When do we sail again?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: That depends on when the next adventure calls! You know that I'll be ready to join you, just say the word.

As the adventure comes to an end, the troupe grants you the title of Honorary Captain.\nBrant passes on Drake's nautical chart to you, insisting that if you ever come across new adventures in the future, remember to count him in the action.
Seems like my captaincy is over, too…
I'll leave the paperwork to you.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Time really does fly.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Paperwork? Why wasn't I warned about this?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Haha, jokes aside, you can count on me for that!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Anyway, this is for you.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Is this… Drake's scroll?

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Exactly! I figured it would be a good memento of our adventure.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: I'm proud to announce that you are now our troupe's Honorary Captain.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Whenever the next grand adventure calls, count me in. I'll be ready!

speaker: NPC #100015
anh_en: Six o'clock, dinner! Six o'clock, dinner!

speaker: NPC #100015
anh_en: Captain, Pan Cake at your service! At your service!

speaker: NPC #100015
anh_en: Greetings! Captain Brant sends his regards!
Brant lost his bet.
I'm the captain now.

speaker: NPC #100015
anh_en: Ooh, Captain! Captain!

speaker: NPC #100015
anh_en: Brant lost again! Surprise, surprise.
It happens a lot, doesn't it?
Has he ever won?

speaker: NPC #100015
anh_en: Never wins! Never wins!

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: Captain {PlayerName}, what's our destination?
Sail back to Huanglong!
Visit the Black Shores!

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: Splendid! Brant took us to Septimont once, so we know that route well.

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: That might be a challenge. We've never gone that far before, but I've heard about Huanglong's famed Hero Plays. Maybe we'll get to see one!

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: The Black Shores…? I've never heard of that place. What's it like? Can't wait to see it for myself!

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: Now that I know the plan, I'll go tell the others and get things ready.
No gasps of disbelief?
Just another day in the life of the Troupe of Fools!

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: Haha! We've braved wuthering waves and stared down every tide! We're seasoned sailors, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: Captain Brant might be whimsical at times, but when the chips are down, he always pulls everyone through.

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: Normally, Captain Brant calls the shots, but since the helm is yours, I'm all ears!

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: Surprises are just part of our life, so we've gotten used to this "improvised" way of sailing.

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: Speaking of which, we've been busy with convoy assignments lately as pirates have been causing trouble intercepting trade routes, so we should stay sharp, Captain.

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: After today's performance, I'll check the sea conditions again.

speaker: NPC #50100
anh_en: Tina! Where are you? Rehearsal is starting soon!

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: I'm coming!

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: Well, Captain, duty calls! I hope you're finding your footing here. Catch you later!
Finally! Now this feels like a captain's job.
I'll leave it to the First Mate.

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: The Fools are always eager to know where we're headed. So a captain must light the way!

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: The First Mate's opinion does matter, but it's up to the captain to set the course.

speaker: NPC #50103
anh_en: For those of us who've left our pasts behind, a guiding star is everything. I don't know what the troupe would do without a captain.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (I see. I'll do my best to live up to that! Then, let us—)
Explore the entirety of Rinascita!

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}. I heard you're the captain today. Don't forget to wrap up the paperwork!
I thought I was running a ship, not a ledger!
I came for the high seas, not a list of to-dos!

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: Haha, don't worry. It was a joke. I hope you've been enjoying yourself today.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: Leave the paperwork to Brant. Pero will keep an eye on him to make sure it's done by tomorrow.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: Brant might not look like your typical captain, but he gets the job done.
He is surprisingly reliable.
He does things in his style.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: Hehe, all in a day's work for a captain, right?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Let me think… the switch should be in the other room.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Light floods the room again, but your keen senses tell you something is different.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: We've scoured every inch of the backstage, including every shadowed corner.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It seems the Round Hat isn't here.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Various paintings pile up in the art room, their pigments emitting a gentle glow. They all appear to have been painted recently. But... does someone as busy as Cantarella have the leisure to paint them?

speaker: NPC #150026
anh_en: Round Hat... for you.

speaker: NPC #150026
anh_en: Take them.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The doll thrusts a Round Hat into your hands with no further explanation.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The red velvet of the hat gleams, as if coated in a girl's shimmering tears. It's like a maraschino cherry on a frosted cake. Sweet, yet bitter.
The doll thrusts a Round Hat into your hands with no further explanation.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: At long last, the final performance.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Dance! And fight!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: The Maiden's crown will soon appear—

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: And rest upon one among you.

speaker: NPC #150025
anh_en: Round Hat. Thank you.

speaker: NPC #150025
anh_en: Odd… but, thank you.

speaker: NPC #150025
anh_en: The final performance. Begins now.

speaker: NPC #150025
anh_en: Go. The front. Closer… clear… reassured.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The doll's broken words seem to suggest you step closer to the stage for a clearer view. \nBut "reassured"… Who should feel reassured? You? Or the doll? The answer may lie ahead, once the performance begins.
The doll thanks you for bringing her the Round Hat and invites you to the stage for the final performance.

speaker: NPC #150027
anh_en: Show time. Need light.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The doll's face is expressionless, yet its gaze lingers unmistakably on the lamp in your hand.

speaker: NPC #150027
anh_en: Light. Lamp.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The frequencies... are in such a disarray... It will be hard to switch between worlds now...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: That woman is… Why would a Fisalia be here?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: How dare she show up in the town after everything they did!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Come on, those rumors aren't even confirmed…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: She's a noble with real power, and we're just commoners.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Are you scared? Well, I'm not!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey, keep it down! You want to get us in trouble?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Just calm down and make it through the night…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: After all, tonight's the only time we can mourn for them.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The frequencies... are too chaotic...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: No worries. We'll try again.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: (Strained breathing)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You must be Annis.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And also Girl A, who couldn't speak but managed to send me that message.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You want me to find her, right?

You figure out who this girl with a red round hat is. She must be Annis, the silent Ghost Girl A who sent you that message. But why hasn't she aged over these years? There's no time to dwell on this question now. After all, saving Cantarella comes first.\n\nAnnis offers to help. She closes her eyes and holds the lamp. A brilliant light appears, reigniting the lamp's glow, yet Annis vanishes in its wake.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: We'd better watch ourselves! They might have tricks up their sleeves we can't even imagine!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: How dare she show up in the town after everything they did!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Will the lost souls truly return home?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: So... painful...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Ergh...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The Cantarella I know is unbreakable.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: She will never falter even if you drown her with all these malicious whispers.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And you certainly won't shake me, either.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: All those years of lying and scheming, and what have you gained?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Well, you see, illusions can also lead to true beauty.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Your obsession, corrupted by whispers, has become a shadow over the castle… A deluge of delusions that shouldn't exist in this world.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I can feel the pain those whispers inflicted upon you. Allow me to free you from them... once more!

Years ago, Cantarella used illusions to deceive the late head of Fisalia, seizing his position and ending the cruel trials. But his remaining obsession, corrupted by the whispers, has lingered in the castle and turned the place into the Sea of Ghosts.\n \nTogether, you and Cantarella set his lingering will free.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: A tarnished reputation? You could have walked away from this, Cantarella.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I still remember the little you. The youngest, the most neglected of all the Fisalias. You always lingered by your cauldron, and only smiled when a bird fluttered past the window.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: You despise this place, don't you? But the blood in your veins... it binds you, holds you prisoner in this endless nightmare.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: You loathe our rules, yet they have already seeped into your very existence.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Tell me, have you ever considered leaving? Let go of this burden that crushes you, and you'll be free as air, free to live the life you've longed for.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: My dear lord, I've already gifted you the sweetest of dreams. But why do you still cling to this earthly burden?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: You watched with satisfaction as I climbed over the fallen, ascended the steps to glory, and wore the thorned crown... Was that not enough for you?

speaker: NPC #150038
anh_en: Illusions are no match for poison, Cantarella. False bubbles burst, and here we are—the end of it all.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The abyss may reside in shadows, but even the deepest darkness cannot endure the touch of light.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Your trust strengthens the lamp. It now burns brighter.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Now is the time. Let the light shine brighter.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Now! Free him from the Threnodian's whispers.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Tonight's theme is the ghost girl, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Then… if we get our hands on it, let's keep it for ourselves!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I want to stay young forever. That way, you'll always see me at my best!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Nah, I want the one that turns stone into gold! Then we can live a wealthy life together.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yeah, I heard it's related to something that happened in the town a few years ago…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Is this what they mean by "based on a true story"? Ugh, that gives me the goosebumps!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: What's there to be afraid of? It's just a folk tale.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Every place has their own. I think they're all made up to scare people and hype up the festival!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm not scared of any ghost girl. Not even a ghost lord would faze me! I'm definitely getting that elixir!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Is that elixir really as powerful as they say?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Of course, I've seen it myself. Uncle Rick got one before.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: He couldn't use it himself, but sold it for a nice profit!

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: We haven't fully banished the whispers. Watch out. The twisted obsession is returning to the shadow.

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: In that hellish duel, Cantarella shielded us with illusions.

As the lingering obsession of the late head of the Fisalias fades, the Sea of Ghosts vanishes.\n\nWith the hymns rising around you, you find yourself in the sanctuary, where the girls who are supposed to be dead stand in front of you, all safe and sound.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: My lord, I offered you the sweetest of dreams and safeguarded your legacy when you departed.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I have entrusted Fisalia's true faith to one most deserving, and the Threnodian's deceptions in the Inverted Tower have been laid bare.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: No more whispers shall haunt us. Our children are freed from the cruel burdens of those trials.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Now, you too shall find release from the Threnodian's whispers.
They aren't ghosts, are they?
So, this is the answer?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Heh, nothing escapes your eyes, does it?

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: We're here, alive and well!

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: It all started

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: The elixir

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: was our blood and tears

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Yet the bane

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: gave us sweet dreams

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: At last

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Through the shadows

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: we reached the end

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: with a false hope

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: An elixir to grant any wish

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: was said to be here

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: We dived into darkness

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Choked down fear

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Nothing's here but the deep... and ourselves.

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Once Cantarella took charge of the family, she shielded us, keeping us safe in the castle's depths.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Since the Threnodian's lies were unraveled, the frequencies and situations on the outside have shifted.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Thanks to you, the Order is now entangled in its own troubles, too distracted to reach into the Fisalias.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Most deeply affected by the Threnodian's whispers was the castle—where the former head was trapped, where innocent girls were lost to the trials... As the Threnodian fell, all these frequencies broke out at once.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The long-standing fear, pain, resentment, and repression—all that the whispers had suppressed burst free, becoming a new cage.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The shackles of one's spirit were heavier than those from the outside. Yet, thanks to you, we shattered those shackles together.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I knew then... the time had come for the girls to finally go home.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I never meant to draw you into this. I was planning to shoulder it all alone. That's why for this year's Night of Remembrance I took part myself, and as host, I chose "ghost girls" as the theme.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: My plan was to break through the Sea of Ghosts, claim that I've solved the riddles and won the elixir of revival, and then use it to send the girls home when the Dance of the Dead begins at midnight.
What about the letter I received?
What about the influence on me?

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: The Order's members were always prying, eager to find out the truth... I knew if we went out recklessly, we'd only invite danger.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Your arrival, seemingly by chance, was perhaps destined.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The letter wasn't my doing, but I think I know who brought you to my side.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: She had no intention of hurting you with the abnormal frequencies, but she had been in the twisted Sonoro for too long... long enough that she was nearly one with its frequencies.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: When I saw that letter and sensed something unusual about you, I realized you could no longer stay out of this matter. With a special constitution, you were affected by the frequencies overflowing from the Sea of Ghosts.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Looking back, my arrogance blinded me... Ah, forgive me, for showing you this weak side of myself.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The currents here run deep, and the tangled seaweed is thick. Even I can easily become ensnared.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: But you… you helped me untangle these knots and weathered the torrents by my side.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Thanks to you, the elixir was much easier to make. That's why I said, a skilled brewer is far more important than the ingredients or the process.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Please, accept my heartfelt gratitude. Thank you for being here, and for staying by my side.

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Cantarella, you don't have to bear it all alone anymore! You've got someone you can truly count on now.

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Though... I really miss my home, more than I can say.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hehe, you're right. I have one last favor to ask, {PlayerName}. Could you take the elixir and see the girls home on my behalf?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The Fisalia doesn't enjoy a good reputation, and some villagers would resist my presence. At this point, causing any complication is the last thing I want.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: You, however, as the Laureate who exposed the lies and turned the impossible into the possible, will carry a weight they can't ignore. If you're the one to handle this, the people will be convinced.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Besides, even if the Order intends to look into this "miraculous revival" later, your status and capabilities will hold them back.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: But putting all that aside, it's with your effort that this elixir was possible. I can think of no one more fitting for this task.
I'll help until all is settled.
Don't you want to clear your name?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Thank you. Both I, and the entire Fisalia family, will aid you in any way we can.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Names are like sea foam that easily fades away. It hardly matters to me. Besides, it may not be a bad thing for people to stay wary of the Fisalias.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: After all, we're a large family, with deep-rooted issues. Change takes time.

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Fortunately, Cantarella holds the Night of Remembrance every year. With our masks, we can slip away, even just for a while, back to our village.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Girls, gather your things. It's time to go home.

You learn from Cantarella that since the Threnodian's lies were uncovered, the frequencies and circumstances around Ragunna have shifted. The time had come for the girls to finally go home.

She admits that she never intended to involve you and had planned to handle everything herself. That's why for this year's Night of Remembrance, she took part herself and chose "ghost girls" as the theme.

She had meant to dive into the Sea of Ghosts alone, claim she had solved the riddles and obtain the elixir of revival. This would allow her to send the girls home during the midnight Dance of the Dead. 

But Annis's message led you to her side to complete the plan.

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: It's always a great comfort to see Jojo living happily and in good health.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: My dear, from this night forward, you're free to be with your families.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} here has solved the riddles. Together, {Male=he;Female=she} and I will craft the elixir of revival.
Wait, what's going on?
I think I'm getting the picture now.

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Thank you, Cantarella, for everything you've done for us for all these years.

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Now that we're leaving, you'll be left alone here…

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: You should never have had to bear such a heavy burden.

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: I still remember what you told me back then, during the trials. You said you wanted to leave this place behind, go somewhere far away where no one knew you, and live freely...

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: But now, you're staying in this cold castle, bearing it all alone…

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: As long as I am the head of Fisalia, what happened here remains buried. No more trials, no more innocent lives caught in this web.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: My freedom for theirs—a fair exchange, wouldn't you say?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It's time to leave, my dear.
You prepare to send the girls back to their homes. Before you leave, they say their final goodbyes to Cantarella, thanking her for everything she's done for them over the years.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Tonight, all the riddles are solved. Behold, the elixir of resurrection.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: What a night to remember.

The Night of Remembrance has come to a perfect close, and the town settles back into its usual peace. The windmill creaks as it turns, and leaves drift lazily in the midnight breeze. \nIt feels like nothing ever happened, as if it was just a fleeting night's dream. But you know it was real, because Cantarella stands right beside you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It's late… Would you care to come to my castle and rest for the night?
I'd love that. I could use a good rest.
It will be my pleasure. Let me walk you home.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Cantarella's lips curve into a gentle smile, her eyes, calm as the ocean depths, rippling with a hint of warmth.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: She knows you're stronger than her, but her instinct to care for you remains, as natural as the breath she takes.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Oh, the pleasure is mine, my dear.

The Night of Remembrance ends smoothly, and the girls return to their homes. The lingering influence over you and Abby is lifted, and everything returns to its usual calm.

It feels like nothing ever happened, as if it was just a fleeting night's dream. But you know it was real, because Cantarella stands right beside you.

She acknowledges that you're stronger than her, but that doesn't stop her from instinctively caring for you. She invites you to rest at her now peaceful castle.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: *yawn* That was a really long nap.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: *sniff* Mmm, the strange smell is all gone! You smell good again!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Oh! I had the best dream! I was dancing with all these cute Echoes! Hehe!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Oops, uh... am I interrupting something?
No, no, Abby. Go back to sleep.
You're just realizing it?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Fine... I'll just go take another nap.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hehe… Things have returned to normal, it seems. How delightful.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: With you here, this castle feels… warmer. Your presence may have dispelled the chill that used to linger.
So, you chose to offer your own strength...
So, you sought a different way...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Yes. When I took up the Sword of Divinity, I felt a <ano=Fleurdelys>presence</ano>, someone far more capable, more suitable. A new possibility emerged.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I asked the Sentinel to transfer my Second Awakening power to that girl.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The Sentinel had always wielded the power of separation, but instead agreed to my proposal to combine our strengths. With that power, she confronted the Threnodian.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: We triumphed, for the moment, but the Threnodian proved to be more difficult than we expected.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: To stop the brutal Divine Trials and secure us the final victory, I chose to become the family head, drawing on every resource available to achieve our goal.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I pretended to align with the Order to keep the Threnodian off guard, all while searching for a way to fully liberate the Sentinel and end the Threnodian once and for all.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: And then... I found you.
So that's why you took me straight to the Sword of Divinity.
The Fisalia family...
You must've gone through a lot.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hehe… I have been watching you from the moment you set foot in Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Now, I daresay I know you inside out.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Just as you chose your path, I've chosen mine. I will see it through, whatever it may cost.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Besides, compared to what you've endured, my hardships aren't worth mentioning.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: You defeated the Threnodian in the Inverted Tower, saved the people of Rinascita, and freed those young girls... and me as well.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The girls are now back home, and the Threnodian's whispers have finally faded from this castle.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: And with the Order's concessions, the shadows over Rinascita are vanishing. Peace has come to us once more.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Thanks to you, the days of pain and sacrifice have ended. A calm life… that is the miracle you've brought.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: As the head of Fisalia, I must offer you a fitting reward for all the efforts you made.
The Divine Trials...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: An elixir for eternal youth, perhaps? No, judging from the power of your Awakening, it seems you may already possess that.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Then, let it be the elixir that turns stone into gold.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I, Cantarella Fisalia, hereby offer {PlayerName} the family's entire legacy—every elixir and every hidden secret.
That's too much.
Really? Everything? Does that mean...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hehe… the Fisalias make no unprofitable bargains. It's my privilege to give it all to you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hehe, this is "our" home now.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It's been a long day. You deserve a sweet, peaceful sleep.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Here, a special elixir I've prepared with Albizia flowers—their gentle, lingering fragrance can waft through reality into your dream.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Now, close your eyes... and rest. Good night.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Our family's purpose has always been clear—to resist the Threnodian's spiritual interference and hold fast to our faith in the Sentinel.

It's just you and Cantarella in the castle now. She opens up to you, sharing her thoughts.
 
The Fisalias have always fought to resist the Threnodian's spiritual interference and hold fast to their faith in the Sentinel. The cruel trials were designed to find a Maiden with an unbreakable will, someone capable of withstanding the Threnodian's whispers.
 
Cantarella can't accept the so-called "necessary sacrifice" that strips others of their free will, but she understands it's the only solution. Therefore, she transferred her Second Awakening power to find a solution where no one else but her would be harmed.
 
She pretended to align with the Order to lull the Threnodian into complacency, all the while searching for a way to liberate the Sentinel and defeat the Threnodian once and for all.
 
And then, she found you. Alongside Cantarella, you shaped this peaceful, happy ending, a miracle born from both of you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The cruel trials were designed to find a Maiden with an unbreakable will, someone who could withstand the Threnodian's whispers and fix her eyes on the true light.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Yet, in pursuit of that "noble cause," innocent lives were sacrificed without question.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I can't accept the so-called "necessary sacrifice," one that tramples the will of others in the name of duty. It's nothing but living off the weak.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Though it's important to kindle the flames, none should forget those burned to ashes—those lives shouldn't have been squandered.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: After all, we are more than just firewood.

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Hi, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: Thanks to you, we're finally back home, safe and sound!

speaker: NPC #50135
anh_en: And Jojo's fully recovered, too.

speaker: NPC #150030
anh_en: Ms. Rosemary at the Apothecary gave me this special medicine! Just a tiny dab, and the pain's all gone!

speaker: NPC #150030
anh_en: She said it was from Ms. Can… something… Oh, I can't remember. Grown-up names are always so hard to keep straight!

speaker: NPC #150030
anh_en: Anyway, it's from a very nice lady!

speaker: NPC #150030
anh_en: And anyone sick can use it, too! Yay!

speaker: NPC #150031
anh_en: We survived, but at what cost? Is it a blessing? Or is it just more to carry?

speaker: NPC #150031
anh_en: Sometimes, I wonder, when life is this heavy, could death be... an easier path?

speaker: NPC #150032
anh_en: But if you die, you lose everything. No more chances. No paths ahead.

speaker: NPC #150032
anh_en: Besides, as survivors, who are we to say whether the dead found peace?

speaker: NPC #150032
anh_en: Just being here, with thoughts and worries and even fears… That's its own kind of happiness.

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: Welcome. Would you like to reach for the brightest star in the sky, or indulge in the greatest joy of the mortal world?

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: Or maybe… nothing could ever satisfy your endless desire?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Always so playful, Mammon. Unfortunately, my friend here isn't driven by greed.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: All we seek is the first riddle of the "ghost girl" to set the tone for tonight. After all, even the smallest catch can serve as a splendid entrée for a grand feast.

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: I see, but nothing comes for free. If you want it, you'll have to trade me something entertaining.

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: Perhaps a loaf of bread that speaks, oil that melts into water, or... a glimpse into Fisalia's hidden past.
How about a special performance from a Laureate?

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: Oh, just for me? That would be an honor I'd truly relish.
Mammon, the owner of the first stall, says he will only give you the first riddle if you exchange something precious.\n\nAs the new Laureate, you offer a performance, which he gladly accepts.

speaker: NPC #150033
anh_en: Annis, O' Annis… the light in despair, the angel from the mirage…

speaker: NPC #150033
anh_en: Oh, no, child. Annis is as real as hope itself.

speaker: NPC #150033
anh_en: Not in name, no. But the angel Annis is always near.

speaker: NPC #150033
anh_en: When someone is in a bind, yet clings to the faintest glimmer of hope, Annis appears in the form of things they're familar with, guiding them out of the tight spot.

speaker: NPC #150033
anh_en: If you're strong enough to hold on, Annis will come to you.
Hello, ma'am. Do you know Annis?
Annis? Isn't that the name of Girl A?

speaker: NPC #150033
anh_en: Hmm? So, everyone's heard of Annis?

speaker: NPC #150033
anh_en: Girl A? No, no… Annis is Annis, no one else.

speaker: NPC #150033
anh_en: Annis is the angel sung about in hymns, a gentle light that appears to those lost in despair.

speaker: NPC #150033
anh_en: They take many forms, like someone dear, a flower, a bird… even a jellyfish, sometimes.
So Annis is just a legend?
Is there an Annis here in the town?

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: I've conducted over a hundred visits and interviews, traveling between Thessaleo Fells and Egla Town. Finally, I think I have a theory...

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: In extreme cases, one's own identity can fragment, conjuring up an imaginary figure.

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: So, when an entire community is facing intense pressure...

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: Hmm, but I'd say that angel or not, true salvation lies within ourselves. Don't you agree?

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: It seems that these regions are experiencing a phenomenon—mass hypochondria, if you will.

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: For example, many people claim to have seen an ancient knight they believe is still alive.

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: Others speak of an angel named Annis, said to answer the call of those with unbreakable wills. Annis appears in different forms, helping those in dire need.

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: From the records, she's often seen as a young girl, a flower, a bird… even a jellyfish.

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: Yet, after combing through records over the past few centuries, I have yet to find any concrete evidence for Annis's existence.

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: Medically speaking, it seems more likely that these are hallucinations brought on by intense mental strain.

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: When someone is under severe stress or endures deep trauma, the mind might create an external figure to ease the pain, like a survival mechanism.

speaker: NPC #150039
anh_en: Think of the pressures of strained family ties, the toll of years of competition, and hallucinations induced by toxins...

speaker: NPC #150049
anh_en: I never imagined life could feel this carefree.

speaker: NPC #150049
anh_en: Just look at this vast scenery... It brings much calm to my heart.

speaker: NPC #150050
anh_en: Yeah, I feel the same way. A simple and quiet life. There's a beauty in it.

speaker: NPC #150050
anh_en: We have Cantarella to thank for this peace.

speaker: NPC #150049
anh_en: I feel reassured with her as the head of our family.

speaker: NPC #150049
anh_en: She's… she's everything a Maiden should be, more so than I could ever be. And as the head of Fisalia? She's unmatched.

speaker: NPC #150049
anh_en: For us, I think it's our turn to make the most of the world she saved for us. Let's live every day to its fullest.

speaker: NPC #150050
anh_en: Yes, and let's capture the beauty we find along the way! I'm sure she'll be happy to receive these photos!

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Now, back to our topic. Hidden among the stalls set up for tonight are three riddles entwined with the tale of the "ghost girl." Yet, these stalls are rather elusive. Rumor has it that they might even be run… by demons.
I doubt it.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Well then, might I suggest we collaborate to secure this reward?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I am after a particular elixir myself.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Well then, might I suggest we collaborate to secure this reward?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I am after a particular elixir myself.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Such admirable restraint. However, it's too late to withdraw from this game, as the ghosts have already begun to shadow your every step.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: According to that message, bringing those ghosts back to the mortal realm might clear the effects weighing on you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: So, might I suggest we collaborate to win the elixir that brings the dead back to life? I could also use that elixir myself.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: In that case, why not unravel the lies and find the truth yourself? It could be quite enjoyable.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Come and join me in this game. I know you won't let go of any potential clues.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: But of course, there are no demons in this world, only distorted frequencies or men cloaked in disguise, driven by their unmet desires.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Besides, there are certain places that only you may be able to reach.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I happen to need a special elixir myself.
I thought someone as talented as you could make any potion.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Well, it requires more than you might imagine: the finest ingredients, precise procedures, impeccable techniques, and, of course, the proper mood.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: But with you at my side, even the most intricate elixir would be a delight to create.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I'd love to explore this with you, be it elixir or poison.

Cantarella tells you that three riddles entwined with the tale of the "ghost girl" are hidden among the stalls set up for tonight.\n\nWhoever solves all three riddles and uncovers the mystery of the "ghost girl" can ask the host for an elixir that grants any wish. You're skeptical, but Cantarella seems intrigued. You decide to join her.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Dealing with them requires no money. Instead, they sift through your desires, choosing what to claim for themselves.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Isn't that enchanting? There's no thrill in simply buying all your heart's desires with mere money.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: And now, we have the "main course" for tonight: whoever solves all three riddles and uncovers the mystery of the "ghost girl" can ask the host for an elixir.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Whether to turn stones into gold, grant eternal youth, or even bring the dead back to life… Whichever you want, this potion is here to make it real.
I want the one that turns stones into gold.
I want the one that brings the dead back to life.
I just want to get rid of whatever effect that message had on me.

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: How marvelous! I hear the sounds of birth and doom, of everlasting mountains and seas, and the fierce pulses of life!

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: This is life's symphony, each note threaded by the loom of time, more alluring than any Siren's call!

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: As promised, here is the first riddle: The Siren's Song.

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: Long ago, a group of girls followed the Siren's call out of town. They journeyed to the 'crown' atop the mountain and to the waterfall that cascaded into the depths.

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: Beyond this riddle, I, Mammon, have yet another gift to offer for your performance.

speaker: NPC #150021
anh_en: Please take this music box. It's dusty with age, but it might just sing again with a song like you just played.

Impressed by your performance, Mammon reveals to you the first riddle: The Siren's Song.

"Long ago, a group of girls followed the Siren's call out of town. They journeyed to the 'crown' atop the mountain and to the waterfall that cascaded into the depths below."

He also offers you a music box.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Something falls from the fading chaotic frequencies. \nIts form is twisted, like a lump of flesh torn from the abyss. \nIt's a book.
Knock on the door three times.
Smash the door.
Toss a Shell Credit at the door.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A strange sensation creeps into your hand as you knock. You immediately sense the shift in the surrounding frequencies.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Your fist passes through the door. It's there, yet not there.\nLike striking water, no matter how hard you try, the force is swallowed by the endless sea.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Nice try, but this is not a wishing well, not to mention it's reckless to make wishes to the Sea of Ghosts.\nThe abyss seems to have no interest in devouring you now and returns your Shell Credit.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Behind the door, you catch the faint scent of seawater-soaked pages and the soft sound of jellyfish tentacles brushing through the waves.
Knock on the door three times.
You find this door familiar.
You're tired of knocking on it.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The cacophonies from behind the door are like high waves going to burst out of it.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Yes, it's the third, no, maybe the fourth time it appears. Or more likely, it just keeps regenerating itself, again and again.\nPerhaps the door also recognizes you as it snaps open and drags you inside.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: However, the abyss will never get tired of you. Since you have nowhere to run in the deep sea, your only choice is to face it.\nThe door opens wide anyway and pulls you into the waves.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That person does seem a bit extra...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Perhaps Mammon has offered us a little aperitif.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Alright, I know where we need to go next… The second riddle is waiting for us.
As Cantarella tinkers with the music box, you notice its shape resembles an apple.\n\nInspired by your observation, she solves the first riddle and leads you to the second stall.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It's understandable. Hearing a Laureate perform is an honor, a blessing for everyone in Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Even this music box should be humming along in admiration…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Cantarella taps the music box, but it doesn't work as expected.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Oh, so that's why this little thing isn't behaving… Someone must have silenced it, leaving it unable to sing.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Cantarella's fingers move deftly as she tinkers with the music box, but it remains silent.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As Cantarella examines it, you notice the music box has a unique shape.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: If you look at this music box from above, doesn't it resemble a big apple?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hmm, now that you mention it… Indeed, it does.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: But can the glimmers from these delicate drifters truly light up the entire sea?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Yes, just place it gently here.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I, Cantarella Fisalia, value every promise I made to you and vow to see them through.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Besides, there are certain places that only you may be able to reach.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Come now. We've more to uncover.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A bizarre poster announcing the "final performance."\nThe two dolls on it look strangely familiar.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: We'd better watch ourselves! They might have tricks up their sleeves we can't even imagine!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: How dare she show up in the town after everything they did!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Will the lost souls truly return home?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: So... painful...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Ergh...

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: I know what you came for.

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: Huh… What made you choose this one? Was it your sharp intuition, or the ability to see right through everything?

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: No need to answer. There's something in you. I can tell your soul is burning like a flame that no ash could ever smother.

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: Take this "luck" hidden within the freshest apple. You deserve it.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Cantarella gives you a reassuring glance. \nHer eyes shimmer like ripples over a moonlit sea as she gazes at the apple and gestures gracefully.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: That one, please.

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: So, the rumors are true—nothing escapes your keen gaze, Cantarella the Bane.

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: This little taste of "luck" is just a starter. Now, allow me to serve the main dish.

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: Here comes the second riddle: The Red Apple.

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: The girls lined up for their apples, each one in a vivid, glistening red… but why would apples appear in the deep sea?

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: Whether it brings "luck" or "misfortune," taste it and see for yourselves.

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: Without exceptional insight and unparalleled courage, all you'll end up with are mere scraps.

The owner of the second stall is Beelzebul, who asks you to pick the freshest apple in the stall. After you find the correct apple, Beelzebul gives you a "lucky coin" and reveals the second riddle: The Red Apple.\n\n"The girls lined up for their apples, each one in a vivid, glistening red… but why would apples appear in the deep sea?"

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: If you lack what I seek, then just swallow the scraps with the ashes.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Good enough for the fishes, perhaps, but hardly something to serve at the table.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: This distinguished friend of mine deserves nothing less than the finest dish and the freshest apple.

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: Well then, give it a try. May you find the freshest apple.

speaker: NPC #150022
anh_en: Go on, make a choice. Let's see if this apple holds the prize you seek.
(Choose one)
(Look for help from Cantarella)

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hmm... Our delicate little friend seems to have slipped above us.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I'll find us a way.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: People of Rinascita often use coin tosses for divination.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Heads up signifies good fortune, a sign of following the sacred path. Tails up, however, invites misfortune, a mark of defiance against the Divinity.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The front of the coin features a doll in a red hat, while the back shows one in blue. The coin has an unusual appearance, with uneven, ribbed edges.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Are these dolls blessed or cursed?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Perhaps the last riddle will give us a clue.

The coin isn't perfectly round, with its edges ribbed and uneven. The front of the coin features a doll in a red hat, while the back shows one in blue.\n\nCantarella picks up on the clue and leads you to the third stall... But, isn't collecting these riddles going a bit too smoothly?

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: Hmm, which is the most beautiful among these dolls?

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: The lucky red hat! Exactly! Following the divine will is always a wise choice.

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: Defying the divine will is a reckless gamble with your very life at stake—one I wouldn't advise.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Without waiting for your response, Invidia hands you a doll with a red hat.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Cantarella's gaze seems to reflect a stormy sea, veiled in layers of mist that hide her feelings. After a moment, she picks up a doll with a red hat.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: If we obey the divine will, does that really bring us luck?

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: Haha, I like your honesty! Yes, they're all pretty much the same, aren't they?

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: Here, take this one.

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: This one has bright eyes, that one has a nice nose, and that one there has red lips… Wait, this one's gotta be a bit less pretty. Can't let it outshine me!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Invidia tosses the red-hat doll your way.

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: Wonderful! As long as you follow the Divinity, luck will surely be on your side!

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: Now, for dessert, I present you with fortune cookies.

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: This is the last riddle: The Round Hat.

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: A girl dons her red dancing shoes and wears a scarlet hat, ready for the final act of her performance.

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: Now, all the riddles are in your hands! Whether the answers will rise like bubbles from the witch's cauldron, well, that's up to you.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As you hold the doll, its features suddenly sharpen and become lifelike. Its delicate brows, bright eyes, and elegant attire seem to come to life in the blink of an eye.

Dolls wearing red and blue hats are placed in the third stall. The owner, Invidia, asks you to pick the most beautiful one. But no matter which one you choose, she insists on giving you the doll in the red hat, claiming that the red hat symbolizes divine will and brings luck.

She then tells you the last riddle: The Round Hat.

"A girl dons her red dancing shoes and wears a scarlet hat, ready for the final act of her performance."

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: Ugh, so frustrating. They're all gorgeous, but none quite live up to my standards!

speaker: NPC #150051
anh_en: Now tell me, what do you think? Which doll stands out the most?
(Pick the doll in a red hat)
(Pick the doll in a blue hat)
(Look for help from Cantarella)
They all look the same to me.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The message feels cryptic, and the bizarre formatting gives you an uneasy feeling.

You receive a strange message from a "ghost girl." The twisted frequency within it affects both you and Abby. \n\nTo uncover the mystery and lift its effects, you decide to attend the Night of Remembrance in Egla Town, as mentioned in the message.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Night of Remembrance? Is that another special event in Egla Town?)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (And this message… Is it a prank? Or is there more to this?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The longer you stare at the message, the more the words seem to twist and distort, heightening your unease.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Ugh, what's this smell?!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Nope, I can't take it… Gotta take a break…

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Ew, why do I still smell it down here? Wait, this weird frequency… It's coming from that message!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Ugh, my head… so dizzy… I'm gonna lie down. Just... just holler if you need me…

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Looks like we've been hit by the weird frequency in that message. I should check out what's going on in Egla Town.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Now all the riddles are here, like fish returned to the sea. However, they are entangled in a maze of seaweed.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Let's see... A dusty broken music box, a cog-like "lucky coin," and a doll in a red hat.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: They're all out of production now. None of the music boxes these days use this kind of cog.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Looks like these little trinkets are relics from the past.
They can be assembled into a ballerina music box!
How about we put them together?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Good catch. As a girl, I used to while away those endless, quiet hours in the castle by playing with such things.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Perhaps some part of me still remembers what to do… No, I'm certain I still do.

Cantarella places the doll on the music box's pedestal and slides the cog-like coin into the slot. Click—the missing cog clicks back into place. Just like that, the fish breaks free from the maze of seaweed.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It seems all we need is the Laureate's performance to breathe life back into this old relic.

You realize that the music box, the cog-like "lucky coin," and the doll in a red hat can be assembled into a ballerina music box.\n\nCantarella puts the parts together and you perform once again. This time, the music box plays.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: How would you free them from the maze?
Analyze the keywords of each riddle.
Find the connection between these items.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The Siren's Song, the Red Apple, the Red Shoes and the Round Hat…

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Among the tales of Rinascita, all these three end bitterly.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: However, with the Laureate's aid, we may see a different ending tonight.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Since all stories are rooted in reality, perhaps we should take a closer look at the three items we've collected.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Let's see... A dusty broken music box, a cog-like "lucky coin," and a doll in a red hat.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: The show begins.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The melody evokes a sense of familiarity, reminding you of that place—<ano=Castle of Fisalia>Porto-Veno Castle</ano>.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It only strengthens your suspicion that the "ghost girl" must be connected to the Fisalia castle.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A sharp headache interrupts your thoughts, the distorted frequencies intensifying. Through the pain, you find a reason to visit the Fisalia castle.

speaker: NPC #750088
