anh_en: Ugh… what was that…? My head… This pain's getting worse. I need a break somewhere…

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: You've been under this influence far too long, especially in a place filled with spirits. I should have warned you sooner.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: You need a proper rest… and we're not far from Thessaleo Fells.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Come to my castle. I have potions there that can help ease the strain.

As the music box plays, the red hat doll materializes and dances, only to abruptly stop. You realize it was all an illusion, but the music reminds you of Porto-Veno Castle. A fleeting shadow crosses Cantarella's usually calm face.\n\nA sharp headache interrupts your thoughts, the distorted frequencies intensifying. You seize the moment and ask Cantarella if you can rest at her castle, and she agrees.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ah... Excuse me for a moment. It's time I tend to the flowers.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The potion eases your headache, bringing clarity to your mind. \nWith renewed focus, you try to explore the castle for more clues.

Cantarella lets you rest in her garden and brings you a potion to ease your nerves. You feel much better after drinking it.\n\nCantarella then leaves to attend to other business, giving you a chance to search around.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hope this can help you feel better.
Thank you. What's this?
Smells good. What's this?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: This potion is crafted from freshly crushed Barnacle Leaves, mixed with the sap of Violaca, Sea Okra, and Sea Apple, all fermented in a glass vial.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Each of these lovely plants is cultivated here, hand-picked, sorted, and blended by my own hands.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: As the poisonous ingredients entwine, their toxins soften over time, like nightmares transforming into the sweetest dreams.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Don't worry, it's perfectly safe and even delightful. Drink up, and rest a while.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Though I may not be able to lift the "curse" binding you just yet, I can certainly help tame it for now.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You find a young girl hiding behind a plant, peering at you with wide, timid eyes.
You spot a girl wearing a red round hat among the bushes. She tries to say something but can't speak, instead gesturing for you to follow her.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Her round red hat draws your attention, a striking resemblance to the one worn by the dancing doll in the music box.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Sensing that her presence here is no coincidence, you brace yourself to ask her some bold questions.
Excuse me. Who are you?
What are you doing here?
Are you one of the "ghost girls"?
Do you know where Cantarella is?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl attempts to speak, but all that escapes is unintelligible mumbling.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl nods decisively before running off to another area.
Are you playing hide-and-seek with me?
Are you trying to show me this plant?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl shakes her head and then points at a crimson plant nearby. Its shape resembles an apple, yet it seems more like a peculiar marine creature.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl nods. The crimson plant resembles an apple, yet it seems more like a peculiar marine creature.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Apple... apple in the sea... Sea Apple!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Sea Apples are known to be poisonous. This clue must be key to solving the riddle of the Red Apple. \nBefore you can ask the girl anything more, she has already run to another spot.

The girl points at a crimson plant nearby. Its shape resembles an apple, yet it seems more like a peculiar marine creature.

You realize it's a poisonous Sea Apple, which may be the key to solving the riddle of the Red Apple.

Before you can question the girl, she runs to another part of the garden.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl nods. The plant resembles an apple, yet it seems more like a peculiar marine creature.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Jellyrose... Round hat...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Could the round hat worn by the girl in the riddle actually be a poisonous Jellyrose Medusa?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: If that's true, then the "ghost girls" indeed have a connection to the Fisalias.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I need to discuss this with Cantarella.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl nods decisively before running off to another area.

The girl points to a jellyfish-like plant, its crimson bloom resembling her own round hat.

Could the round hat from the riddle be a poisonous Jellyrose Medusa? If so, the "ghost girls" are tied to the Fisalias. You need to speak with Cantarella about this.

The girl seems to understand and runs off, gesturing for you to follow.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You find Cantarella finishing a dance under the moonlight. Her graceful movements seem meant to regulate certain frequencies.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What exactly are the Sea Apples and the Jellyroses in the garden used for?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The crimson Sea Apple, also called "the alluring reaper," is a dangerous plant. A single bite can lead to paralysis, suffocation, or the excruciating pain of a burnt throat and torn organs—ultimately bringing its victim an agonizing death.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: As for the Jellyroses, their blooms will transform into Jellyrose Medusae. These little ones can produce a neurotoxin that induces intense hallucinations, and in extreme cases, causes the body to seize and twist in a violent, uncontrollable dance of death.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The two lethal plants have been meticulously nurtured by generations of the Fisalia family, flourishing within the gardens of Porto-Veno Castle for centuries.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So my guess was correct. The "Red Apple" in the second riddle refers to the Sea Apple, and the "Round Hat" in the last riddle points to the Jellyrose Medusa.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: As for the first riddle, "Siren's Song," the "crown atop the mountain" and the "waterfall that cascaded into the depths below" clearly points here—a crown-like castle that sits atop a jagged cliff, with a waterfall rushing down.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It seems the girls in the riddle were lured into the Porto-Veno Castle.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The strange frequencies coming from the music box probably reflect the suffering of the "ghost girls," who were poisoned and tortured in the castle.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But why? Why would the Fisalia family do this?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I don't believe you'd engage in such senseless cruelty or take pleasure in others' suffering.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ah, you've made it here. I'm glad to see you're feeling better. Now we can finally have a proper conversation.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: There should be a reason behind this… Wait, there's one Fisalia tradition that might explain it. The Divine Trials.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It's a ritual to select a maiden of extraordinary willpower, a Fisalia who can withstand the Threnodian's whispers. I assume such extreme methods were needed for the trials.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Well… I never imagined you'd solve the mystery so quickly. You never cease to amaze me.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The truth behind the "ghost girl" riddle is none other than the grim secret of the Divine Trials.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The blood and tears shed in these trials throughout the years have seeped into this castle and concocted what we now call <ano=Sonoro Sphere>the Sea of Ghosts</ano>.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: There, past and future intertwine, and Fisalia's ancient secrets cling to the cracks of time like grotesque scabs.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: With you by my side, I would relive that trauma, and unfold the layers of forsaken time for a closer look.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: And if… you find these scabs have somehow crept unto my very flesh and feel the need to cut them away, I'll place my full trust in you and leave it in your hands.
Why do you trust me so much?
Can I trust you?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Did you come all this way for me, or are you in search of the secrets slumbering in the deep?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ever since I guided you to the sanctuary… you've seen through me and all that the Fisalia family conceals.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I've witnessed you cleanse the chaos of the Inverted Tower, restoring order to the heavens and seas. If you are the one to pass final judgment on me… it would be the highest honor.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Absolutely. Remember my promise? Whether it's elixir or poison, I'm ready to explore it with you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I, Cantarella Fisalia, value every promise I made to you and vow to see them through.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Now, the answers we seek lie in the depths of fierce undercurrents… Will you join me and dive into the deep sea?
Sure. I'm good at swimming.
Of course. I've seen it all.
Yes. We must free those ghosts.
Yes. I have to remove the influence on me.
I come for you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Then let's dive in together.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: You're like a pearl from the deepest sea, but… I'd never let such a flawless gem endure even the smallest scratch.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I knew you'd say that.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Your wisdom, courage, and kindness… no matter how deep the waters, always shine through.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Mmm, the strange frequency you carry is indeed from the Sea of Ghosts.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: That message with the distorted frequency is no doubt a creation of this Sonoro.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I don't know why it reached you, but the answer is hidden within. After we uncover the truth, its influence on you will fade.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Once we enter the sea, I'll be right by your side, tightly. No poisonous creature shall harm you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: For you are the one I've chosen.
I come for the secrets.
I think I'm ready to go now.
I need some time to get ready.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Excellent. Together we dive into the Sea of Ghosts.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Of course. It's wise to ready yourself before diving into such perilous depths.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I'll be waiting for you in the garden, whenever you're ready.

You follow the girl to the corner and find Cantarella dancing, her steps seemingly regulating certain frequencies. 

You share your thoughts with her, and she admits that the "ghost girl" refers to the cruel Divine Trials of the Fisalia family. The blood and tears from these trials have twisted Porto-Veno Castle into the <ano=Sonoro Sphere>the Sea of Ghosts</ano>.

To uncover the truth and lift the "curse" binding you, you must dive into this Sea of Ghosts.
Both.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Oh, I'm flattered… Don't worry, with someone as precious as you here in my castle, I'm not going anywhere.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hehe, clever little fish… Have you figured it out? The answer has been right here, waiting to be discovered.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hehe, such greed… Rest assured, I'm here to unravel the secrets with you, as I promised.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: So, prepared to set out?
I'm ready.
I need a moment.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Excellent. Together we dive into the Sea of Ghosts.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Take your time. I don't mind lingering here a little longer with my beloved Violacas.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Is this still Porto-Veno Castle? Something feels… off.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Yes and no. The past has spilled into the present here.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The overflowing frequencies have enveloped the entire castle, forming this Sonoro, the Sea of Ghosts.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The voices of the ghosts rise faintly from the depths, like the soft pop of a bursting bubble. Listen closely to these whispers of the past.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Piece together these fragile clues, and the answers will emerge on their own.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: But do take caution. One wrong step in these murky depths, and we may be drawn into an endless abyss…

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: With a bit of light, though, we can hold back the darkness.

You and Cantarella enter Porto-Veno Castle, which now looks a bit different.

Cantarella explains that the twisted frequencies have overwhelmed this place, displaying a mixture of past and future.

She manages to keep the last ray of light in this dark abyss and stores it in the lamp.

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: Bells chime, spirits awake. Mask up for the ghost parade! Welcome, dear guest. Are you here for the Night of Remembrance?
(Take out the mask.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Like this one?

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: This is… the mask of the Laureate! What an honor to meet the new Laureate in person! Yes, this one will do perfectly!

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: The Laureate enjoys the same privileges as the host of this festival, so please, enjoy yourself tonight!

The guide briefs you on what the Night of Remembrance is. It's an annual festival in Egla Town, dedicated to honoring those who have passed. People dress up like ghosts at night for various activities.\n\nThe guide tells you to wear a mask for the event, and you show him the mask of the Laureate, which works perfectly.
What is the Night of Remembrance?
Yes.

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: It's the only night in a year when the lost souls return to the mortal realm! Wear your mask and blend into this special gathering. You never know who or "what" might be hiding behind the mask…

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: Well, well, that's a plain reaction. Can't scare you, huh? Alright, let me explain it properly.

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: The Night of Remembrance is an annual festival in Egla Town, dedicated to honoring those who have passed. When night falls, people dress up like ghosts and join in a variety of activities.

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: And… Er… Oh dear, can't quite remember the rest.

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: Ahem! Anyway, to satisfy your curiosity, why not see for yourself? All you need is a mask.

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: Fabulous! All you need is a mask.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Though the black of the sea is overwhelming, I've managed to preserve the last ray of light.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: You see, light is something that darkness can never fully devour.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: As long as it flickers, it can guide us out.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I, Cantarella Fisalia, hereby grant {PlayerName} unrestricted passage through Porto-Veno Castle.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Let us explore and weave through the past and future together.
Cantarella gives you the lamp of light and grants full access to the castle.\n\nWith this lamp, you are now able to switch between the past and the future.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: We are now in a fragment of the "past"… You've done well.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The past that emerges from the Sea of Ghosts is not entirely real.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It only reveals what it chooses to show, which means we must uncover the hidden truth ourselves.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Spirits bound in the cracks of time, wander no more.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Please, set them free with the light.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: They've been trapped here for far too long.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A few written lines appeared on the surface, seemingly the last message left before the frequencies dispersed.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (A potion that can grant any wish… Sounds familiar.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The girls must have been lured here by such impossible promises.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Cantarella, since you were part of the trials yourself, why not just tell me the secret?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: There, there… We're surrounded by twisted frequencies. It seems they're guiding us towards the truth of the Divine Trials, and that truth holds the key to solving the "ghost girl" mystery.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: During the trials, the ever-present abyss silently watched over us… I can feel the Sonoro Sphere has recreated that same ominous gaze.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: If I were to reveal everything about the past all at once, this Sonoro could grow unstable or even collapse, drowning us in its wake.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: To keep us safe, we must tread carefully and avoid taking reckless actions.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: So let's listen carefully to what the sea is trying to tell us.

You find an announcement of the previous Divine Trials.

The first trial requires the participants to select the three most toxic Sea Apples from the depths and bring them back by any means necessary.

It seems the twisted frequencies want you to experience the trials yourselves to uncover the mystery of the "ghost girl."

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It seems this little lamp has something to say. You may go ahead and touch it.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: See how it glows? It's time to use its power.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Perhaps we need to switch to the right time.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The dark sea is where treasures often hide.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It's like how precious memories drift in the cracks of time.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: You may use your lamp to locate them.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: A pearl that shimmers but is out of reach is not necessarily an illusion.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Let the lamp work its magic… for light can travel through time.

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: Would you like to proceed, honored Laureate?
Yes, please.
I need a moment.

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: Perfect! Please, follow me.

speaker: NPC #150019
anh_en: Of course. Please take your time. I'm here to assist whenever you need me.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: In the depths of darkness, forgotten treasures await.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Light holds the power to reveal their resting place.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Be careful.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: They've lingered here too long, tormented by agony and anger.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: We will set you free.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Off you go, trapped little fish.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Born of water, returned to water.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It's getting turbulent.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The fluctuations you create can bring a brief calm to these restless frequencies.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: In other words, when you swiftly dodge their attacks or block with your weapon, the ghosts lurking in the cracks will be momentarily exposed before you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: This book looks familiar.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Just put it back on the right shelf, like how you did before.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Well done. You never disappoint me.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: They say most questions can be answered in books, but can they really?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Cantarella? What's she doing here?)
In the bustling event, you spot Cantarella in the crowd. She smiles at you from a distance and signals you to follow her.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The Divine Trials stand as a hallowed tradition of the Fisalia family, a ritual that demands every family member to offer their daughters to face the ordeal.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Yet tales of these perils have driven some to seek out young girls resembling their own and use them as substitutes.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: These girls' parents are often offered a generous sum of money or sweet promises as compensation.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Behind this intricate web stands the late head of Fisalia. To him, the Fisalia daughters who had been replaced were nothing more than "useless stones."

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The substitutes, however, he considered "rough gems" that could be polished into dazzling jewels through suffering.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: For him, regardless of blood, the Maiden must be a Fisalia. To this end, no sacrifice was too great.

You find the first Sea Apple along with a note written by a worried girl, Chloe.\n\nThe Divine Trials are a hallowed Fisalia tradition, but the danger surrounding them has led some family members to seek out commoners who resemble their daughters, using them as substitutes.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: There are many footprints of varying sizes in the hall, all seem to belong to women, but only one is clear enough. Cantarella's footprints are among them.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: To avoid the watchful eyes, the girls formed secret pacts in whispers.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hum a special tune, "use the right color," "knock on the door three times every two seconds"…

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: In the cold, unfathomable sea, they clung to each other, seeking warmth and comfort.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The little fish huddled close, unaware of who might vanish, or what tomorrow would bring.

You find the second Sea Apple and another note from Chloe that records why and how she participated in the trials.\n\nTo avoid the watchful eyes, the girls formed secret pacts in whispers, such as "hum a special tune," "use the right color," "knock on the door three times every two seconds"…

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The Fisalia family is built on poison, and from a young age, every Fisalia child is introduced to it.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Years of exposure gradually built up our resistance. At first, we suffered, but over time, few poisons could harm us.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: We are no longer merely the bearers of poison. We become the poison itself.

You find the third Sea Apple and another note from Chloe that reveals her change in mindset during the trials.

The Fisalia family is built on poison, and from a young age, every Fisalia child is introduced to it and learns to build up resistance.

The Fisalia bloodlines can develop poison-related abilities when exposed to poisons and pushed to the brink, but commoners rarely survive. However, a commoner girl named Annis also seemed to have awakened such an ability, though her throat was damaged by poison, leaving her forever voiceless.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Stillness, darkness, and silence. "Fail," and you'll be lost in darkness. "Pass," and you'll face an even greater darkness.\nBefore the merciless poison, there are no winners.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: So... painful...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Ergh...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Sweet dreams, girls. May you rest in peace.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The answer remains submerged, yet from the ripples of the past, a familiar door rises.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Maybe try knocking three times, as the girls once did. Knock, knock, knock...
A familiar door appears in front of you. Just knock on it three times as those girls used to do. Maybe something unexpected will happen.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hmm… It seems safe here. We can catch our breath amid the surging undercurrents.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Even in the depths of the sea, there would be a place for resting, like the eye of a storm.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Perhaps we should take a moment to explore this room. It seems like an ideal setting to gather our thoughts or simply rest.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Young girls are always brimming with dreams.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Though their bodies are caged, their hearts take flight, winging freely through realms of imagination.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: They recorded these ideas on paper, each word melting into a sweet candy to soothe their sorrows.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I still remember there was a bookshelf that kept many such pure, sweet fantasies.

You find a fairytale sketchbook that seems to be made by the girls.\nThough their bodies were caged, their hearts took flight, winging freely through realms of imagination.\nThey recorded these ideas on paper, each word melting into a sweet candy to soothe their sorrows.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Though time has yellowed these pages, the girls' laughter and joy still dance vividly across each line.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: But it remains trapped on paper, lost to time.
You find notes in the sketchbook.\nThough time has yellowed the pages, the girls' laughter and joy still dance vividly across each line.\nBut it remains trapped on paper, lost to time.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: What a pleasure to meet you again, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Still, it'd be best if they didn't stir up trouble for the living.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: In my humble opinion, lost souls find peace only when their wishes are fulfilled. Then, perhaps, they'll stop haunting people.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Since fate has brought you here, why not offer your aid to those poor, restless souls? I'll join you, of course.
I don't usually do ghost work.
Why would you offer to help me?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ah, the familiar confusion of a first-timer. But fret not, for I will be your guide through this unforgettable night. Step by step.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Shhh, no need to jump to conclusions. Who knows, it might actually be you doing me a favor.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Every Night of Remembrance brings its own theme. And this year, it's the "Ghost Girl."

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Imagine this: an innocent girl lost in the dark sea, fear ripping her apart as her soul drifts away, while her body sinks ever deeper into the abyss. Despair consumes her, bit by bit, until she transforms into a monstrous phantom.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: So, what brings a distinguished Laureate to this ghostly place?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: A thrilling story, don't you agree? Like savoring a medium-rare lamb chop served with oysters. One tender slice, and the crimson juice spills, adding just the right flavor to the already exquisite dish.
I like exquisite things, too.
Not sure I love it.
You're making my skin crawl.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Huh… So we share similar tastes. How wonderful.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Oh, really? Then consider it a simple "appetizer" for tonight.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Oh, is it too much for an innocent lamb like yourself? Hehe, my apologies. I hope this doesn't dampen your spirits.

After reading the strange message you received, Cantarella explains that the Night of Remembrance is centered around ghost-related themes. Tonight's theme happens to be the "ghost girl."\n\nShe senses the effect on you and invites you to join the event, promising that you'll recover once you solve the riddles prepared for tonight.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Tired of heavenly views, are we? Hehe, are you here to savor the underworld's wonders and dance with its spirits?
What brings the head of Fisalia here?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Why not? What harm could there be in a ghost of the deep reveling among spirits?
So you're also a ghost of the deep.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Also? What are you implying?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You show the strange message to Cantarella.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: On the Night of Remembrance, it's only natural that the departed return to the mortal realm for their unfulfilled wishes.
These girls...
Chloe...
What exactly happened...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Every girl came from different backgrounds, each with their own unique personality yet the same determination.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Even as poison gnawed at their bodies, they never lost faith in a future where freedom might bloom.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Little Chloe… I hope she's found peace somewhere, where no pain can reach her anymore.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Forgive me that I can't tell you more while we remain trapped within the depths. Once we've explored the whole of this sea, the truth will rise to the surface.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: An aged diary rests before you, its pages filled with notes the girls once exchanged.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The cute symbols, paired with messy handwriting, pull you back to those memories of long lost past—ones too painful to dwell on.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Sea Apples' crimson hue is so vivid that it almost burns the eyes.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The jellyfish drift gracefully, their translucent forms gliding through the water. A Jellyrose Medusa sways its delicate tentacles, its rounded body resembling an elegant hat.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It gestures behind you, and as you turn, an unexpected door stands in the center of the room.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Before opening the door, have you ever imagined a scene where seawater rushes out, flooding everything before you…

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: But for now, I don't think that will happen. We haven't quite reached the deep waters yet.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Should we go now and see what the jellyfish are trying to say?
Let's go.
I'd like to stay here a bit longer.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Lovely. Don't forget to knock three times.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Take your time. This place feels like a gentle embrace, one that makes you reluctant to leave.
Behind the door is another world where the jellyfish await your arrival.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Darkness breeds the unknown, and the unknown gives birth to fear.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: In a place like this, the only anchor you can rely on is the faint light by your side.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Trust its guidance. It will clear a path through the shadows and quell your fears.
It looks like a study room, but as you look up at the ceiling, the sparkling waves there make you feel this whole place is underwater.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: But can the glimmers from these delicate drifters truly light up the entire sea?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: In this spacious room, it's just you and Cantarella. Her gaze lingers on you, dark and endless, like a bottomless abyss.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It seems like fate insists we move as one, side by side.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: In the realm of poison, none can rival the Jellyrose Medusa.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ah... a scent I know well. There's a Jellyrose Medusa, lying in wait just a little deeper.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: They tend to be wary when alone, their nerves quick to tingle at the slightest move.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: But worry not. I know what to do.

This is the second announcement of the Divine Trials.

In the second trial, participants should make a team of two, capture the most venomous jellyfish, and exchange their catch with their teammate. The one who survives the jellyfish's venom shall be declared the winner.

Since only you and Cantarella are in the castle, you decide to team up and find the Jellyrose Medusa.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The jellyfish drifts on the other side of the room, its movements slow and unhurried, as if the bookshelf's cover lends it courage.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ah, I know this bookshelf well.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Today, it seems ambitious. Hungry enough to devour two books at once.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: One titled Past, the other, Present.
The jellyfish is right on the other side of the room, but to remove the blocking bookshelf, you need to put two books on it.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Are we prisoners to the insatiable appetite for knowledge, or to the ever-expanding void?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Yet I trust your eyes. They'll see through the tricks hidden within.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Offer your soul, surrender your flesh. Give all you have, call the lost from their rest...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That sounds uncanny.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Oh, sorry. Forgive me if it unsettles you. It's an old folk song about the Night of Remembrance. They say its eerie melody has a strange frequency that can draw the attention of ravenous "demons."

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ah… I can feel it now. There it is—the first stall.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Cantarella steps forward with unwavering certainty, her movement ethereal, drifting like a ghost. At this moment, she seems capable of summoning demons herself. Without hesitation, you follow her lead.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Many books seem to have been leafed through, their pages adorned with sketches and annotations in diverse handwriting styles.\nJudging by the fresh ink, these touches were added not long ago.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: An empty shell... the remnants that Past has left behind.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Just one more to go—the shadow cast by Present.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: This one isn't picky. It's a mere accident born from the twists of time.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Offer it any book, and it may reward your courage.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Now, both Past and Present are ours.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Go ahead, knock upon the door where Future lies waiting.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ah, frightened away... our lethal yet delicate little friend.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Looks like we need to handle these two first.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A gentle glimmer lingers where the jellyfish once was, as though it is trying to tell you something.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hebenon... She was such a timid girl, like a frightened rabbit.

A note details the remorse of a Fisalia girl named Hebenon.\n\nAs the second daughter of Fisalia's senior line, she was gentle and reluctant to harm her own blood. Yet under the watchful eye of the abyss, the girls had no choice but to drink poison for fleeting moments of peace.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: She'd peek out from behind Mandragora, her little face half-hidden.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: She cried so often... I still remember the day she brought me tea laced with mercury. Her hands trembled so much, tears spilling into the cup as she tried to serve it.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Such a good girl, really. So, I couldn't bring myself to refuse her.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Had I not drunk it, the abyss closing in on us would have taken us both.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The tea itself... well, it was tolerable, certainly better than Sea Apple. Just a bit of burning, a touch of dizziness, and a pounding ache in the head.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Whether it was her tears that softened the poison, or my body's quiet resilience, I recovered quickly enough.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Only through suffering could the girls of the trials steal a fleeting moment of peace.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Forgive me. I shouldn't linger in memories. After all, it's the present and future that truly matter, wouldn't you say?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Look. There it is, just a step away.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Heh, it seems everyone desires the deadliest jellyfish.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Expired obsessions rarely know when to stop.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: All roads lead to our destination. Let's explore another way, shall we?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Will the lost souls truly return home?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's been nine years...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Sometimes, it feels like they actually return to us on the Night of Remembrance.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yes, but only on this special night...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: These walls can't withstand the erosion of water.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Let's return to the embrace of the underwater realm.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: But then, I woke up... There was no sunlit shore around, and I lay here, as ever, in this cold abyss.

A note describes the determination of a Fisalia girl named Mandragora.\n\nAs the first daughter of Fisalia's senior line, she was carved by the family laws and clung to every teaching of the head of our family faithfully. However, beneath her cold resolve, a hint of hesitation still lingered.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Mandragora, just like her name, was a bright yet lethal flower.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Oh, please don't misunderstand. "Lethal" is the highest praise for a Fisalia.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: She clung to every teaching of the head of our family, shaping herself so meticulously that her thoughts and her very self vanished, lost to the family's cold framework.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I saw the weight of what she gave for that trial, all for a cause that was barely worthy of her sacrifice.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: So, when she served me the scone dipped in the essence of Jellyrose, I didn't hesitate to swallow it all.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: She was much tougher than Hebenon, but still, behind her unwavering gaze, I caught a flicker of reluctance, a shadow of something almost tender.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: As for the poison, the sensation was... I felt like I was drowning in slow waves, my body twitching without control and my vision slipping into a soft blur...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: And somewhere, within that haze, I saw us transformed. Birds, perhaps, dancing on a sunlit shore, carefree and joyful.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Leave, restless obsessions.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: There's nothing left here that deserves your grasp.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Leave this boundless abyss.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Seems like this little one is ready for a "duel," trying to take your life with its venom. But I despise unnecessary fights... Hand it to me.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Come now. We've more to uncover.

You and Cantarella return with the most venomous jellyfish. Now, it's time to follow the trial's rule and feed each other the deadly poison.

While you know nothing of poisons, Cantarella, who is well-experienced in this field, extends her hand and volunteers to take the poison herself.

You hesitate, but she smiles and calls the jellyfish to her, explaining that she has long since become immune to all poisons.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Yes, just place it gently here.
No, I can't...
You've already endured this before.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Nothing fret about, dear. I've long since made my peace with poison.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: This jellyfish, a remnant of the past, can't harm me now.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: You have such a kind heart, {PlayerName}… Always ready to take on burdens, even while carrying your own.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: But some weights belong only to those who've already weathered their storms. So, let me bear this one.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: See? I'm fine.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Jellyfish have no voice. They simply drift in the tide, struggling to let their faint glow disperse the darkness.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Yet here it is, a small shimmer of light, escaping the grip of the past to reach us now.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ah, it seems a subtle shift has taken place... I can smell danger...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Let's look closely and see what new presence lingers here.
A subtle shift seems to have taken place in this familiar room.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The waves came crashing, eager to snuff out every spark they found.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Poison and whispers slithered in, seeking to clip every wing.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Sweet dreams were shelved away, locked tight… only to wither into silent, brittle tears.
A sketchbook scribbled with the lyrics of an eerie folk song.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You sense an ominous presence emanating from the bookshelf.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The next moment, it takes shape before you.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Look! It's the new Laureate!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: My oh my, but who's beside her? Looks like some kind of noble lady.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'd say she's no ordinary noble. Such grace and maturity… she's got to be from a prestigious family.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hmmm, the nearest land with a noble house is Thessaleo Fells, which belongs to… the Fisalias?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Just look at her dress! Such elegance! She's not even eclipsed by the Laureate. She must be someone of great importance.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've heard the Fisalias are super secretive. Never thought we could actually see one here.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I know, right? How lucky are we to meet them both tonight!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Wait a second… If people like them are showing up, could the rumor about the elixir actually be true?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Yeah, that makes perfect sense!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girls' despair seeps from the book's pages, winding around your heart.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You press the book shut, your chest tight, and draw a deep breath to steady yourself.
The messages jotted on the sketchbook are like soundless screams.\nYou can feel the despair of those girls from these words.
About Hebenon…

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Both she and Hebenon vanished during the trial, and no one knew their whereabouts.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: As if someone had quietly guided them out of sight, right under the head's nose.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Why? I stand perfectly well right before you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Tears wouldn't grant me mercy, and I never intended to blindly follow rules that were never meant to be kind.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I earned my place my own way. That's why I stand here now, able to share this with you.
And Mandragora…
Are you all right?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hebenon was fragile, an easy prey to the Threnodian's whispers.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: She was never suited to be the Maiden. Truthfully, being chosen would never be an honor.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: So, it was a good thing she wasn't chosen. Both she and Mandragora vanished during the trial, and no one knew their whereabouts.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: As if someone had quietly guided them out of sight, right under the head's nose.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ah, Mandragora. She was so… rigid, so willing to bend to the rules, even if they were impossible.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I wish she could have seen that in this world, there's more than rigid obedience. Many things are far more precious.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: An old diary, with exchanged notes between young girls.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The tiny, endearing symbols and untidy scrawls pull you into the memories of that harsh, unforgiving trial again.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Sea Apples flourish in wild clusters. Under the shimmering water, their red hues look almost freakingly bright.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Jellyrose Medusa drifts lazily nearby, its long tentacles weaving strands of both fortune and misfortune.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A doll wearing a red hat has appeared on the table out of nowhere, drawing your attention.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You recall someone saying it is a symbol of fortune.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As long as you follow the Divinity, luck will surely be on your side!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: But... is it really so?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You are lost in thought as a door silently appears behind you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: There's a weight to the air behind. A mixture of whispers from the deep, dried tears, and the stale, lingering scent of blood.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Behind this is the deep water zone.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Are you ready to face the relentless surges? The place ahead is beyond the reach of light, like the night sky devoid of stars, hungry to consume everything within.
Let's go.
I'd like to stay here a little longer.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: It will be dark and murky there. Please, stay close to me.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hmm, we do need to be well-prepared before diving into the depths... both in body and mind.
Behind the door is the deep water zone. Please be well-prepared beforehand.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The doll's lifeless face stares at you as a prickling unease crawls up your spine.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The doll hesitates for a moment, then lowers its head, remaining silent.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The doll stands still, responding to your generosity with silence.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The doll stands still, responding to your teasing with silence.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hm...
Are you okay?
You're affected by that jellyfish, aren't you?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: No, it's… merely some old memories resurfacing. Don't worry. I'm quite well.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: When I entered this place, I knew that certain memories would seek me out, even if I did not wish for them to.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Seems I'm not as resilient as I thought…

speaker: NPC #150025
anh_en: Final performance. Begins soon. Hat, unfit.
A strange doll blocks your way and asks you to find a suitable round hat for her.\n\nMeanwhile, Cantarella seems unwell but forces herself to stay collected for your sake.

speaker: NPC #150025
anh_en: Help me. Bring the Round Hat.
What final performance?
You're talking about Round Hat's final performance...
Alright then.
Okie. Dokie.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The doll remains still, offering no response.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Here, the past and future, dreams and reality, are intricately intertwined, inseparably bound.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The chaotic frequencies here might have trapped the light.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Let's try once more, gently. Patience and encouragement always help.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Blue and purple clothing inspired by the sea… Is she a Fisalia?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: They've allied with the Order to control the Common Terminals. Plus, they might have tricks up their sleeves we can't even imagine! We'd better watch ourselves!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Fisalia? Ancient nobility, known for their fondness for poison, power plays, and their ties to the Order. One of their own even made it to Primus, if I'm not mistaken.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Wait, how do you know all this?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Novels, of course! Mysteries brew imagination, you see.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I'm not a noble myself, but I can definitely read about them. Just think of it as a fun tidbit.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: But the Fisalias aren't just any nobles to gossip about… What if they poison us?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Relax! They can't know who we are with our masks on...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It doesn't matter if you're wearing a mask or not. With just a wave of their hand, they can unleash a deadly smog and finish us off!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Seriously? You're joking, right? Even those novels didn't mention anything like that!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hm... I'll take care of the one on the right side!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The puzzle here seems to require two people to crack.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Anything I can help with?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...The door opened! Be careful.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Thank you! But what on earth is this place?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I will handle this!

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Rover, you're here.
Gotta throw myself a challenge from time to time.
I'm not planning to go back on my own words.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: How reliable.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Then let's get going.
Wasn't expecting you to arrive before me.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Well... As the Wayfinder, I do know a couple shortcuts.
Where are we going?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: After dealing with those Artificers, I ruled out the other locations on my way to join you.
You meet Changli again and she shares that she has pinpointed the most likely location of the game record. Together, you prepare to search for it.
I trust you’ll guide me well, Miss Wayfinder.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The notes only provided a vague idea of where the game record is. I've determined the most likely location on my last visit.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: We’ll be heading there. See if we can find anything new.
You've been there before?
That’s surprisingly straightforward, especially coming from you.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: But one can only do so much alone. This is why I need your help.
Lucky for you, I'm very good at finding things.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: You seem curious about that ancient structure.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: It looks familiar... Like the abandoned Court of Savantae facility I saw, but bigger in scale.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I heard it first appeared along with our Sentinel. Later, the Court of Savantae based their Chronosorters on its design.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: We can see the whole of Hongzhen from here.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Smells like a whole bunch of messed up frequencies... It's so... familiar...
(How could there be any Tacet Discords in Mt. Firmament?)
(Is Abby sleep talking again?)

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: C’mon, after all we've been through, you still don't trust my sniffer? Be grateful, I'm giving you a warning!

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Rover? Did something happen?
Tacet Discords could be assaulting people over there.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It's in the same direction we’re going. Could it be...
Let's go take a look.
As you and Changli enjoy the view from the pavilion in Hongzhen, Abby senses the mixed frequencies of Tacet Discords and humans from a cave. Someone may be in danger...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I never noticed how beautiful it looked during my previous visits.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It's the same place as always. I suppose it's my state of mind that has changed.
How did it change?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I don't know. Maybe it's because... Your presence makes me feel at ease.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Wait... I smell Tacet Discords in that cave!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: No... There's more... Tacet Discords, humans, and...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Signs of climbing... Someone may have been here before us.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A compass buried in the ground. It resembles those commonly used by the Pioneer Association.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Multiple footprints with varying levels of depth. They suggest a person was hastily running away from something.

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: Get away... from me! Ugh... I can't hold up much longer...

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: Help, help! Oh, thank goodness...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Please stand back. We'll take it from here.

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: I-I can fight! Let me help!

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: T-Thanks for your help...
Take it easy. Everything's all right.
Relax. Your wounds look pretty bad.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: While we've solved the crisis in Mt. Firmament for the time being... Public access to the mountain is still restricted. Before entering the mountain, any explorer must submit a request and can only do so while accompanied by the Midnight Rangers.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Sir, could you please share your reasons for traveling here alone?

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: I, I heard about Mt. Firmament's legend... So I came to find its secret...

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: I've only been in the mountain for half a day, everything was going smoothly before those monsters pounced on me on my way back... *cough*...

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: I must get back... Fuling... She's still waiting for me...
He doesn't look like he's only been here for half a day...
He seems a bit off.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It seems he is still hiding something from us.
Are you all right?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: He needs to go back to Hongzhen for proper medical attention... Time is against us.
We’ll need to escort him down the mountain.
Something feels strange about this place.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Agreed.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The appearance of Tacet Discords is indeed unusual… We can ask him later when he's recovered a bit more.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Indeed. Tacet Discords appearing in such numbers on Mt. Firmament, of all places… This is unusual, to say the least.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: We can continue our conversation later, after getting him to safety.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: On that note, we still don't know his identity... Judging from this uniform, he might be affiliated with the Pioneer Association.
The Association has a presence in Hongzhen right now.
He mentioned someone waiting for him.

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: I... I'm okay. Wait, you... Are you THE Rover...?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Good point, Rover. Let's head back.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Some of those injuries are older than half a day...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Then perhaps that "someone" is in Hongzhen. Could be his friend or an acquaintance.
You take the adventurer in coma and return to Hongzhen with Changli

You rush to rescue an adventurer under attack by Tacet Discords. The adventurer, claiming to seek Mt. Firmament's secrets, faints. Changli suspects he is hiding something and plans to gather more information once you return to Hongzhen.
How do you know me?

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: You're that hero who fought against the Threnodian, and you also resolved the time crisis here with Madam Magistrate. Everyone's been talking about you...

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: And Lady Changli... I-I never thought I'd have the chance to see you in person...

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: ...Without your help, I would've been a goner for sure...

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: I can't die here. Not when I've got someone waiting for me...

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: I've finally, finally found it... After all this time... Ugh...

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: ...The Weiqi pieces were scattered, but the guru remained calm. "It's getting late," he said gently to the woodcutter. "Shouldn't you be heading down the mountain?"

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: ...Well! That's the whole point. The truth is stranger than fiction, my friend. Every detail in that story is based on real events.

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: Let me share with you the other legend of Mt. Firmament, for deep within its sacred peaks lies a powerful secret... the "Secret of Immortality"!

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: We all know that Mt. Firmament is the abode of the Sentinel, gathering spiritual energies from both heaven and earth for countless eons. Over time, even the mountain itself has taken on the form of our majestic Sentinel!

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: Living in the mountains for long stretches of time, surrounded by fresh air and drinking from nature's own bounty, can add years to one's life span!

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: It all starts with that game of Weiqi, one that the woodcutter stumbled upon. Too bad those secrets have been long forgotten...

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: Gather around now, people. You're in for the story of a lifetime...
…Changli?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Shh...

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: As he glanced at the sky, the woodcutter was shocked to see how much time had passed. "It couldn't have been more than two hours," he thought in disbelief. Feeling apologetic, he prepared to leave, worried that the guru would be annoyed with him.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: ...I'll see you there.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: *yawn* What's with the ruckus... Huh, what’s that in your hands?
Changli gave it to me a moment ago.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmm... "Behold Hongzhen in its entirety, next to a ring and hanging eaves. When eternal snow thaw into flowing streams, let us reconvene."

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Ooh... I see, I see...
Do you know what it means?
Ooh... So that's how it is...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I see I've got no clue at all!
So much for the anticipation!
Wow, I'm so shocked to hear that.

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: But when the woodcutter turned around, he nearly jumped out of his skin. The hermit guru, who had been playing Weiqi and drinking wine, was now gone. In his place lay a shattered Weiqi board and a heap of decaying bones.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I get the very last part, at least! She’s asking you out! Well that's a fancy way to write stuff...
...The first part reads like it's about the meeting spot.
According to the description, it's somewhere in Hongzhen.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: How did you manage to get all that hidden meaning?
I'm experienced. Dealt with Jinhsi's riddles already.
Thanks to my big brain.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: But the buildings in Hongzhen all look pretty much the same. Which one exactly was she talking about?
We can ask around to find out. I’ve done this before.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Makes sense. Lead the way!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: And now... this next sentence, "eternal snow thaw into streams"... What is that supposed to mean?

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: The woodcutter was so scared that he dropped his bamboo basket and ran down the mountain without even looking back.
Maybe it has something to do with local folklore.

In Hongzhen, an elderly storyteller shares the legend of a hidden Weiqi game on Mt. Firmament that is said to grant immortality. While listening, you notice Changli nearby. She hands you an accessory and a note before quietly leaving. The note hints at a secret meeting, and to decipher its meaning, you decide to ask around.

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: As he reached the mountain's base, he was hit with a stark realization. The quaint village he remembered had bloomed into a bustling town, with sturdy brick houses replacing the humble thatched cottages. And where his home once stood, only an empty wasteland remained.

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: He noticed a date on the calendar that he had never seen before. In shock, he grabbed a passerby and urgently asked, "Excuse me, can you tell me the current date and time?"

speaker: Người Già
anh_en: As he heard the answer, his legs went weak. Everything had changed—time had passed and his loved ones were gone. No one remembered him anymore.

speaker: NPC #1317
anh_en: So the woodcutter left Mt. Firmament, but how was he still alive and kicking? With a hundred year's worth of time inside him, shouldn't he...

speaker: NPC #1318
anh_en: Your story... It's a bit far-fetched, don't you think? I mean, if I wasn't from Hongzhen, I might have fallen for it.

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: I remember he went on sabbatical months ago, and he left with Fuling...
Fuling?

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Yes, Fuling, his girlfriend. I think they're visiting Hongzhen together. They're staying at the inn over there.

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Oh, Fuling asked us about his whereabouts not long ago. She seemed quite worried.

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Speaking of... Is he really okay? Perhaps we should get him to a hospital first...

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: No, I'm not going... Fuling... She's waiting for me...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Don't worry. We'll help you find Fuling.

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Woah...! G-Greetings, Lady Changli!

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: H-How may I help you today, Lady Changli? Oh and, hello {PlayerName}! The person on your back... Is he okay?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: We found him on Mt. Firmament. Do you know where his companions might be?

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Isn't this Wuli? What happened to him?
He was attacked by Tacet Discords.
He's still unconscious...

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: He's one of the Pioneer Association's explorers, but we don't see him around Jinzhou too often.

speaker: Young girl
anh_en: W-Wuli! I.. *cough*...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: You mean... that legend? It's real?

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: Fuling... Are you... Are you not happy?

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: No... I am... I'm so glad to hear it.

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: Haha... Yes...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: ...Wuli!
You carry an exhausted and unconscious Wuli to a doctor to treat his injuries.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}, Lady Changli. You saved his life...
I'm glad he's okay.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: May I please ask... what on earth happened? I've never seen Wuli like that...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Breathe. Take it easy.
Well...
... And then we found you.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: So... He said he only spent half a day in the mountains?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Was that not the case?

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: No... I've been... I've been waiting for almost a week.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: It's not unusual for Wuli to be out of touch for a few days when he goes on long trips. This time, however, seemed longer than usual. If it weren't for you two showing up, I would have asked the Midnight Rangers to help me search for him in the mountains.
What's his obsession with the mountains?

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Wuli, he... He did it for me.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: I used to work as a landscape painter. Wuli and I met through work, and we traveled to many places together.

speaker: Young girl
anh_en: *cough*... Thank you. I'm okay now. Who are you? ... And Wuli, is he...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: A few months ago, I got really sick. It affected my ability to walk, which got worse over time. We couldn't go on our adventures like we used to. Wuli stopped taking on work and traveled all over the world to find a cure for me.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Despite his efforts, we couldn't find any cures... Until two weeks ago, when he brought me to Hongzhen. Said he had a surprise for me.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: I thought it was just going to be a relaxing trip, but he disappeared for seven days. Now he's back, rambling about having found a way to stop my condition from progressing...
He was saying something about the "legend"...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Mt. Firmament's "Secret of Immortality", I presume?

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Yes... Wuli told me that he's researched and found an untouched paradise on Mt. Firmament. A place where time stands still. He said if I lived there, my condition would never worsen...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: ...It cannot fully cure me, but at least we can spend eternity together.
You must be Fuling?

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: At first, I thought it was just a myth... But then you brought up how he only spent half a day in the mountains...
He may have run into Temporal Disruptions.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Those were my thoughts as well, but Wuli seemed very certain.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Mt. Firmament used to have Temporal Disruptions caused by its tumultuous history. However, thanks to Magistrate Jinhsi and Rover, these disruptions have been dealt with. Or so we had hoped.
Looks like there might still be some of them.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: So there are still unaddressed Temporal Disruptions in the mountains. And unfortunately, Wuli has stumbled upon one, mistaking it for the legendary cure he was searching for.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: But little did he know, it would only put him in more danger.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Yes, I am... Can you please tell me what happened?

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: I see...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: ...So that's why there were rumors of Rangers being here to take care of the leftover Tacet Discords, and block off access to the mountain...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Then... if this Temporal Disruption you speak of is truly so dangerous...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: {PlayerName}, Lady Changli, please help us get rid of it. For the sake of everyone here.
But your friend...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: He truly thinks it's the only way to save you. He's willing to take a slim chance, just for you.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: *cough* I... I'm okay. I haven't talked this much in a long time.
I'll go get a doctor for you.
You need to rest.

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: Fuling...!

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: ...I'm just a little tired. I'll be fine after some rest.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Once Wuli wakes up, I'll explain everything to him.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: If you have any other ideas, just tell him.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: But if you keep it all to yourself... No one, even those closest to you, will know how you really feel.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: ...Yes. I understand.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: {PlayerName}, things are taking a turn. We should probably tell Lady Xinyi first.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Freezing my own time... I don't think I should do that. It's not my best option. I appreciate your concerns, but I'll be fine.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Dreams always come to an end. Eventually we have to wake up, and keep moving forward.
Indeed. Let's go.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Wuli... You're hurt?! I've been looking for you... You didn't pick up my calls...

At the hotel, you meet Fuling, the gravely ill girlfriend of the adventurer Wuli. He had gone into the mountains seeking a way to slow her condition but mistakenly believed that the Temporal Disruptions held the key to immortality. Accepting her fate, Fuling pleads with you to put a stop to the dangerous Disruptions.

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: Great news, Fuling! ...I found it! Finally!

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: I've found a way to slow down your illness. No more pain, my love... We can finally be together, forever!

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: What brings you here at this time of the day?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: {PlayerName}, you've been exploring the mountains lately, so I'm sure you have a good grasp on Mt. Firmament. But if there are any hidden disruptions we missed...
It must've appeared after Wuli entered the mountains.
Someone had kept it hidden.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Precisely. Yet... Why did it reappear at this point?
Maybe it has something to do with Wuli.
Maybe it needed a specific trigger.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Fuling's "legend" differs from the situation at Mt. Firmament we're familiar with. In that tale, mortals were spared the cost of losing years from their lives.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: He was utterly convinced of his discovery, and he somehow managed to run into Temporal Disruptions in half a day’s time. Also… when I questioned him, he evaded my inquiries.
Was he lying?
He was hiding something.
There's been a bit of an incident.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Lies that are most challenging to detect aren't usually outright falsehoods, rather they hide parts of the truth.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The explorer wanted to save his friend indeed, but he was also hiding something.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: ...I've become rather curious about the truth behind this "Temporal Disruption."
About Fuling's attitude towards all of this...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Did you notice something, {PlayerName}?
She accepted the reality a little too quickly.
Why did she want to get rid of the Temporal Disruption?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: For someone with a terminal illness, they should hold onto any chance of survival—no matter how slim... Is that what you think?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Maybe she's come to terms with her destiny, or maybe... she never planned on continuing to live like that forever.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Changli...
You explain the events that have transpired.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: ...Well, please pardon my baseless speculations.
About the anomalies in that area...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I knew you'd notice too.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The frequency disturbance here is weak. It's similar to past Temporal Disruptions at Mt. Firmament, but not exactly the same.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Master Xuanmiao's records show that this is where the game record last appeared. This is also where we found that explorer.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: ... As Changli mentioned, this anomaly may indeed have something to do with that legendary game record.
The complete Temporal Program indicated in that game record...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Exactly... If this were to be the case, then we are not the only ones searching for its whereabouts.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The explorer did not tell us about his source of information.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: But his knowledge of Mt. Firmament far exceeds that of a first-time visitor.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: I see. Strange appearances of Tacet Discords in the mountains, and undiscovered Temporal Disruptions...

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: You mean...
Something bigger is behind all of this.
We need more information. Let's not act rashly.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Got it. The Midnight Rangers will block all entrances to the mountain for now. And Changli, you still have the power to send in garrison troops as needed.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: We left Mt. Firmament in a hurry. I need to go back up the mountain and investigate further... I have some theories that could use confirmation.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: We're still unsure about the exact location and range of the Temporal Disruption. Regardless, its reappearance is a pressing issue that needs our attention.
I'm coming with you.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It may get dangerous.
I haven't fulfilled my promise yet.
Then having another person onboard makes it less dangerous.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: There are several questionable details according to {PlayerName}'s description.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Well then... Thank you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Thank you again for your help. You were supposed to be here for a relaxing time... but it seems another crisis has popped up.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Do take extra caution.

Through discussions with Xinyi, you begin to question Wuli's motives and his sources of information. You suspect that the Temporal Disruption might be part of a larger scheme and could be connected to the Weiqi record you are searching for.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: What do you make of Fuling's words from earlier, Rover?
About what happened to Wuli...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: He claimed to have spent only half a day in the mountains, but it's been seven days since he returned to Hongzhen... That does sound like some kind of Temporal Disruption, one that wasn't strong enough to affect Hongzhen.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: After Jinhsi's battle with the Sentinel, she ordered Midnight Rangers to patrol Hongzhen and inspect Mt. Firmament for any lingering Temporal Disruptions before reopening it to the public.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Now it has become quite clear what the two were thinking.
Would you make the same choice... If it had happened to you?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Hmm...? Why the sudden question?
It seems you don't care that much about your own death.
You seem to understand Fuling deeply.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Is that how you see me? Hmm... Perhaps for some, death is just a destination. There are more significant things to focus on.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I'm just making an educated guess from what we've collected. And honestly, Fuling isn't exactly good at keeping things to herself.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Let's stay focused on the issue. While the diary is cryptic, it still exposes the true intentions of whoever misled Wuli.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It's no coincidence. All the clues point to a correlation between the Temporal Disruption and the legends of the Weiqi game. Or maybe... someone's trying to make us connect the dots.
Wuli's diary mentioned the Sentinel.
So this is what she had on her mind...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Yes. Information on the actual powers of Jué... This isn't the kind of information an ordinary explorer can obtain.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I guess our "old friends" have still not given up.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: They went to great lengths just to lead us here. It would be rather rude of us to not respond in some way.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: According to the information in my master's notes, and Wuli's map...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: ...The place we're looking for should be just ahead.
Since the Fractsidus already know so much about the Sentinel...

While investigating Wuli's camp, you learn that Fuling has accepted her fate and doesn't want Wuli to sacrifice his future as an adventurer for her. Wuli's diary reveals ties to the Fractsidus, suggesting someone is trying to connect the Temporal Disruption to the Weiqi game.
Did you know about it all along?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I had my speculation.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Fuling has come to terms with her impending death. She doesn't buy into the legends of "immortality." Instead, she simply wants to make the most of the time she has left and fulfill her and Wuli's dreams together.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: If Wuli wants to reach that so-called "paradise," he'll be trapped inside forever. It also means he'll have to give up his entire future as an explorer.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: That is not what she wants for him.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Her ultimate desire is for her lover to embrace her inevitable passing, and to realize the joint aspirations they hold in her place.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: She hasn't given up, but rather clings to hope for their future, even if she won't be there to see it unfold.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Traces of excavation on the ground... Looks like someone was trying to dig a hole with their bare hands. Could it be Wuli?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: This is... a Weiqi board.
Could it have anything to do with the game record?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The abnormal time flow here is most likely caused by the Chronosorters. Perhaps there is a way to fix it.

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: Marvelous play, truly remarkable. Occupying both solid territory and influence. An extraordinary move.
That person looks like... me?
Is this why you brought me here?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Changli seems to be in deep thought and does not answer.

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: Never have I imagined I'd experience such a great game of Weiqi on Mt. Firmament. You may look young, my friend, but there's so much more to you than meets the eye.

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: Please, no need to be so modest. I can tell the difference between our skill levels.
A mirage of the past...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: ...This is my master's voice. The voice of the other person seems deliberately erased.
Master Xuanmiao?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Who do you think the other person looks like?
That person looks familiar.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: What can I help you with?
It sounded interesting.
It was a bit too exaggerated.
I wasn't mentioned in the story, so a thumbs down.
Haha... Maybe Grandpa Zou can learn a thing or two from you in terms of humor.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: Grandpa Zou's great-grandfather was a descendant of the first inhabitants of Hongzhen. He grew up hearing stories about Mt. Firmament. Recently he heard Madam Magistrate had resolved the crisis, so he decided to visit and learn more about his roots.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: People in town are curious about the outside world and how they are perceived. Grandpa Zou is happy to answer their questions and has unknowingly become popular among them. Before he knew it, everyone was coming to talk to him...
And it turned into a storytelling session...
He must be a fan of that storyteller in Jinzhou.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: It's funny to hear outsiders describe my hometown, Hongzhen, as mysterious. We're just a normal place with our own quirks...

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: Especially lately, with so many people from Jinzhou coming on some kind of expedition. They're obsessed with us, like we're some kind of ancient relics. Can you believe they actually asked if our Pavo Plums have magical powers?
(Ask about the riddle in Changli’s note.)

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: Time truly is a formidable force...
Really? So you're into stories and anecdotes too?
Looks like we have that in common.
You're such a great storyteller, like everyone else I met here.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: Oh please, I'm only repeating what I've heard from him. He's been on a roll with his stories lately. But let's not take them too seriously, they're just for entertainment.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: When snow thaw into streams? Ah, you’re not from around here, I bet? When we say that in Hongzhen, we mean the <ano=Time Period>Shichen</ano> of Wei. Early afternoon, the warmest hours of a day.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: Legend tells of a visitor who ventured here some centuries ago. Back then, local villagers were struggling with no firewood due to heavy snow. This visitor opened up a path with their Forte and diverted a hot spring to provide warmth and aid.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: People say it was once a stunning sight, with mist and ice flowing westward down the streams, as if many celestial beings were returning to the sea. Now the sight has unfortunately disappeared, but the saying sticks. We use it to describe time in local speech.
I see.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: Well, it's what Grandpa Zou tells everyone. I haven't seen it with my own eyes, but when it comes to stories like this one... They're usually made-up.
You don't believe in those stories?

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: Hmm... Not that I don't want to believe them, but... Oh, you were listening to one of his stories earlier too, right? What did you think?

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: It has been decades since we last met, but you, my friend, still look the same.

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: Turns out I had already met you all those years ago, my life saver… and you're older than me. I should have been more respectful back then.

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: So you remember our promise. I am overjoyed...

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: A new city is about to be established. Having accomplished so much, why do you choose to retire now?

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: ...I may have spoken out of turn. If you're not in a rush to depart Jinzhou, how about another round of Weiqi with me?

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: *cough*... Well played. Even after twenty years, I still have no chance of winning against you.

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: The result of this game will decide the fate of Jinzhou, and even the entire world.

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: The road ahead is long and treacherous... Our final game, let's make it...

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: Haha... I barely noticed how so much time has passed.

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: Every move in Weiqi is fluid and unpredictable. Even if we start with the same opening, the outcome can never be predetermined... We see this in our game, and it's true for all the lives out there.

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: My clan are a group of hermits. We view the world as a game of strategy, manipulating the ebb and flow behind the scenes...

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: But you, my friend, chose to enter the game yourself. It's a dangerous path with no end in sight. I want to help, but my time is running out. I won't be there when you finally succeed...

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: Please don't feel sad for me. If I die, it would be an honor to rest at the Sentinel's feet.

speaker: NPC #1333
