anh_en: When the time comes... the one who shall finish this game of Weiqi with you will not be me, but rather my apprentice.

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: Do my plans seem too risky to you?

speaker: NPC #1333
anh_en: No need for concern. With her intelligence and quick thinking, she'll surely be able to solve this puzzle.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: You've come this far and followed us here, yet you hesitate to reveal yourselves. Guess I'll have to take the lead and extend an invitation.

speaker: NPC #1323
anh_en: ...Don't assume you'll always be in control, Changli.
Enough talk.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Our friendly chat is over. It's time to say goodbye.
You encounter Xuanmiao, Changli's master, across time. When you touch the old Weiqi board, it glows in response, and you spot the Fractsidus Artificer following you.

speaker: NPC #1323
anh_en: Still not giving up yet, Changli?

speaker: NPC #1323
anh_en: We know more than just that unfinished game, we are well aware of the price you have paid... You're dangling at the end of your rope.

speaker: NPC #1323
anh_en: Your unwitting trail has led us straight to our target.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Oh? Is that so?

speaker: NPC #1323
anh_en: The Sonoro Sphere is open. Go!

speaker: NPC #1323
anh_en: Anyway... {PlayerName}, thank you for letting us into this Sonoro Sphere.

speaker: NPC #1323
anh_en: You are indeed very special, as the Excellency foretold.

A portal to the Sonoro Sphere opens, and the Fractsidus Artificer rushes through, convinced that the power of the Temporal Mandate lies within. After defeating his minions, you and Changli enter the Sonoro Sphere together.
Stop them!

speaker: NPC #1323
anh_en: Sorry, but you're not getting past me.

speaker: NPC #1323
anh_en: Jué's formidable time-bending abilities, at their peak... All trapped within this Sonoro Sphere, as I'm sure you are well aware.
It's only a legend.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Do you really want to chase after this legend when you don't even know if it's real?

speaker: NPC #1323
anh_en: So what? Wouldn't it be a sight to behold as this Sonoro Sphere consumes everything in its path, while the Temporal Disruptions bring death?
You're out of your mind...

speaker: Rover
anh_en: An unfamiliar space... No sign of the Fractsidus. Changli's also nowhere to be seen.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: I need to find her quick.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Why did you come here? No one but the Exiles are willing to stay here now.
You shouldn't be here.
Do you know... Changli?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Are you a bad person?
... I'm not, I'm looking for someone.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: ...That's what all bad people say.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Whatever you're looking for... There's nobody here but me and the Tacet Discords.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Changli... who's that?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I'm the only one here besides the Tacet Discords.
Why are you here alone?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Huff... Huff...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: ...When I'm here, no one's afraid of me, and I won't hurt anyone.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Anyway... You should hurry up and leave, it's not safe for you to be here.
(She doesn't seem lost in the Sonoro Sphere...)
(She looks just like Changli...)
(Whatever the case, I can't leave her here alone.)

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Why did you stop talking? Are you lost?
Yeah, I'm kind of lost.
Can you help me out of this place?
Are you okay?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I... I can take you somewhere safe. I know a shortcut that leads to a safer village.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Ugh...
(Reach out to her.)

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Thank you.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Mirages in a Sonoro Sphere shouldn't be able to hold a conversation like this. Are these... phantoms pulled from Changli's memory, generated by Retroact effect?)

Inside, you find a young girl surrounded by Tacet Discords. She uses flames to fend them off but injures herself in the process. She resembles Changli, raising suspicions about their connection. Concerned for her safety, you decide to venture deeper into the Sonoro with her.
You got burned. Let me help you.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I-I'm fine! It's my Forte... I'm used to it.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: You... Stay away from me, or you'll get burned.
Okay, I won't move. Relax.
You won't burn me. I'm very tough.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: This village was attacked by Tacet Discords. There's nothing left.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: We'll be safe once we get out of here.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Hmm... This place seems a bit different from what I remember.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: These are... The villagers, attacked by Tacet Discords...
They have already...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Why... There weren't any of them here before...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Don't worry. My Forte is strong! I will get rid of them and protect you,

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: You... Why did you...
Leave the fighting to me. You're injured.
I can't let you fight them alone.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: ...Okay.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Don't worry, I won't hold you back...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I'm not just any kid! I am strong, you know.
I know.

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: What do you want? I've done nothing wrong!
...It's not nice to badmouth people like this.
Not everyone values power and fame.

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: Then I guess you've also been fooled by her looks. That woman will stop at nothing to get what she wants, while you remain oblivious to her true intentions. And by the time you catch on, you'll already be caught in her trap.

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: Wait a minute, has she actually achieved anything substantial during her time in Jinzhou? Or did Madam Magistrate just fall for her clever words and let her slack off?
You're underestimating Jinhsi.
What makes you so sure?
Hmph... I say you're underestimating Changli's trickery.
I... I have my reasons to believe so!

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: I heard she tricked that VIP guest of Jinzhou into going to Mt. Firmament. Just think about how dangerous that place was!

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: She must have been afraid of {Male=him;Female=her} getting too close to Madam Magistrate and ruining her plans... What a sinister woman! Fortunately, that guest was a skilled fighter, and {Male=he;Female=she} managed to escape unharmed.
(Ask about the riddle in Changli's note.)

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: I hope you don't mind my frankness. Just giving some advice, 'cause you look pretty innocent and gullible... Not from Jinzhou judging by your outfit, right?
I am that VIP guest.
People call me Rover.

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: Oh shoot, I completely forgot about something I need to do. Sorry, gotta run...

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: Huh? Uh... You're just asking for directions...? Sorry, I'm not a local, can't help you there.

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: Wait, you... you were the one talking to Lady Changli earlier, weren't you?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The young man begins looking around warily, as if in fear of something terrible hidden in the shadows.

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: If I were you, I'd steer clear of her. She's a deceitful woman who enjoys toying with people's hearts. A cunning villain who will manipulate you without you even knowing it.
How so?

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: Haven't you heard? She left her government job to come here, to this small town. There's gotta be a reason behind it.

speaker: NPC #1320
anh_en: I heard she chose to quit her job, but I bet she messed up back in the capital and got demoted here as punishment.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: The village I lived in got destroyed by those scary monsters.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: They hid me in a safe basement... While everyone else died or ran away... No one except me made it out alive.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: When I came out... No one was there anymore.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Now, I must get to somewhere safe...
It's okay, you're not alone anymore.
Let's go find somewhere safe together.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Okay...!
The girl reveals her entire village was destroyed during a TD Outbreak. She only survived because some villagers hid her in a fireproof basement.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Ugh...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: T-That's because I don't know how to properly control it yet...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: The Resonator who taught me about my "Forte" said if I don't use it properly, I'll die young.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: They also said a lot of things I couldn't understand... Told me I shouldn't use it too often.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: But... if I don't use my Forte, I'd get eaten by the Tacet Discords, or killed by the bad people...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: What's the point of living a longer life if I can't even survive?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I want to live. I want to become a strong grown-up.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I want to have good control of my power, and protect the people who protected me in the past.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: And then... And then I'll make a peaceful and prosperous world for everyone.
Your hands...
A peaceful and prosperous world for everyone...
That's a respectable goal.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Yes. According to the village teacher, that means children will no longer be in danger from monsters. We'll all have enough to eat and stable lives.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: But I've still got lots to learn... so I'll need to find someone really strong, and learn from them.
You will find a great mentor.
And you'll become very strong yourself.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Thank you...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I want to become as strong as you are...
Sure, but promise me...
Promise me you'll take good care of yourself, okay?
Does it hurt?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I-I understand... I'll do my best.

She confides that despite the toll her abilities take on her life, she uses them frequently to survive. Her dream is to grow up and become someone strong enough to help others. To bring peace to this world, she must find a skilled mentor to guide her.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: It might look kind of scary, but actually... it doesn't hurt at all.
Are you sure?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Of course. I'm a Resonator too, you know. My Forte is a powerful one. I control fire.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Nothing's brighter and warmer than the fire... it can burn away the cold and drive away monsters.
But the fire could burn yourself too.
But you look very tired...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: What a strange place... It's supposed to look familiar, but there are so many things I've never seen before...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: This door...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: ... I don't know why, but I keep getting the feeling that I've been here before, it's so weird...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Let's look around... Maybe we'll find something.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Whoa...!

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I-I'm not hungry yet...
Did you find something?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I found some dry rations... They look well-kept, should be still edible!

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: It's a bit frozen... No worries, I can use my fire to heat it up.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Are you hungry? I haven't seen you take a single bite...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: You can have these.
Thank you. I'm not hungry.
What about you?
If you don't eat anything for too long, you won't be able to walk.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: There's a piece of paper... It has turned yellow.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: ...When the village was raided, I failed to protect anyone with all my efforts. Now all I'm left with are these old injuries and the rest of my meager life, and some food to spare for anyone who passes by.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: If I had arrived sooner...
It's not your fault.
It's a thing of the past now.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: ...Okay.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: What is this all about? I don't understand...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: This is...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (... A mirage of the past.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (This place... It looks familiar, too.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (These are my memories... recreated inside this Sonoro Sphere.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (As I stepped inside, both Rover and the Fractsidus vanished into thin air. The frequencies are constantly changing, and the flow of time is chaotic, just like it had been on Mt. Firmament...)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (A Sonoro Sphere affected by Temporal Disruption… Once someone enters, there's a risk of being stuck inside forever. And if my master had planned all of this...)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Did he do this to mislead, to separate, or perhaps...)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (I should be careful. Whatever the case... I must find {PlayerName} first.)
You and the girl encounter a mirage of Changli, while elsewhere, Changli sees multiple reflections of her past self. She ponders over it and resolves to find you at all costs.

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: I'm starving...

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: This thing... Umm, if I burn it a bit with my fire... I can eat it, I guess?

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: I-I didn't...

speaker: NPC #1325
anh_en: Don't try to play me, you little thief.

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: I found these all by myself...!

speaker: NPC #1325
anh_en: Ha! You think I'm buying this story? How the hell does a little homeless brat like you score all this food?

speaker: NPC #1325
anh_en: This is our turf. Better scurry off if you know what's good for you...

speaker: NPC #1325
anh_en: Why don't we... let her stay? See, she's a...

speaker: NPC #1325
anh_en: ...We've got plenty of mouths to feed already. Unless you're planning to have her eat from your plate?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Huff... Hah... I-I can do it...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: (Yes, back then, I didn't know how to control my flames. I could only brute force my way out it, and my body was always covered in burns...)

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Uhh... How did she disappear like that? Wait, are you that legendary Rover who saved Jinzhou?!
Really?

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Yeah! And she came all the way to Jinzhou to help out Magistrate Jinhsi for the sake of peace in Huanglong. She's been working tirelessly behind the scenes since then, fully dedicated to her task...

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: How could anyone not revere such a selfless act?

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: *sigh* I could've sworn I just saw her. Where did she go? I wish I could take one more look...
Are you sure you're just here for the travel guide?

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Ahaha...
The tallest building?

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Ahem... what can I do for you?
Yes.
I can't help but feel envious. I wish I could speak to her like you did, but she refuses to do interviews with the Pioneer Association. Plus, I doubt we have anything in common to talk about anyway.
(Ask about the riddle in Changli's note.)

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Well, you've come to the right person! I'm here to compile a new travel guide for Hongzhen!

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Next to a ring and hanging eaves... Oh! I know where that is. You'll need to stand on the tallest building in Hongzhen to see what you're looking for.

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: It's on the northeast side of the town, can't miss it. You'll see it once you get there.

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Say, that person earlier... that was Lady Changli, right?! I saw you talking to her!
Do you know her?

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Of course! Everyone in Jinzhou knows about Lady Changli, even though she rarely appears in public.

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: As Master Xuanmiao's disciple, she excels in the arts of politics and diplomacy. Her travels have taken her across the four seas, and as Secretary-General, she has commanded respect from all who cross her path!

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: Ma'am, are you okay? There's been a lot more Tacet Discords lately...

speaker: NPC #1326
anh_en: I'm fine, thank you for driving those monsters away... But honey, these cuts and bruises all over you, some new and some old. They never seem to fully heal...

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: I'm a Resonator. These wounds are nothing.

speaker: NPC #1326
anh_en: *sigh*... Oh honey. You shouldn't be trapped in this place like we are for the rest of your life.

speaker: NPC #1326
anh_en: You should go to the city. With a powerful Forte like yours, you'll surely find a wonderful future for yourself there.

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: But ma'am, what about you and the others...

speaker: NPC #1326
anh_en: You go out there and make something of yourself. Make us proud. And when you're ready, come back for us. What do you say, dear?

speaker: NPC #1326
anh_en: And these... Take these with you on your way there.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: (This place... This is where master once lived in seclusion.)

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: (The spaces are a jumbled mess inside this Sonoro Sphere...)

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: Please... Wait!

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: I think... I think it means people can take care of themselves and have a place to call home.

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: I... I'm a Resonator too! I have a strong Forte! Look!

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: Is this... Flame Manipulation?

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: My dear, you've come all this way. What do you need from me?

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: I-I am... You gave me some food before, I haven't thanked you yet...

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: You misunderstood my intentions. When I sought shelter in your hideout during the rain, I gave you rations as a small token of thanks. No need to be troubled by it, little one.

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: B-but, you told me... The path to safety lies in embracing fortuitous moments. I didn't understand what you meant by that...

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: Well now, I only said those words on a mere whim. Never expected you to remember them so clearly...

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: I've heard Master Xuanmiao is a wise hermit guru who helps people. Can you, maybe, take me as your apprentice? I've been searching for you for so long... Please, will you consider it?

speaker: NPC #1324
anh_en: I want to live, learn to control my power, and become stronger... Or I won't see a peaceful and prosperous world...

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: Do you know... What defines a peaceful and prosperous world?

speaker: NPC #1328
anh_en: Do you have to go, master?

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: When the time comes, you will know, and you will have my aid.

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: You need only use your wisdom to offer that person some necessary guidance.

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: {Male=He;Female=She} is the only one who can truly change this world. You must find {Male=him;Female=her} and help {Male=him;Female=her}.

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: This way, the world of prosperity you seek will soon be within reach.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: (I believe... I've found that person, master.)

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: (...This Weiqi board, and the Sonoro Sphere... They are both a puzzle and an answer.)

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: (The end of this Sonoro Sphere... Turns out it's exactly where {Male=he;Female=she} is.)

Changli recalls her master Xuanmiao's farewell before he passed away, during which he imparted wisdom on navigating life and instructed her to assist someone capable of truly changing the world. Seeing this memory, Changli now understands what must be done.

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: My time in this world is up, my child. I have my own destination to head to. I can only accompany you so far on this journey.

speaker: NPC #1328
anh_en: Are you going to a dangerous place alone? Why can't I go with you?

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: It's not your turn to go there yet, Changli. You are a very gifted child, and you will surely achieve greatness one day.

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: But the price you pay for forcefully employing your Forte can never be erased. Your lifespan is doomed to be much shorter than that of ordinary people.

speaker: NPC #1328
anh_en: ...Yes, I understand.

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: Remember what I have taught you. Ponder carefully, plan meticulously, and shield yourself wisely. For when you have grown into the person you aspire to become... Your impact on this world shall be great.

speaker: NPC #1328
anh_en: Changli will remember your teachings by heart, master.

speaker: NPC #1328
anh_en: But master... This person you want me to find... How should I find them?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I guess this is another riddle from my master...
Are you okay?
Maybe we've met in the future.
(Is this an effect of the Temporal Disruption, too?...)

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Hmm?
Is this... a missing part of the device?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: We might be able to open that door with it!

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: What will we find behind that door?
Maybe it's what you're looking for.
Maybe it's the exit.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Yeah... I hope so.

After solving the puzzle, Changli spots you and the girl's mirage from afar. Meanwhile, the girl recalls that she has been searching for something important. She feels an odd familiarity with you, despite never having met before. Suddenly, a missing part of the device needed to open the gate appears in her hand.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I... I'm fine...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I think I'm remembering something... but it's all just a blur, I can't make out any clear images...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I've been looking for something... for a long, long time...
What are you looking for?

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: I don't know... I just remember that it's very, very important, something that can change the world...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: But I'm starting to wonder why I'm even here... Everything looks so different from what I remember...

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: And... Why do you look so familiar? We've never met before...

speaker: NPC #1329
anh_en: A scheme be grander than naught. Vanquish malevolence in its nascent guise.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Sorry. I kept you waiting.

speaker: NPC #900014
anh_en: This place... It—

speaker: NPC #900015
anh_en: Run!!

speaker: NPC #900016
anh_en: I-It's a trap! They played us!

speaker: NPC #900013
anh_en: Master...?

speaker: NPC #1329
anh_en: Changli, you have done well.

speaker: NPC #1329
anh_en: Now that you have found the answers you seek... it is time to begin your journey.

speaker: NPC #1329
anh_en: From this moment on, the choices you make and the plans you lay out...

speaker: NPC #1329
anh_en: They will all lead to that future.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: ...Changli.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Don't worry...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: This game is almost over.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Can you feel it? It's warm... Doesn't hurt at all, see?

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: It's so beautiful...
(Tell Xinyi what happened.)

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Temporal Disruption hidden inside a Sonoro Sphere... It makes sense now why it stayed hidden for so long.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: I never thought the solution would be to burn down the entire Sonoro Sphere from the inside...

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: You went too far back there, Changli.
Changli, about your condition...
Yeah, that was a bit too risky.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I know my limits.

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: Rover, Lady Changli...
How are you feeling?

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Wuli, this is the miracle we've been waiting to see! It's hope reborn after destruction...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Wuli is fine now, thanks to his doctor's help. As for me... Well, at least I can still walk a bit.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: After all, it's been almost five days...
So it's already been five days...

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: I never properly thanked you for bringing me back to Hongzhen. I heard about the attack by the Fractsidus in the mountains. I... I'm so sorry...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: *chuckle* No need for that. I understand.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The Fractsidus had their eyes on the same thing as we did. They've been planning an ambush on us for a long time. Why would we blame it on you?

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: We will never forget how you saved us. You gave us the opportunity to witness such a breathtaking sight. Thanks to your help, this journey holds no regrets for me.

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: As for the truth behind the so-called Secret of Immortality... Fuling has told me everything.

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: I had a gut feeling it would turn out to be a disappointment, but I couldn't give up. And in the end, I lost sight of why I even started this journey...

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: ...But this isn't the first time this has happened. Let's just call it another adventure coming to an end.

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: Fuling...

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: I've talked about it with Fuling. From now on, I'll take her on more trips to see more new places together.

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: Until...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Until the day... when I can no longer hold a pen. I've already talked to the folks at the publishing house, and they're happy to let me continue painting for them.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: My eventual departure may be unavoidable, but I want to give it my all until the very end.
No matter what happens, please take care.
Even if...

speaker: Rover
anh_en: I know you have already looked past death, but remember... There are people who care about you. They want you to live on and be happy.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Yes, I understand. Sometimes, I wish...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: ...we could stay together a little longer, if only for a while...

speaker: NPC #1314
anh_en: Of course, Fuling, I... We've always been...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It's not time to be sad yet, is it?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I've compiled a list of renowned doctors in Huanglong. They're highly skilled and may offer assistance for your medical condition, which is challenging but not impossible to cure.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Lady Changli, I truly can't thank you enough...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: No need for thanks.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Hmm... If you're feeling generous and want to repay me, I hope to see Fuling's work in the next issue of "Artists of Huanglong".

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Everyone's been missing seeing their favorite landscape artist's work lately.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It's over.
Didn't know you were a magazine reader.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Are you surprised? Well, now I'm curious. What kind of a person do you see me as?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Now that the situation has been resolved, you should return to Hongzhen. You deserve some good rest.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: After going through so much, you must be exhausted, {PlayerName}.
What about you?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Me? Well, I think Lady Xinyi could use the extra help with dealing with the aftermath.
Are you sure you'll be okay?
Got it.
Well, It wouldn't hurt to have a little more faith in me, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Did you find what you were looking for?
Splendid.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: It's getting late. Maybe we should wait until we get back to discuss anything else.

You and Changli manage to escape the burning Sonoro and reunite with Xinyi, Wuli, and Fuling. The remaining members of the Fractsidus have been captured by the Midnight Rangers, and the Temporal Disruptions have ceased. Wuli and Fuling understand each other's true feelings and plan to explore more places together, continuing their pursuit of shared dreams. Changli asks you to rest while she assists Xinyi in wrapping up loose ends.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Thank you for your help. The Midnight Rangers have successfully apprehended all remaining Fractsidus members in the mountains, and the effects of the Temporal Disruption have now vanished.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: I lost all contact with you during this whole time. Did you run into any trouble?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hey. Why are the people here so divided about Changli?
It's nice. The place is bustling with life.
It's much more lively than before.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: The crisis at Mt. Firmament has been resolved, and the waterway between Jinzhou and Hongzhen is open once again. As a result, there has been an increase in visitors from Jinzhou, making the town more lively than before.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: With the chaos subsiding, our town and city are now reconnected, allowing residents to live and work in peace.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: We owe you a debt of gratitude, Rover, for your efforts in clearing the remaining effects of Temporal Disruptions in Mt. Firmament over the past few days.
Just doing my part.
Couldn't have done it without everyone.
That job was a beast. You better have my money ready.
*chuckle* Of course.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: We're all indebted to you, Hongzhen and its people alike. If there's anything you need, don't hesitate to ask.
She doesn't seem to have ill intents.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: I couldn't help but notice you've been asking around. Is there something you need assistance with?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Xinyi and Changli have a mutual trust as acquaintances. It should be fine to ask Xinyi instead...)
Well...
You tell Xinyi about your encounter with Changli and what the passersby said about her.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Hmm... I see. That sounds like something Changli would do.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Even though we're not that close, I know a bit about her personality. She wouldn't just hand over something that symbolizes her identity to anyone, especially when...
Especially what?

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: I think it would be better for her to tell you personally.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: The Magistrate's Counselor is shrouded in mystery, and her motives are often hard to decipher...

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: When she wants something done, it's never as straightforward as it seems, and few can grasp the true meaning behind her plans.
We'll have to figure it out ourselves.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: The rumors and controversies surrounding her never cease, but she seems unfazed.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: However... I believe one has to get involved personally to truly understand Changli's intentions, regardless of public opinion.
My plans exactly.
I'm very curious about her plans.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: About the riddle... it seems you have already figured it out by yourself.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: But remember, it's not just about the answer, but also what she wants you to understand.
Indeed.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: If there's anything else you need here in Hongzhen, please do not hesitate to let me know.
Thank you.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: *chuckle* Then... If you'll excuse me.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmm... You humans make everything so complicated.

The people you speak with have varying opinions on Changli, but you deduce the meeting location from their insights. You encounter Xinyi, who identifies the accessory as one of Changli's prized possessions, suggesting that understanding her intentions will require personal involvement.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Well, at least now we know what she wanted to say.
Let’s meet at the highest place in Hongzhen, in the early afternoon.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Now that’s much easier to understand. Why did she have to make it a whole riddle? *yawn*... I’m getting sleepy again.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Rover?

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Nice to see you again. How are you liking Hongzhen so far?

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: {PlayerName}, greetings.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Perhaps she's just taking some time to rest and recover... It must have taken a lot out of her to summon that much fire at once.
How is she doing?
...She's being too hard on herself.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Changli knew you’d be worried, and she wanted me to relay this message to you...

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Meet her at the pavilion on Mt. Firmament. She'll be waiting for you there.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: She also said... No more riddles this time.
Thank you.

Two days later, you visit Xinyi in the Meeting Room, learning that the Fractsidus was indeed seeking the Temporal Mandate referenced in the Weiqi game legend. However, their scheme was thwarted by you and Changli. The Fractsidus Overseer who had entered the Sonoro has vanished. As for Changli, she awaits you at the pavilion.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: We're almost done dealing with the aftermath of the previous incident. We're currently questioning the remaining Fractsidus members we caught at Mt. Firmament.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: They wanted to get their hands on the Temporal Program from the legend of the Weiqi game, with the intention of unleashing chaos in Mt. Firmament once again. But thanks to you and Changli, their plans were foiled.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Changli recounted to us that a Fractsidus Overseer had entered the Sonoro Sphere and was injured by her fire. They were lucky to escape, but have not been seen since.
They just don't know when to quit...

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: I've put together a thorough report for City Hall. We will strengthen our defenses to make sure this doesn't happen again.
What about Changli?
I haven't seen her these days.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: We parted two days ago on the coast, and then she returned to Jinzhou.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: How are you feeling, {PlayerName}? Well-rested, I hope.
Indeed.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Oh, is that so? I'm curious then.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Sure, ask away. I'm happy to answer them to the best of my ability.
About the game record and "Secret of Immortality"...
About the Sonoro Sphere...
About the little girl in that Sonoro Sphere...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: It all started a century ago, when my mentor, Master Xuanmiao, had a brief encounter with a certain peculiar visitor.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: During a TD Outbreak, my master was rescued by that individual. {Male=He;Female=She} exuded a unique energy and was always elusive. My master dug through ancient texts and unearthed {Male=his;Female=her} presence in long-forgotten history.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: After searching for several years, he finally met that person on Mt. Firmament again. They played a game of Weiqi together, and that was how the legendary game record came into being.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: At first, I thought my master meant the game record held actual information about the time crisis. But it was just a clue. The real key was finding you, the person behind it all.
I'm feeling great, but...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: And lastly, the Secret of Immortality... It's most likely just the woodcutter's own spin on the tale.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: My master and the mysterious "visitor" had set a trap with the Sonoro Sphere, using the Weiqi game as a guise. They hid it with the Court of Savantae's Chronosorters, and it would only activate once the time flow on Mt. Firmament was restored to its normal state.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Pure coincidence or the calculated workings of the Fractsidus, the explorer stumbled upon the Weiqi board, setting off its defense mechanisms.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The Sentinel was already damaged when it arrived here. My master had foreseen the disasters that would befall Mt. Firmament, so he created this mechanism as a precautionary measure.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The Sonoro Sphere would devour all who attempted to enter, unless they knew the solution to that puzzle.
The solution? You mean burning down everything?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Precisely.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The only way to escape was by burning the Sonoro Sphere without hurting anyone inside. It required masterful control of Forte. Thinking back, it was probably his ultimate test for me.
I'm more concerned about you.
It also thwarted the Fractsidus's plans.
Didn't know someone could plan so much ahead...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: That was his first goal with this Sonoro Sphere.
There is a second one?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Before leaving, Master entrusted me with a mission: To find that individual... The one who played Weiqi with him. The one who left behind that game record.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: After my master's passing, {Male=he;Female=she} would be the only one who could control the Sonoro Sphere. By now, you should know who {Male=he;Female=she} is.
Is it me?
I think it's me.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Yes.
But I don't even remember that Sonoro Sphere.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Aww. Can't you see I'm perfectly fine, sitting right in front of you?
I see that's why you seemed to know a lot about me.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: That's why you needed me as your Wayfinder.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: My master often mentioned you before his passing.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: And from the moment you arrived in Jinzhou, I had my suspicions about your true identity. Our journey to Mt. Firmament solidified my beliefs.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: And finally, the Weiqi board in that Sonoro Sphere sealed the truth for me.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Indeed... Those memories... They were all real.
I saw... a little girl in the Sonoro Sphere.
I assume that was a younger version of you?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Yes... That's all in the past, just a little homeless girl with no name.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I never thought we could make new memories in the Sonoro Sphere, where only the past repeats itself.
I'm still a little worried.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: A moment of companionship and protection meant everything to me.
But I wasn't really there for you. Not in the real past.
If there isn't a Secret to Immortality, what about you...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I can sense your unspoken question. Did I sacrifice my life when I burned down the Sonoro Sphere, like when I was a child?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: What I told you there was true. But I've grown and gained control over my powers. Using my Forte now won't harm me in any way. Of that you can rest assured.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Also... If you really are the legendary person who changed the course of history, then you are perhaps the closest to immortality aside from our Sentinel.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: We mortals come and go, our lives are full of meetings and goodbyes. Our time on this earth is fleeting compared to yours. So don't let it bother you.
I live in the moment, just like you do.
...That is not the same.
Is Mt. Firmament back to normal?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I see. Perhaps this is why... It's so hard to leave this beautiful world behind.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Then... Would you be willing to finish that game of Weiqi with me instead?
Of course.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Despite the Sentinel and Mt. Firmament being saved, the Fractsidus would not go down without a fight. They were convinced that the Temporal Mandate was hidden within the game of Weiqi, but little did they know, they had already fallen into a trap.
I see...

When you meet Changli at the pavilion, she reveals everything. You were the "golden-eyed visitor" who played Weiqi with Master Xuanmiao. Back then, you foresaw a disaster striking Mt. Firmament and left the Sonoro as a contingency plan. Changli admits that while she is not concerned about her lifespan, she feels a deep sadness at the thought of leaving behind the world's beauty. Now, she wishes to play that long-anticipated game of Weiqi with you.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Don't worry, {PlayerName}. We are only having a casual conversation today. Nothing taxing.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Besides, you only agreed to join me here for more questions, right?
That's not my only reason...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Every winter, my hometown buzzed as people left their mark in the fresh snow, hoping for dreams to come true when it melted.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Did you try it too, Changli?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: No, I only watched from afar... My Forte always melted the snow faster than I liked.

speaker: NPC #1331
anh_en: Isn't that Wuli? What happened to him?
Do you know him?

speaker: NPC #1331
anh_en: Not really... He showed up in town and started asking weird questions to all the older folks. They've been avoiding him ever since.

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: The Secret of Immortality... I've found it...

speaker: NPC #1331
anh_en: *sigh* He really went up the mountain, didn't he? Oh my... Quick, get him to a doctor!

speaker: NPC #1322
anh_en: No... I'm fine... Go find Fuling...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Sir, do you know where his companions might be?

speaker: NPC #1331
anh_en: I'm not sure. There are lots of other people in town who are dressed just like him. Why don't you try asking them?
We will. Thanks for the tips.

speaker: NPC #1332
anh_en: His companions? Hmm... Sorry, I just joined the Association not long ago. I don't really know them.

speaker: NPC #1332
anh_en: His gear though, these are last year's designs... Perhaps you should go ask Youning? She's been a member for quite some time. She might know him.

speaker: NPC #1332
anh_en: Youning's just up ahead.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The young orphan girl carried on

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: To ignite a brighter tomorrow

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: She wielded her wits to evade harm, treading on knives with care

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Alone, yet maturing through stumbles

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Later on, she became someone else's "teacher"

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: She taught the future leader this...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: To guide conscience, and secure prosperity for the people

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: To continue lost teachings of past sages, and establish peace for all

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I will be the torchbearer, for one person can't rid the world of chaos alone.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: —One day, a future of prosperity and lasting peace will arrive

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Everywhere she looked, tragedies rampant

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: As Lament engulfed the globe

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: A world torn by monsters, filled with homeless souls

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: With her own blood as fire, she drove away the cold

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: And her master said...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: In this tumultuous world, lives are fragile as mayflies

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: She couldn't exhaust herself to save those before her

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: But she must endure

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Uh... Was there something like this here before?

speaker: Rover
anh_en: These mechanisms... They need to be unlocked from both sides at once.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Okay. Let's each handle one side. I'll go over there.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: It's open!

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: ...Tacet Discords! Watch out!

anh_en: More Tacet Discords... I'll handle them.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: Okay...

anh_en: Is this... The key to that door?

anh_en: Yes... And those Tacet Discords just devoured the frequencies of the guard on door duty…

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Changli? What is it?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Nothing, {PlayerName}. I just thought... the snow is beautiful today.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Is that...

speaker: Rover
anh_en: The chaotic Temporal Disruptions are even clearer to see.

speaker: Bé Gái
anh_en: ...No! Don't come any closer!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: (A ring, she wrote... Should be this ring-shaped ancient structure, I guess?)

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Wow, it’s really huge now that we look at it.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Next, hanging eaves... If we look from here... Is it that pavilion?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: It does look quiet. Should be a nice place for meetings... *yawn* Ugh, getting 'eepy again…

speaker: Rover
anh_en: That must be the place, then.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: I’ll get going.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Grandpa Zou seems to be telling another story…

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: … With a wave of {Male=his;Female=her} hand, Mianloong Chamber bursted open! The Sentinel awoke from its deep slumber, breaking through the clouds with unstoppable force!

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: The Tacet Discords froze under its intimidating aura, unable to cause further harm.

speaker: NPC #900057
anh_en: As the dark clouds dispersed and light returned to Mt. Firmament, the people were safe once more.

speaker: NPC #1317
anh_en: This story you're telling today... It sounds a bit different from yesterday, doesn't it?

speaker: NPC #900079
anh_en: Hmm… so, which version is the real one?

speaker: NPC #900080
anh_en: Haha, who cares? Today's story sounds more entertaining than yesterday's. That's all I care about!

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: How should I break it to him…

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: I really don't want to be the one who stops him from pursuing his dreams, so I…
You should let him know what you just told me.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: I will… Thank you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Thank you, I will.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: By the way, Lady Changli... Did she...

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: ...Nothing. Please forget about it. Thank you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Oh, hi, Rover, what's up? Anything I can help you with?
He had been muttering your name in his coma...
Nothing. Please take care.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: I… I understand what you're trying to tell me.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: Wuli is an experienced adventurer, always wary of hidden dangers. He's highly cautious and never lets his communication get cut off.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: We have explored countless places together, even the most perilous ones. The world has been ravaged by the Lament, but amidst all the destruction, new life emerges, captivating us both.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: However, since I became unable to accompany him on his journeys, Wuli has given up chasing his dreams.

speaker: NPC #1315
anh_en: I don't want my absence to taint his joy. I refuse to be the one who holds him back from pursuing his passions.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Please inform us immediately if anything occurs. The Midnight Rangers are ready to aid you at any time.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Take care.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: Don't worry. Since Changli extended an invitation to you, she should be in good health now.

speaker: Tân Di
anh_en: On that note... I'm surprised our usually strategic Counselor made such a spontaneous decision.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: What else can I do for you?
About Grandpa Zou…
Thank you. I'm good.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: Grandpa Zou seems to have boundless energy, doesn't he? He arrived with an old, tattered book and told us he wanted to reconnect with his family. None of us knew him though.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: I gave him a tour around Hongzhen, and then we became quite close. As it turns out, we're actually related.

speaker: NPC #1319
anh_en: However... I'm still unsure about how to address him as a family member.... Regardless, it's a pleasant discovery to make.

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Sigh... Looks like I've lost track of her again. Fine, I'll go back to work...

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Hmm? Where did our photographer go this time?

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Oh my goodness! I can't believe I just had a conversation with Lady Changli! I'm so pumped up!

speaker: NPC #1321
anh_en: Alright! Time to get back to work! Let me see… The next location is…

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Thank you for fulfilling my wish, {PlayerName}.
About Changli's future plans…
You're welcome.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I am done with my work in Jinzhou. Now I should be able to stay in Hongzhen for a bit longer.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I've heard the springs here work wonders for relieving fatigue. Hmm… perhaps I'll indulge myself a little.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Hehe... If you have a moment to spare, I suggest staying here a bit longer.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Hongzhen is quite the pleasant place to relax.

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: I can teach you how to control your power. But in this world of ups and downs, relying solely on brute force will not get you far.

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: If you long for a peaceful and prosperous world, you must utilize your own intellect to choose, strategize, and shape the future you desire.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Those tokens from Jinhsi... It was your idea, was it not?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Sorry, {PlayerName}. Jinzhou faced multiple threats back then, and we had to be cautious. We did not intend to inconvenience you. I regret our lack of hospitality.
It's okay. Jinhsi had explained your reasons.
I'm more or less used to it by now...
It's a thing of the past.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: This time... *chuckle* I just wanted to see you. The brilliant mind that always understood my unspoken words.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: ...I am very grateful you decided to come.
What's the deal this time? Another Tacet Discord to beat?
What's the deal this time? Another errand to run?
Let's cut to the chase. What do you want from me?
Special?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Apologies for giving you that impression, Rover. That’s not how we treat our saviors.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Apologies for giving you that impression, Rover. That’s not how we treat our saviors.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I merely have a few questions, and I was wondering if you may have the answers.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Does this game of <ano=Go>Weiqi</ano> look familiar to you, Rover?
No.
...I'm not sure.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: ...I see.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: There is a local tale about the "Secret of Immortality" being hidden on Mt. Firmament. Have you heard about it?
The one I heard in Hongzhen?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Apologies for my delay.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Yes. I have a slightly different version of this tale to share.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Centuries ago, a Taoist cultivator met an enigmatic visitor on Mt. Firmament. Despite their age difference, they soon became friends and often played Weiqi together.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: One day, a woodcutter stumbled upon them, having lost his way home. Their game mesmerized him so much that he didn't notice the red tie on his basket rotting away… Panicked, he bumped into the Weiqi board.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Despite the interruption, the visitor remained unfazed. They offered the woodcutter some tea, then guided him down the mountain, shielding him from dangerous Temporal Disruptions. After that, the visitor disappeared.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Many years later, the Taoist cultivator became a legendary hermit guru. Upon returning to Mt. Firmament in his final years, he reunited with that elusive visitor.
You mean this game in front of us?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: But that's how old tales go, slowly losing their truth as they're passed down.
You mean the other folklores may hold some truth too.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Precisely.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The legend may be shrouded in myth, but that game of Weiqi was real. Embedded within its records lies a cryptic message: "This game record can solve the crisis of time."
It's fine. I just got here too.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: From what I know, only the Sentinel in its prime has the power to manipulate time through its possession of a complete Temporal Mandate. For us mere mortals, controlling time is indeed similar to gaining immortality.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: As the records state, it only reveals itself when Mt. Firmament emerges. But how it ties to the Temporal Mandate remains an enigma... at least for now.
The Sentinel's wounds...
There might be an undamaged sample of Temporal Mandate.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Yes. We may find a way to heal them.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: If that is the case, we’ll be able to heal the Sentinel's wounds.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: But... our chances are looking slim. That game record could just hold my teacher's memories, not any real value.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: So I am presenting this as merely a personal request.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I am planning to go find that record. Could you please join me?
Something tells me you've been here for a while.
Sure.
Why me?
I’ll consider it, but what's in it for me?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Thank you for lending me a hand. I promise it will be worth your while.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: As we have been to Mt. Firmament before, I imagined it would pique your interest, as the tale concerns our Sentinel.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: And, moreover... You are special to me, and… to Mt. Firmament. I hope I have provided enough reasons to clear your doubts.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: In addition… I promise to aid you in any way I can after we return with the record. How does that sound?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Very well. Let's meet on the gallery road outside Hongzhen.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I still have some preparations to do. Please go ahead, I'll join you later.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: ...Apologies. I heard about your memory loss. Please pardon me.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Thank you for accepting my invitation.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: The two resumed their unfinished game. People believe the visitor shared their Secret of Immortality through cleverly-placed Weiqi pieces, as a final parting gift.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Yes... and no. This game is missing the final twenty moves. It is unfinished.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: That was a bit different from what you heard before, I guess? The story changed over time, infused with fantasy in each retelling.
I am interested in this tale too.
I see. Then I have no reason to not go.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Splendid.
It's still early. How about we set off now?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: *chuckle*...So you've guessed it.
I see you really love your riddles.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Still, I owe you an apology in person.
I see. Then I suppose I have no reason to not go.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: I asked you about the unfinished Weiqi game, because I believe it may have something to do with your past.
You mean...

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Yes… After all, it takes two to play Weiqi, right?

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: If my speculation is correct… That game of Weiqi may hold clues to your lost memories.
Alright. Count me in!

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Thank you for accepting my invitation.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: You looked adorable, focusing on the Weiqi board. I didn't want to interrupt you.

At the pavilion mentioned in the note, you meet Changli. She shares the full story behind the "unfinished Weiqi game"—an enigmatic visitor once hid the Secret of Immortality in the last Weiqi game she played with her master. This game might be tied to the Temporal Mandate and your lost memory. Changli asks for your help in uncovering the truth.

speaker: Trường Ly
anh_en: Oh? And what makes you think so?

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: ...Come over, child.

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: You bear the powers of Flame Manipulation. A phoenix born from fire, one that shall bring peace to this world...

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: From this day on, your name will be <ano=Eternal Flames>Changli</ano>.

speaker: NPC #1327
anh_en: Such a fierceful power. If not used wisely, it may engulf you in return. Without proper guidance, you will eventually be reduced to ashes... Alas, perhaps this is fate.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Two days have passed since Changli told me that she and Xinyi would handle the aftermath. I wonder how she's doing...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Are you worried? Let's just go ask her then.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Might as well. Changli can be difficult to find. Let's go ask Xinyi first.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Beware. This is where many Wooly stories begin.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: When the story gets longer, so will the paths ahead. We might even come across broken bridges and stuff.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Since we'll only be telling the beginning of the story this time, we should get to the end pretty soon.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: There! A treasure chest! It's all yours!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Look at all these monsters. Let's beat 'em up!

speaker: NPC #1380
anh_en: Ohhh... You're finally here. Those terrible monsters. Baa...

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Perfect. Now that we have clues about the relics, Wooly Warrior's adventures are officially a go.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: All we need to do now is go through this door and we'll be back to the real world!

speaker: NPC #1380
anh_en: You're very welcome, dear! If you have any more questions, do come back anytime. Baa-Baa now!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Thank you, Fairy Cloudy.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: This is Cloudy Fairy. She gets scared pretty easily, but she's really nice and will give us directions.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: (She's even got all the settings prepared and everything...)

speaker: NPC #1380
anh_en: So you're searching for the Gateway of Wishes? Baa. All you need to do is follow this path and collect three relics. Baa...
Three relics?

speaker: NPC #1380
anh_en: Yes! The first relic is the Sword of Courage. To obtain it, you'll have to face all of your challenges head-on. Be careful...

speaker: NPC #1380
anh_en: Next, the Shield of Faith. This is a tricky one, but so long as you believe in yourself, you'll find it eventually after searching every nook and cranny.

speaker: NPC #1380
anh_en: And finally, the Wreath of Hope. A crown of flowers that can reflect a person's thoughts. Never withers, forever blossoming.

speaker: NPC #1380
anh_en: Once you've gathered all three relics, the Gateway of Wishes will open before you.

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: {PlayerName}, welcome back from the Wooly Kingdom!

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: Because Encore loves to play and adventure with you! It's just that everyone was so busy last time...

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: But, this time Encore's here on vacation! Curious about what happens next in the story, Rover?

speaker: An'ke
anh_en: If you are, you should join Encore's adventure team, that way we can go and find out its ending together!
Can I be the team captain?
Is this turning into a make-believe game...?

speaker: An'ke
