When you reach the cave, Bei Ji faces "The Savages" with resolve, determined to bring them to justice before you and Lingyang arrive to help.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Tợn
anh_en: Oh well, at least we'll get to claim your sorry corpse later...

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I-I'm not afraid of you!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I know all the dirty things you've done!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I-I've already sent out proof against you.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Even if you kill me... It won't change the truth!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: There are still brave people out there... They will stand up to you... I know they will...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I knew it! Bei Ji wasn't working with them.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: {PlayerName}, sorry I let you see this side of me.
Yes, she is safe now.
She's worried sick. Hasn't slept in seven days.
That's good to hear... Thank you.
What?! Oh, Bei Shi... I'm so sorry... I'm such an awful brother.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I didn't expect she would... I'm sorry.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Sorry I made you worry too.
About Bei Shi...

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Yeah, I guess you've already heard some of it from her...
Wow, that was scary.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Our parents were both members of the Pioneer Association. They were famous explorers, until we lost them to an accident.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: We've been struggling to survive since then. I did many part-time jobs to make ends meet, trying to take care of my sister.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: But Bei Shi... She said she wanted to join the Pioneer Association, and fulfill our parents' unfinished ambitions...

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: She's the last family I have. I was really scared I'd lose her, too.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I tried to ban her from joining the Pioneer Association, and we got into a huge fight. We haven't really talked to each other ever since...

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: But, to be honest... When she was accepted to join the Association, I was really happy for her.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Unlike me, she is brave, positive, and always willing to try new things. As her brother, I'm happy she'll get to see a bigger world.
I'll keep it a secret.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Looking back on it, I was holding her back from pursuing her dreams.
You had your reasons.
You should have respected her decision.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: ...Yes. I shouldn't have tried to make the decision for her.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: It's too dangerous here. Let's get out first.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Your sister's been worried about you.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Hiss... Grrr... You hurt my friend... You die!
Lingyang recounts every detail of the events to you.
Lingyang asks you to keep his beastly side a secret. After hearing about your efforts, Bei Ji opens up about his conflict with Bei Shi, sharing his true feelings.
Please keep it a secret between the two of us.
Thank you. That would be great.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I'm alive! Thank you for saving me!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Oh and sorry but, who are you?
Your sister sent us here.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: My sister... Bei Shi? She's been worried about me? Is she doing okay?
Your brother...
We are fine.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Bei Shi...

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: Bei Ji!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Bei Shi, I'm so sorry I made you worry...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Though seeing your reunion is truly touching...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I still gotta say, this isn't the right place for conversation. Let's head back to the city first.
Lingyang! Rover!

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Thận Trọng
anh_en: Why... Why did this happen?
With the Patrollers' help, you catch "The Savages" and the Bei siblings are finally reunited.

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Tợn
anh_en: When it rains, it pours...

speaker: Kẻ Lưu Đày Hung Tợn
anh_en: This is not what I had planned!
You did this to yourself.
You can't always get what you want.

speaker: Kim Tuần Úy Nghiêm Nghị
anh_en: Behave!

speaker: Kim Tuần Úy Chính Trực
anh_en: Thanks for the tip, young lady. We made it in time to catch them because of you.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: Lingyang! {PlayerName}! Are you alright?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: So, when you found out that Bei Shi lost her courage because of the Jingle Beast, you came up with a plan to get rid of it?
But in the end, I couldn't achieve anything...
Yes, you're right...

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I failed. Couldn't find the Jingle Beast, couldn't beat the bad guys. I only knew how to cower in fear... that's all I could do.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I'm just an incompetent coward. I've always been!

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: No... That's not true...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: At least, you didn't choose to work with those bad guys.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Succumbing to desire and killing their own kind, these are the deeds of beasts.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: It's a uniquely human trait to go against their natural instincts, even sacrificing themselves for someone else, or for a greater cause.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: It only takes a moment for a human to descend into beastliness.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Yeah... I thought I could kill the Jingle Beast, and make my sister happy again...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: But holding on to one's humanity requires unwavering commitment and courage.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Bei Ji, you've already proved your bravery.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I'm sure your sister is proud of you, too.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: R-really...?

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: Yes! I love you, brother. But promise me you won't do anything stupid again.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Okay, yes, I promise you... But, um, at least I did find something this time!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: We now know the so-called Jingle Beast is just a bluff!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: So, Bei Shi, you don't need to fear it anymore!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: And I heard rumors about an Exile group called "The Savages." Said they knew how to talk to that beast...

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: But I did hear the bell...

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Perhaps it was just your imagination? Or maybe it was some Tacet Discords?

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: No way! I heard it loud and clear. I couldn't have mistaken it.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Hmm... I guess we still need to help Bei Shi get over the Jingle Beast.
Why is she still so convinced?
Yeah, we should do something.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: {PlayerName}, Lingyang, we'll be going home now. Sorry for the trouble I caused.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: So I thought...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Sure, go get some good rest. Don't forget to come see the liondancing show tomorrow!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Eh? Tomorrow?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Don't tell me you've forgotten your liondance request?

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: No, no, I didn't...

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Sorry. Actually, I made that request to further investigate the Jingle Beast...

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: But now, I guess that's no longer necessary.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I see...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I know you've still got questions about the Jingle Beast. Who knows? You may find the answers in tomorrow's liondancing show...
Let's go cheer for Lingyang.
The liondancing show tomorrow is really important.
You wanted to find the Jingle Beast through them?

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I see. We'll come watch the show!
Yeah, please do come, okay?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I know you still have a lot of questions to ask...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: And there are things I'd like to discuss with you.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Please, follow me.
Bei Shi and Bei Ji wave goodbye before taking their leave.

You learn that Bei Ji had originally planned to kill the "Jingle Beast" to prove his courage and earn his sister's respect. Though he feels like he has failed, Lingyang reminds him that true bravery lies in overcoming one's weaknesses for those we care about. Bei Ji gains Bei Shi's understanding, but her fear of the "Jingle Beast" remains. To help her, Lingyang invites the siblings to watch the Liondance, believing it may help dispel Bei Shi's fear.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Yes... I wanted to prove my courage. Wanted to make her proud of me.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I just wanted to show her... If her timid brother could do it, so can she!
Your courage is commendable.
Being brave is not the same as being reckless.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Okay, let me think.. My first client's nearby. You might've seen them before.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Just cross the bridge, keep going, and we're there!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Phew, and now we're back.

speaker: A Kỳ
anh_en: Lingyang! You're finally here! Master's been looking for you!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Oh no! I completely forgot!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: {PlayerName}, could you look around backstage for a bit? See if you can find anything that might help Bei Shi overcome her fear...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I'll be right back!

speaker: A Kỳ
anh_en: Hurry up! Master's getting angry!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I'm coming! I'm coming!
Lingyang asks you to check backstage for props that might help Bei Shi form a new opinion about the "Jingle Beast."

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A handwritten pamphlet titled Lucky Greetings Collection. Signs of regular revisions can be noticed.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It records in details all the popular Lucky Greetings from Huanglong, including the ones often spoken by Lingyang.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Hey, {PlayerName}, I'm back!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Bei Shi got hit pretty hard during the attack, and she probably blanked out for a bit.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Then, perhaps her brain made up some fake memories about that creepy Jingle Beast in the rumors to fill in the gaps.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Bei Ji wanted to kill the Jingle Beast to help his sister. Indeed, getting rid of the thing she fears could work.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: But that won't solve the real issue.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Like we heard on our way here...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: The scary beast comes with many different names. We can defeat the Jingle Beast now, but another Twinkle Beast could appear later.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: It's not enough to just defeat that one Jingle Beast. One must have the courage to take on any beasts.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: That's why I want help Bei Shi overcome her fear with our liondance performance.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: As the liondance evolved, it picked up various new styles and elements, which hold unique significance to each person.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Our goal is to create a customized performance that truly benefits Bei Shi.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Okay, gotta go prep now! See you at tomorrow's liondance show!
Before the performance, Lingyang shares the origin and meaning of the Liondance, suggesting that it might help Bei Shi overcome her fear of the "Jingle Beast."

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: My Master is super strict before our performances. He wants us to give our all for the people of Jinzhou. Can't disappoint them!
Why are liondance shows such a big deal in Jinzhou?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Hmm... Let's begin with the history of this tradition.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Liondance shows started as a way to cheer up returning soldiers and boost their morale before battles.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: It evolved over time into a way to boost soldiers' spirits before battle, symbolizing courage and the hope for victory.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Later on, it transformed into the festive performance we see today, but it's still about keeping bad luck away, dispelling fear, and passing prosperity and protection to future generations.
What does this have to do with Bei Shi?

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Hi, {PlayerName}, there you are!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: It's been quite a while since I last saw a grand liondance show like this. I'm so excited about it.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: {PlayerName}, do you know what the secret is about the Jingle Beast Lingyang was talking about?
I have no idea.
Wait until you find out.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Oh, the show's beginning!

You meet with various clients before the performance. The Bei siblings are curious about the secret of the "Jingle Beast," while Grandpa Gan reminisces about the Liondance performances he enjoyed during his time in the army. Linling and Shengmao decide to give the "Settlement" ceremony another go, and everyone awaits the grand Liondance with excitement.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: I was once chased by a big creature in the wilderness. All I could hear was a bell ringing and my only thought was to run away.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: And, erm, please forgive me...

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: I am upset, because you never told me anything... You always carried the burden alone.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: Didn't even tell me you were gonna go kill the Jingle Beast... Don't you ever do something like that again!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: I promise, I promise. Let me treat you to something as my sincere apology.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I know a nice food stall, it's right up ahead in the square. You should check it out.

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Awesome! Bei Shi, let's go!

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: Then I heard about the Jingle Beast, so I figured it must have been what attacked me.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: {PlayerName}, how was my performance? Did you like it?
It was great.
Yeah, not bad.
Hehe, getting your compliment is all that matters to me!
Hmm... Guess I still need to hone my skills a bit more...
Bravo! Bravo indeed! Such a blessing to witness.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: You're making me blush, {PlayerName}...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Anyway, I'm super glad to hear that from you.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: {PlayerName}, thank you so much for your help.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I couldn't have accomplished any of this without you.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: But when I saw you perform today, it all came back to me! That's the same bell ringing sound I had heard back then!
I have one more question.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Yeah, sure... Let's talk somewhere more private.
Thanks to the Liondance performance, Bei Shi can recall how the sound of a bell saved her during a previous attack in the wild. Her fears begin to shift as her courage is restored.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: So... I must have been saved by that bell.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: The bell that sounded like it was chasing after me... It was actually guiding me away from danger.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: The liondance inspires and empowers each person in a unique way. I'm glad my performance could give you courage and inspiration.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: Yeah! I loved your performance! I think I can keep working as Explorer for the Pioneer Association now!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: Bei Shi, that's amazing!

speaker: Bối Tế
anh_en: When you joined the Association, I was actually so proud... I'm happy you get to keep chasing your dreams...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: {PlayerName}, let's talk here.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Uncontrolled emotions in human Resonators lead to <ano=Overclocking>disasters</ano>. It's even more dangerous in beasts, as they follow instincts.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Over time, most of them died out, driven extinct by their unrestrained desires.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Beasts that can bring their power under control are extremely rare, but... they do exist.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: And the Jingle Beast... It happens to be one of them.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: A long, long time ago, the Jingle Beast wasn't called the Jingle Beast. It used to have a name—

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: It was called "Suan'ni."
That's a ferocious name.
That's an adorable name.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Back then, the Suan'nis lived a tranquil life in deep forests, far away from humans.
About the Jingle Beast...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: However, when the Tacet Fields expanded rapidly, their territories were not spared.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Some of them had to encroach upon certain human territories for a chance to survive.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Humans suffered greatly against the Suan'nis, with their terrifying appearance, powerful Resonance Abilities, and wild animal instincts...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: ...And that's why the Suan'nis were deemed evil.
How do you know all that?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Uh... I read it in an old book in Huanglong. Said they lived under that giant Violet Banyan tree in the Dim Forest.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: The Suan'nis have nearly gone extinct over the years. And now, there might be only one of them remaining.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: And... I've heard of an interesting theory from the archaeologists...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: That last Suan'ni might have yearned to become a human.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: To make itself more approachable, it first came up with a less intimidating name... Something like, the "Jingle Beast."
About Bei Shi...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: And then, it yanked off all its fur, filed down its claws, twisted its bones, and learned to stand upright...
Why did it want to become human so bad?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Maybe... It was drawn by the bustle and merriment of human cities. It must have been lonely as the last of its kind.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Maybe it was moved by human bravery against the Lament, and wanted to offer help. Maybe it wanted to fight the catastrophe that ruined its once homeland.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Or maybe, it simply couldn't resist human foods?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Anyway... It never really became a human in the end.
Is it because of its appearance?
Is it because of its "heart"?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: If it truly wanted to become human, it had to first understand the essence of what makes a human.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: If you ask me, the essence would be the 'heart' of a human.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Where should I begin...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Therefore, the "Jingle Beast" no longer rejected its appearance and began to, in its animal form, connect with humans, to assist them...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Perhaps, in this process, it happened to save a girl in the wilderness.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: {PlayerName}, what do you think the ending for the "Jingle Beast" was? Did it finally become a human?
It has a long way to go.
Yes, it did.
It doesn't matter anymore.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Well... is that what you think?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I think the "Jingle Beast" no longer cares whether it's a human or a beast. It lives in its own way.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: In this world, there are beings with the appearance of a beast and the soul of a human, just as there are beings with the appearance of a human and the soul of a beast. All it needs to do is be true to itself.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: It will remain resolute and convey the beautiful and inspiring qualities it once saw in humans in its own way.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: {PlayerName}, have you ever thought about this...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Oops, I got carried away and almost forgot—here, keep this bell as a memento!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}!
(Reach out your hand.)

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Lingyang! Come here!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Coming!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I must go get the props ready for the next show.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Come watch my performance again next time! Food's on me!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Please keep this bell! It should bring you good luck! Fare thee well, blessings swell!

In the end, Lingyang reveals the truth about the "Jingle Beast"—it is the last "Suan'ni." Moved by humanity's bravery against the Lament, this creature longed to become one of them. It had been trying to understand what it means to be human and ultimately discovered that the answer lies in the "heart." Since that day, it has sought to express the beauty it sees in humans in its own unique way.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Since there are humans with Resonance Abilities...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: ...Then, could there ever be beasts with the same kind of power?
That's impossible.
I believe so.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Oh, you are...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Nice! Just double-checking again: It will be your grandfather's 60th birthday, right?

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Correct.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Alright, I'll keep that in mind.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Then, I'll do six spins in a row as part of the celebration, which symbolize the six decades your grandpa has lived through!
What do you mean?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Means I'll dance around our birthday star on the poles! It's a special birthday celebration dance.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: One spin for a decade past, health and vigor forever last!

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Thank you so much. I'm sure grandpa will be happy to hear that!
After talking with the client, Lingyang agrees to celebrate an elderly person's birthday during tomorrow's performance.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Fivefold blessings grace your door, good luck and fortune evermore!

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Aww, the Lucky Greetings... You're from the Liondance Troupe, I bet. Nice to meet you!

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: Are you here for my grandpa's birthday party?

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: I thought our reservation was tomorrow. Did you maybe mix up the time?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Ah, here's the thing. People from City Hall already booked a liondance show on the same day for soldiers leaving on an expedition.

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: I see...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: But maybe we can combine your celebrations with this existing show...

speaker: Speaker_98_Title
anh_en: My grandpa loves hanging out with people. He'd be so happy if you could do that for him.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: Hi, {PlayerName}, long time no see! Do you still remember me?

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: I've read lots of ancient books on this topic during this time.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: The books said the Jingle Beast used to live near the Violet Banyan, so I proposed coming here for an investigation.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: Until not long ago, the Academy sent us a message that the spores had been cleared. We hurried over here as soon as we got the all-clear from them!

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: The researcher on our team did a quick analysis, and they've came to the preliminary conclusion that it must be the Jingle Beast.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: And this... Lucky Greetings Collection?!

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: How weird!

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: Has the Jingle Beast learned how to talk already?

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: But why would it choose to learn the Lucky Greetings, of all things...

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: And the Moon Lanterns on the tree... The Jingle Beast, or maybe its family too, they must have put them up there... Why did they do that?

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: But our plan had to be put on hold because of the dangerous spores here.
I do.

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: And you know what? We really found some traces of a large creature having lived here!
I don't.
It's you! Qiaomu!
My brother and I are super grateful for the help we got from you and Lingyang. Please let me thank you again!
It's me, Bei Shi! My brother and I are super grateful for the help we got from you and Lingyang. Please let me thank you again!

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: Who's that... It's me, Bei Shi! My brother and I are super grateful for the help we got from you and Lingyang. Please let me thank you again!
What are you doing here?

speaker: Bối Thi
anh_en: We at the Pioneer Association are planning an in-depth investigation into the Jingle Beast's mysteries.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Oh my, how did I leave such an important thing behind...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I mean... The Jingle Beast, learning how to do Lucky Greetings? Who could have thought...
Yeah. Why would it do that?
Do you know why, Lingyang?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Me? Uh, I have no idea...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Maybe it just wanted to make people happy. Wanted to blend in...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: After all, everyone likes the Lucky Greetings, right? Ahahaha...
About the Moon Lanterns...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: If this is really the place where the Jingle Beast used to live... Maybe it put up the first Moon Lantern here?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Perhaps, after being stuck in the dark for so long, even the Jingle Beast would want some light...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Even if it's just a little bit of artificial moonlight... It would have made it feel less lonely.
I was worried the Qixing Drum could be too loud...
So it's not alone now.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Yeah, indeed.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I'm sure it's no longer feeling lonely... Not anymore.
About the poisonous spores...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: One day, these weird spores suddenly showed up in the Dim Forest, after the Lament hit.

speaker: Yangyang

anh_en: Pero, pero!

anh_en: You see, objects carry people's thoughts and feelings. And what better way to share those than through an opera?

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: What do you think, {PlayerName}? When is someone really gone?

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: The frequencies lingering in this lunachord tell me that its owner never stopped playing, not even during her exile.

speaker: NPC #1533

The lunachord was used for helping others.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: These bits of ship debris may not look like much, but they were once part of countless Pilgrim's ships.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: That's nice of you, {PlayerName}.

anh_en: But the troupe doesn't make its honored guests carry heavy stuff.

Roccia reflects on the ship debris. These fragments once belonged to a Pilgrim's Sail—a vessel that carried everyone’s fear and confusion, while also recording their resilience and defiance. \nThe debris is large and well-suited for use as scene props for the stage.

speaker: NPC #1531
anh_en: Pero, pero!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: There. That pretty much covers the basics.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: They carry all the fear and confusion people felt.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: But they also hold onto their strength.
Perfect for stage props, right?

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: Mm-hmm, this debris will make a good backdrop material.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: Come on, Pero. Let's get them up there.
I'll come with you.

anh_en: Umm... Brant and Bardolino are away, and they put me in charge of the welcoming proceedings.

speaker: NPC #100006
anh_en: Pero, pero...

anh_en: I tend to fumble with words when talking to people... I'm worried I won't do a good job accommodating everyone.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: Perfect. Now we have a glimmer of light to illuminate the darkness.

I found these earlier.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: He never survived the sail... He didn't grab the prop gun in time. The wreath got blown away, leaving only a few petals.

speaker: NPC #1533

speaker: NPC #1533

speaker: NPC #1533

To gain something from it?

anh_en: Pero and I weren't sure if we could keep everyone safe. But watching you in action, it hit me...

anh_en: I'm picking up all kinds of weird scents... the mist, Tacet Discords, some kind of star, wet soil, old book pages, broken dolls, dusty junk, hot cocoa, and oranges...

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: Always with the Tacet Discords. "A sea covered in veil, lay beasts of howling wail." Of course...

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: Well, gotta go all out when you're putting on a show, I guess.

anh_en: The mist is good at messing with your head. Anyone can get lost in it.

speaker: NPC #1533
anh_en: But hey, at least failures help you find the right path eventually.

Thanks, but we've got this. Little one seems quite shy, she's just warming up to us. Wouldn't want to bother you further.

speaker: Tuần Úy Kỳ Cựu
anh_en: Don't worry, you're not bothering us. It's our job to help civilians in need.
Trust me, I understand how tedious a Patroller's job can get. That's why I want to help.
The name's Yinlin. I am also a Patroller… Here's my ID.

speaker: Tuần Úy Kỳ Cựu
anh_en: Oh, a fellow Patroller...
The Patrollers are almost here… Shh.

speaker: Tân Tuần Úy
anh_en: You sure this is real? Never seen her around.

speaker: Tuần Úy Kỳ Cựu
anh_en: You think I can't tell a fake ID when I see it? Shut your mouth.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: No reason you would have seen me. I don't work here, just visiting Jinzhou on vacation.

speaker: Tân Tuần Úy
anh_en: Ah, makes sense.

speaker: Tuần Úy Kỳ Cựu
anh_en: Then we'll leave the girl to you. Thank you for your help.

speaker: Tuần Úy Kỳ Cựu
anh_en: If can't find her dad, bring her to the Patroller Station... C'mon, we're going, rookie.

speaker: Tân Tuần Úy
anh_en: Enjoy your day! Have fun in Jinzhou! Oh hey! Wait up, Captain!
Are you really a Patroller?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hmm? Do I not look the part?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I didn't plan to blow my cover, but that Patroller was sharp…

speaker: Tân Tuần Úy
anh_en: You there. We heard some commotion coming from this area. What's going on?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I would've risked them finding out about Yuanyuan otherwise.
Why didn't you stop Lirong then?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You should see for yourself...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Let your soul rest. Return to your true form, daughter of Lirong—Yuanyuan…
What the...!? Yuanyuan... Is she an android?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes. A "puppet" to be exact… This helpless little girl before you, Lirong's beloved daughter, is nothing but a humanoid robot.

You are both questioned by the Patroller, but the two of you conceal what happened. During the conversation, you discover that the woman is actually a Patroller named Yinlin. After the Patroller leaves, Yinlin reveals that "Yuanyuan" is, in fact, a puppet.
Nothing, officer. We were just hanging out.

speaker: Tân Tuần Úy
anh_en: Really? Then what was that loud banging and shouting?
Oh. This girl just tripped over. Poor thing nearly cried her eyes out.
I'm sure it's just a misunderstanding.

speaker: Tân Tuần Úy
anh_en: Is that so…? Then what did you do after that?
It seems she can't find her father. We were just trying to help.

speaker: Thuận Liên
anh_en: I know staying with us puppets will make my hubby sick eventually... I just want to stay with him while I can.
It must be hard for you.

speaker: Thuận Liên
anh_en: Yes, maybe we are causing harm by simply existing... But I wouldn't trade what I have now for anything else.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh... Yuanyuan...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ow, ow, ow... That's gonna leave a mark.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Xiaosheng!! Stay where you are!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Mom! The monsters are coming!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Another attack? We must keep them away!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I've never seen this many of them before...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey Rover! Ring me up when you find something unusual again, will ya?
Do you know anything about the "undercover investigators"?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Yeah, I heard they'd hide their true identity and infiltrate criminal groups.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Doesn't sound like something I could pull off... I'd probably have my cover blown in less than three minutes.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't bother. You won't find any Patrollers here.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I told you before...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't trust anyone. Remember?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: What a special specimen...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Time to have my men take {Male=him;Female=her} back to the camp...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We meet again. As I expected.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: My orders were clear: infiltrate the Séance Society, gather evidence of their crimes, and find the culprit behind it all.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: So far, I've had no luck meeting any of their higher-ups. Just playing assistant for Lirong to gain their trust.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: They operate under the guise of a non-profit charity.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: The Séance Society lures people in with the promise of bringing back their loved ones. But it's all a sham… You've seen firsthand the truth behind their supposed "resurrection".

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Despite previously keeping a low-profile, they've recently become more active and are using people like Lirong to recruit new victims.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: From what I've gathered, they're in cahoots with Fractsidus...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: And a Fractsidus intervention would've only made things worse.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Lirong, once a Midnight Ranger, lost his daughter in a tragic accident.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: He joined the Society to see his daughter again, and he's been feverishly trying to convince others to do the same.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: He truly believes the puppets are living miracles. A godsent means of redemption.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: This place seems safe enough...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: He could have been a good father, but his obsession with losing his daughter consumed him.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Aside from recruiting new people in Jinzhou, Lirong and I were given another task. See the transaction record in your hands?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Some Fractsidus members ordered a batch of puppets from the Society. We're in charge of handling the deal.
They make puppets for the Fractsidus too?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Not until their collaboration started. The Fractsidus has been demanding prototype puppets regularly.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I plan to investigate these prototype puppets for manufacturer clues.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But Lirong keeps things very tight. He never takes me to his storage place.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: It's almost time for the deal… I need to bring Yuanyuan back to Lirong before he gets suspicious.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: With the Fractsidus in play, things could go south very fast…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Now you know the nitty-gritty details, it's still not late to call it quits.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: So, anything questions for me?
I want to find out who's making these puppets.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You don't seem to be mourning someone…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Why the interest?
They may have a way to recover my memories.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You've suffered a memory loss… I see.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Indeed, if they can make such lifelike puppets by tapping into people's memories, perhaps they could help you remember too.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But we need to find them first... You can be my civilian investigator. What do you say?
Why not. What's the plan?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Lirong and I are about to meet the Fractsidus for our deal. He will then leave to get the puppets at the storage house.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I need you to follow him and send me the coordinates once you're there.
Tell me about your mission.
Will do.
I need to think it through…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: And you're in already? Didn't even think twice?
Oh well. You seem really confident, and that's a good thing.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: They're coming. You'll hide and watch Lirong.
I'll bring Yuanyuan to him... hopefully he won't suspect.
Yinlin reactivates the puppet. It turns back into Yuanyuan's form.
Rise and shine, Yuanyuan.

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Miss Yinlin? W-where am I…? Where's Daddy?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't worry, Yuanyuan. I'm taking you to Daddy in just a moment. But before we do, promise me you'll be a good girl, okay?
Tell me about the Séance Society.

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Okay! I promise!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: That's my girl. Let's go.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I'm leaving the rest to you, Rover.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I understand. This mission won't be an easy one, you better think it through.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But be quick. It's almost time for the deal.

Yinlin tells you that the Séance Society is a dangerous organization that lures people in by promising to bring back their loved ones. They appear to be linked to the Fractsidus, and her mission is to gather evidence against them and identify the mastermind behind it all. Currently, she is investigating the prototype puppets in the hope they hold clues about their creator. Eager to recover your lost memories, you decide to assist Yinlin by following Lirong to the puppets' storage location.
Tell me about Lirong.
I don't have more questions.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hehe... Didn't know you cared so much about me.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: This is supposed to be confidential, but… I've been authorized to make my own calls.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Tsk... The control system's crashed. We'll have to force our way through.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Well? Have you come to a decision?

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Miss Yinlin? W-where am I…? Where's Daddy?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't worry, Yuanyuan. I'm taking you to Daddy in just a moment. But before we do, promise me you'll be a good girl, okay?

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Okay! I promise!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: That's my girl. Now, let's go.
I'll leave the rest to you now, Rover.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I understand. The mission won't be an easy one, you should think it through.
But be quick. It's almost time for the deal.
I'll help.
Give me some more time…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: So you still decided to join me…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You must be pretty confident. That's good.
They're coming. You'll hide and watch Lirong.
I'll bring Yuanyuan to him... hopefully he won't suspect.
Yinlin reactivates the puppet. It turns back into Yuanyuan's form.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Rise and shine, Yuanyuan.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Lirong. Here's your daughter, as I promised.

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: You...!

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Cao Gầy
anh_en: Enough, we don't have time for this… Where's our stuff? Bring them out.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Lirong, go bring them the prototype puppets.

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Huff... Huff... I…

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Cao Gầy
anh_en: Hey… We ain't got all day. Hurry up.

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: No! I won't let you have them!

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Cao Gầy
anh_en: We'll make you regret this...

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Mập Mạp
anh_en: After him! You're going nowhere either, Missy!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Here we go…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: (Lirong's trying to escape with the puppets. Here's hoping that Rover can stop him in time…)

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Yuanyuan!! I was so afraid… I can't bear to lose you again…
Lirong is our only lead... I must follow him!
You follow closely behind Lirong.
Furious with the Fractsidus for their disdain toward the puppets, Lirong breaks their deal and attempts to escape with the puppets. You quickly follow him.

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Please don't cry, Daddy… Was I being bad?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: No, you're always a good girl... always...

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Mập Mạp
anh_en: Ugh, enough with the make-believe. That's a puppet.

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Daddy… am I a puppet?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: No! You're not! Yuanyuan, I...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yuanyuan's ten times more human than you people.

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Mập Mạp
anh_en: You call that thing human? Hah! That's just a robot lab rat.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: And the so-called Séance Society... They are the ones behind Jinzhou's recent missing person cases.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Lirong's the recruiter. You're the perfect outsider, traveling all alone, ripe for the taking.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Heh... But it seems he picked the worst candidate possible.
Then why are you still helping him?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I need to apprehend the true culprit behind this group…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But this is not your problem. I'm on a mission. Leave now and forget everything that happened here today, will you?
Were you looking for this?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Lirong's transaction record… Where did you find it?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: *sigh*… You're such a box of surprises.
You promised to tell me everything.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Sure, why not. I'll give you what you want...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: They offer these puppets to people who have lost their loved ones.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But I don't want prying eyes. If you're really that curious, meet me outside the city at these coordinates.

Yinlin explains that the Séance Society is behind the recent disappearances in Jinzhou. They provide lifelike puppets in place of lost loved ones, and many desperate people join the Society for this reason. However, frequent interaction with these puppets greatly increases the risk of Overclocking. Yinlin is on the trail of those responsible and invites you to meet her outside the city if you want to learn more about the case.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: These puppets can perfectly replicate the personalities of the deceased… To those mourning people, they are indistinguishable from the living.
Yuanyuan... Did she really pass away?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes… With the puppet, she has been resurrected by her father's longing.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: People gave up everything to join this Society for one chance to reunite with their beloved.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: As for how they got their hands on these puppets... I have no idea yet.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Beware, the puppets may seem harmless, but those who got too attached are much more likely to Overclock.
Didn't know they were so dangerous...

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Daddy… I'm tired...
(I guess they still have some morals. There's still things they won't do.)

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I spotted them! Over there!

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Mập Mạp
anh_en: You can't hide from this good ol' sniffer of mine!

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Yuanyuan, get behind Daddy, quick...

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Mập Mạp
anh_en: I'll grab these puppets now. What about that guy, boss?

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Cao Gầy
anh_en: Ice him… We'll take that puppet behind him too.

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Huh… Urgh… Huff... I will not... Let you! Aaaghhah!
(Lirong's going to severely Overclock at this rate.)

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: It's okay, Yuanyuan... They won't find us here.

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Eek… *gasp*…

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: H-Help!
Yuanyuan, take your father somewhere safe!

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Mập Mạp
anh_en: Hey! What the hell are you doing here?!

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Cao Gầy
anh_en: One {Male=man;Female=woman}'s not gonna make a difference. Get rid of them now!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Forgetting someone, are we?
*sigh* Doesn't matter now. I must get all of you to safety first.

Determined to protect the puppets from becoming Fractsidus experimental subjects, Lirong attempts to hide. He reveals that the leader of the Séance Society is known as the Dollmaker. As the Fractsidus closes in, putting them all in danger, you and Yinlin step in.

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Those scary people... Are they coming after me?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Not just you, Yuanyuan... They want all the puppets here. But I won't let them.

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: I'll make sure every puppet finds home, together with people who love and need them. I will NOT let those freaks use them for experiments!

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Master Dollmaker… How could you be the first to betray our belief...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: ("Dollmaker"… Is that the leader of the Séance Society?)

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Is Master Dollmaker bad, Daddy?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: I... I'm not sure anymore. He was our hope... He saved us all, but...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: We've been getting a lot of missing persons reports recently.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Nobody ever saw those people assaulted or anything, they just vanished.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Some of those people are even Resonators or they've served in the military!
These cases might be connected.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Since you're always coming and going from the city, can you help me watch out for anything weird or suspicious?
Sure thing.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Thank you so much! Knew I could count on you!
Ring me up when you spot anything sus, yeah? Laterz!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (You received a message right after hanging up with Chixia.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Chixia just called me. I wonder what's happening...)
Chixia contacts you to say that several Jinzhou citizens have recently gone missing. She asks you to stay alert for anything suspicious.
Oh no. Did I break the law or something?
Hello Chixia, what's up?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Huh? Is that your first reaction? Come on!
Anyway! You know, we could really use your help with this ongoing case!
Here's the thing, we could really use your help with this ongoing case...

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Mập Mạp
anh_en: What the… Those idiots. They were supposed to take care of you!
Count me in. It's not like they'll let me off the hook.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hehe... True. You know your Fractsidus well.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You've got some moves. Impressive…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Guess I can rely on you a bit more. I'll be counting on you.
Yinlin tries to mediate between the Séance Society and the Fractsidus, but the negotiations fail.

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Cao Gầy
anh_en: Careful!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Sorry I knocked out your friends earlier. We're not planning to start anything with the Fractsidus, really.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: What do you say? Care to give Lirong and his daughter a little break? They're our people, after all.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You may have these puppets here. We can pretend none of this ever happened.

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Cao Gầy
anh_en: You think we're stupid or what? We're taking the puppets, and you're all going under!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Aww, you sure you want to do this? We're business partners, remember?

speaker: Thành Viên Tàn Tinh Hội Mập Mạp
anh_en: Partners? You're just a bunch of lab rat keepers trying to play the game!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: So they're not up for peace talks. What do you say, Rover?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: How did you like the fight? Are you injured?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: My, my... Are you worried about me?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: What a surprise. I thought you never trusted me this entire time.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Fine, I'll spare you the teasing for now… Your serious face is quite cute though.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't worry, we took care of all the Fractsidus people here. If the Society becomes suspicious, I'll just pin everything on them.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: They may still question me, but I've mastered gaining trust with lies. It's the key to being an undercover investigator.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Just like what I did to you… Try feeling your back.
You planted a bug on me!?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: A bug and a tracker. Yes. How else did you think I got here so quickly?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I put it there the first time we met.
Not a scratch.
Why did you do this?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't trust anyone… That's the first thing I learned in training.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You may not belong to any group, but you seemed to care for Lirong and Yuanyuan, and you want to recover lost memories…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I can't risk you betraying me by helping them run off or selling me out. Better safe than sorry.
Then I'm sure you overheard the name "Dollmaker"?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Of course. Dollmaker... He must be a big deal in the Séance Society, or even their leader.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We're getting close to the truth... But we have another issue at hand.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I did a quick checkup on Lirong. He just passed out from Overclocking. Lucky for him it wasn't that bad.
What about Yuanyuan?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yuanyuan returned to her puppet form once Lirong fell unconscious. Not even I can reactivate her now.
They were a bit hard to handle.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I doubt she'll be reactivated any time soon. We've reached a dead end with Lirong.
We can try the prototype puppets?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yeah, I was planning to. We may find some clues.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But we gotta move first. Can't stay here for long.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Go collect the puppets. I'll look after Lirong and Yuanyuan.

She admits she tracked you using a positioning device placed on you earlier, explaining that her undercover role makes it hard for her to trust anyone. With Lirong and Yuanyuan no longer providing new leads, your only hope lies in the prototype puppets, so you decide to gather as many of them as possible.
I can take on a dozen more!
Those were the Fractsidus and you didn't bat an eye... Looks like you've got the skills, and the nerve too.
Yeah, better stay cautious. I've seen too many die from recklessness.
Ooh, really? I'll sit back and leave it all to you next time.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We took care of them for now… but there's probably more trouble coming our way.
Is your cover at risk?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Yinlin seems to be on a call...)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This puppet... Next to it is a tag with the recipient's name and identity.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Identity... Twin sister of Linsi. Went missing in an accident.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It's all my fault... If I didn't leave, she wouldn't have gone missing like that.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It's been ten years... I just want to tell her I'm sorry.
Collect puppet.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This puppet... Next to it is a tag with the recipient's name and identity.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Identity... Parents of Xiaofu. Killed during a Tacet Discord Outbreak.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Mommy, Daddy, please come back... I'll be a good boy from now on. I promise...
Collect puppet.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This puppet... Next to it is a tag with the recipient's name and identity.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Identity... Wife of Fujie. Passed away from illness.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: I couldn't bear the sight of her enduring such pain… How I wished I could trade places with her.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: But now I am offered a chance to bring her back to my side. Thank you... Master Dollmaker.
Collect puppet.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Acknowledged… Is that our only option…?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: That's fine. We'll dig further once we're in a safer location.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: My contact informed me of a safe house not far from here… The Patrollers will meet us there.
How do we find this safe house?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We have a designated meet-up spot. There will be wolf-shaped markings nearby to show us the way.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Let's move. Can't let the Fractsidus find us.

After collecting all the prototype puppets, Yinlin plans to take them to a safe place for further investigation. She learns from a fellow Patroller that there is a safehouse nearby for undercover agents, and you both head there.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Yinlin seems to be on a call with someone.)

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But... I believe it's unnecessary...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes… Understood… I'll have it taken care of.
Were you calling someone?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes… It's my contact from the Public Security Bureau.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: They'll be sending people over soon. We can leave Lirong and Yuanyuan in their care.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Are you done with the puppets?
They're all here. No luck with clues, though.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: These must be the coordinates. The Sensor may reveal more clues.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This must be the marking. That way.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: No more markings in sight... This must be the safe house.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Look, there's a device on that wall.
Hmm… We need a passcode.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: They were thorough. The safe house is hidden and has a passcode.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: There should be some hints nearby. Let's look around.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We should be good in here. This safe house is equipped with signal jammers and counter-surveillance measures.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: The Fractsidus won't find us here.
Really living up to its name...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes, it's as safe and secure as it gets.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Nothing gets in, and nothing gets out.
But... where are the Patrollers?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: ("The Séance Society Name List"…?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Wu Sheng/Shunlian… Lianyue/Lian Xiaosheng… Jinlu/He Chang… Lady Guan/Xiaoguan…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: And the list goes on.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Some of the names have been crossed-out.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (These are probably the Séance Society members… The people who went missing.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Am I in their base of operation?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (I was trapped inside this box... It's easier to open now that I broke it.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (There's something between the cracks…)
Retrieve the tablet.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (A tablet with an encrypted transmitter? Messages sent through these are less traceable, I heard.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (But why would I find it here...)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (I guess that's all the clues. Anyway, this place is definitely connected to the Society.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (I should use it to inform Chixia and the others of my situation, and my current coordinates.)
You realize the place is connected to the Séance Society, so you use the communication panel you found earlier to send the coordinates and details of the situation to Chixia.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Look at you, fresh as the dew.
Who? Me…?

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: Where is your <color=Highlight>family</color>?

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: Youngsters like you, always runnin' off and leaving yer family to rot.

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: It's "Family Reunion Day." Ain't no way I'm lettin' anyone leave this camp.

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: Go sit down next to the bonfire and stay there. Don't yer be thinking of slippin' off… Miss Yinlin, show 'em the way.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You heard the kind lady. Now keep your mouth shut and follow me.
And if I say no?
You can try to escape. I wouldn't recommend it, though.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Without Dr. Wu Sheng's antidote, you wouldn't make it too far with that poison inside of you.
You expect me to believe that?
Yinlin… So it really was you!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: It's all up to you. Just know I have no reason to lie.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You were planning to ask Master Dollmaker about your memories anyway, so why not come with me?
What exactly is this place?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: It's the Séance Society's headquarters. We all live here.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Why don't you join the Society? Make things easier for all of us.
Where do I sign up?
No.
Good try. Try not to sound so obvious next time.
I expected as much. But you may have a change of mind later.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Come on. Joining or not, it won't hurt to introduce yourself first.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I went with maximum voltage back there. Didn't expect you'd wake up so soon.

You soon discover that it was Yinlin who trapped you here. She reveals that this is the Séance Society's base and invites you once more to join the organization, offering to introduce you to its members.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Thought you might never wake up again. I was gonna get Dr. Wu Sheng to check on you.
Isn't that what you wanted?
Am I supposed to say "Thank you"?
I have no interest in taking your life. Master Dollmaker wants to see you alive.
You're welcome. But save your gratitude for Master Dollmaker, since he asked me to keep you alive. We'd be in trouble if you died.

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: Why you insolent little whippersnapper. Show some manners when you're talking to Miss Yinlin.

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: Well. What are you waiting for?

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: How lucky I was to have Master Dollmaker bring him back to me... Praise the heavens for this miracle.

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: I'll do anything for Master Dollmaker. Nothing will ever be enough to repay his kindness...

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: But...Why would he make puppets for those Fractsidus devils…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I'm sure Master Dollmaker has his own reasons.

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: Yes... I'm just grateful to have my grandson back. Can't ask for more.

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: Youngsters these days… always complaining about us old-timers being naggy.
Umm… I haven't even said anything yet.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Grandma Guan patrols this place daily to keep us safe. She used to be a Midnight Ranger.

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: Sigh, there's no one like my precious boy. No matter how long this old lady ran her mouth, he'd always listen till the end.
Who's that?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Her grandson.

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: Such a sweet boy he was… His parents died young. I was the only one he could rely on.

speaker: Bà Quán
anh_en: And they took him away from me, as if he hadn't suffered enough misfortunes...

speaker: Tấn Lục
anh_en: Greetings, stranger. The name's Jinlu. We're the guards here, He Chang and I.

speaker: Tấn Lục
anh_en: I know the risks… I'm just... I'll do anything. Anything to make it up to him, if I still can.
You discover that Jinlu met his fallen comrade He Chang here and chose to stay because of their strong bond.
Are you a Resonator?

speaker: Tấn Lục
anh_en: Right you are. The two of us and Lirong used to be Midnight Rangers.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: How are you feeling? Got the Overclocking under control?

speaker: Tấn Lục
anh_en: Thanks for asking, Miss Yinlin. I'm feeling a lot better now.

speaker: Tấn Lục
anh_en: Lirong though… He... he had it rough back there.
Why stay with a puppet when you know it's dangerous?

speaker: Tấn Lục
anh_en: We served in the same unit. He Chang Overclocked trying to save me… In the end, he didn't make it.
What if you end up Overclocking too?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (The Séance Society... Never heard of them before. They said they have a "solution"... But how? This is very suspicious, no matter how I look at it.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Guess I'll just go and see for myself.)

speaker: Liên Nguyệt
anh_en: Miss Yinlin… Who might this be?

speaker: Liên Nguyệt
anh_en: That's why I won't let anyone threaten our peaceful life ever again…
You learn that Lianyue, who also reunited with her deceased child with the Society's help, refuses to let anyone disrupt their current life.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't worry. {Male=He;Female=She}'s Master Dollmaker's guest.

speaker: Liên Nguyệt
anh_en: I see… Whatever. I just want to stay with my son.
Your son… Is he a puppet too?

speaker: Liên Nguyệt
anh_en: So what!? He's still my one and only son… What would you know!?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Rover, let's stop it here...
What on earth happened...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Dr. Wu Sheng, how's Lirong doing?

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: This is the only place where we can forever live with our loved ones.
You're a doctor. You should know how dangerous those puppets are.

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: I do. But I also know why we'll hold on to them no matter what.

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: Doctors can't save everyone. Not even the best of us can.

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: I could only watch as my better half passed away in agony...

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: Master Dollmaker saved us with his puppets. That's something no doctor can ever achieve.

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: What about you? Do you have someone you desperately need to see again?
As a matter of fact, I do.
No, I do not.
I don't know…

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: Out of danger for now, but he's still in a coma.

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: You can ask Master Dollmaker for help. He'll bring them back.

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: Rather fortunate of you... or shall I say, unfortunate? To not have a single person that you cherish.

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: Feeling lost? I suggest taking a walk and go chat with everyone a bit. We're all for helping each other.

Wu Sheng tells you that even the best doctors can't save everyone, just as he was not able to save his wife. The Dollmaker's puppets gave them a second chance, something no doctor could offer. While Wu Sheng understands the dangers of the puppets, he also knows how much they mean to the people here.

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: Sorry... I'm not that familar with taking care of Resonators. There's not much else I can do.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Shame. He shouldn't have disobeyed Master Dollmaker.
Was it you who injected me with poison?

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: Well, yes. Master Dollmaker asked me to.

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: We had no other choice. You refused to join us.
Did you poison everyone else here too?

speaker: Ngô Thịnh
anh_en: No, why would I need to? They're not leaving here.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You've talked with everyone I see. Are you joining us now?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: He taught me combat, puppetry, temperance, and how to become a Patroller.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I owe my life to him.
But he's in for more than just helping people.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes, his eyes are set on another ultimate goal...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We're all his subjects. He needs us to complete the last two puppets.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Every one of us has been aware of this, but still decided to join.
What kind of puppet is he trying to make?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: That's not for your ears. Members only, you see?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But I do admit you're not like the others.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You rescued Lirong and showed respect to the puppets. They weren't just objects to you, I could tell.
They're not bad people, but…
I couldn't just stand by and watch.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Look at you, ever so righteous...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Maybe you're better suited to be a Patroller than me.
You were kind to those people and their puppets, too.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Kindness…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hmph, or maybe... I couldn't just stand by, either.
Can I trust your words this time?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: That's up to you. Trust is a delicate thing. You must follow your instincts and decide how much you're willing to give.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Enough chatter for now. I'll take you to Master Dollmaker's pl...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Help! HELP!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: ...They're just some poor souls longing to see their loved ones again.

Yinlin reveals that she empathizes with these people who just want to see their loved ones again. She reveals that she was once a member of the Séance Society herself. She grew up alongside the Dollmaker and knows that his experiments are aimed at creating two special puppets. However, she keeps the details of this final experiment from you.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Master Dollmaker saves them, letting them make amends for their past regrets.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: A noble cause, is it not?
Is this why you betrayed me?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Heh. How is it betrayal when we were never a team?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Having a cop on our side makes things easier for the Séance Society, don't you agree?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I was just a young orphan, never knew who my parents were. Master Dollmaker took me in.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: What's going on?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: If you really want to know... You'll need to survive this first!

speaker: Tiểu Quán
anh_en: Miss Yinlin! The Tacet Discords are here!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Go tell your grandma. Get everyone somewhere safe.

speaker: Tiểu Quán
anh_en: O-okay!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: What about you, Rover? Will you join them or flee while you can in this chaos?
They're not bad people...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: So you want to help protect them. Knew it.
You owe me the truth after this. Everything.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Everything, huh... The secrets I hold might be bigger than you imagine.

speaker: Tuần Úy
anh_en: Surrender now! We've got you surrounded! You are the leader here, aren't you?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Trust me… Come this way.
When the Patrollers besiege the base, Yinlin takes you hostage but secretly passes you a message: "Trust me… Come this way."

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: My, my. That's quite the party.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hey! Who the hell are you? Let {Male=him;Female=her} go!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: And if I don't?

speaker: Tuần Úy
anh_en: Freeze! Shut up!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere. I've got a hostage, you see?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Whoa! You-You... Don't move!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I wouldn't try anything stupid if I were you. Can't risk the VIP of Jinzhou getting hurt, now can we?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Ugh, fine... Lower your weapons guys!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes... Some TDs found their way inside, and we're now surrounded by a bunch of cops. Hard to make it out of here with the specimens.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Well that's not your problem. Also, no one's coming to your rescue anytime soon.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I guess you managed to send out a distress call? Somehow it slipped past us. Ah… You had an encrypted transmitter tablet.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hand it over. Don't try to deceive me.
(Hand over the tablet.)
You can dream...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Good {Male=boy;Female=girl}.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Funny you'd think you have a choice.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You are a valuable test subject. I don't want to make things difficult for you, unless you force my hands... Got it?

speaker: Con Rối Cơ Khí "Huyền Ty"
anh_en: (Here's the thing. Dollmaker's listening to our every word. All my efforts will be wasted if he suspects anything.)

speaker: Con Rối Cơ Khí "Huyền Ty"
anh_en: (I'll be typing on this tablet for you to see. I want you to follow my instructions.)

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Fortunately you caught that Rover. Whether {Male=he;Female=she}'s useful for research or not, holding {Male=him;Female=her} hostage will buy us some time.
(Nod in agreement.)

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Very well, if you can refrain from unnecessary struggle, we won't have to do things the hard way.
Where are we?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You don't need to know. Now get moving.

speaker: Con Rối Cơ Khí "Huyền Ty"
anh_en: (We're in the factory where the Dollmaker makes his puppets. The place is full of traps and his minions. Very dangerous.)
At least tell me what he's planning to do with me.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hehe. Patience. You'll know once you see him.

speaker: Con Rối Cơ Khí "Huyền Ty"
anh_en: (Dollmaker's in bed with the Fractsidus, trading Overclock-inducing puppets for resources and funds.)

speaker: Con Rối Cơ Khí "Huyền Ty"
anh_en: (I need your help to collect proof of his crimes.)

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: No more wasting time... Let's go.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: What should I do next, Master?

speaker: Con Rối Cơ Khí "Huyền Ty"
anh_en: (I'll take off your restraints on the way. I need you to pretend you're still bound, remember?)
Understood.

Yinlin brings you to meet the Dollmaker, maintaining a façade of hostility due to a bug the Dollmaker planted on you. Through a hidden panel, she explains that this factory produces puppets designed to trigger Overclocking for the Fractsidus in exchange for resources. She needs your help to gather evidence against the Dollmaker's involvement in all this.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Here's the coordinates. Bring {Male=him;Female=her} to me in the inner chamber.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: {Male=He;Female=She}'s a sly one. Ready to bolt any moment.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: I have trackers planted on {Male=him;Female=her}. {Male=He;Female=She}'s not going anywhere in our territory.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: We'll talk once you get there.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You heard him. You're in our turf. Better not get any bright ideas.
You'll pay for this…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You guarding this place for Master Dollmaker?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Out of my way. Master Dollmaker asked for this person.
Something's not right.

speaker: Exile Commoner
anh_en: Urgh... Family... My family...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: They're Overclocking... Must've been exposed to those puppets for too long...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: And the bunch of cops who just attacked us finally pushed them over the edge.
Watch out!

speaker: Exile Commoner
anh_en: Give my family back!

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Yinlin, you made it. Have those cops entered the factory?
What are you planning to do?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Stop it, Dollmaker... My parents would not consent to being brought back as puppets.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Yinlin... I thought at least you would understand me.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: I don't blame you. You were too young when they passed away, after all. You hardly remember them.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: And that's why I couldn't revive them from your memories. Not from my own, either.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: This is where you come in, Rover. You're a godsend, a gift from above.
You want to use me for that?

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Precisely. With help from the Fractsidus, plus your body's data… I will finally create their puppets.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Dollmaker, you…

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: I was an outcast, alone and shunned... Until my mentor and his wife took me in. They were my true family.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Not yet. But those Exiles were Overclocking and I had to take them down.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: I'll do anything to bring them back, no matter the price...
That doesn't mean you can hurt other people.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: So what? Why should I care?

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: It's almost time. We'll have to leave the factory behind, but there's a couple of prototypes I need to bring.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: My identity must stay hidden. Use explosives to stop them if necessary, Yinlin.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But our people are still inside the factory.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Our people? There's only the two of us. The rest of them are not worth my concern.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: What about Rover?

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Same as before, Yinlin. Just knock {Male=him;Female=her} out.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: No need to keep {Male=him;Female=her} intact this time, some level of basic consciousness is enough. The Fractsidus taught me methods to operate on a body like that.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: It's fine, they're disposable.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: I'll leave two puppets here. To pretend we're still holding {Male=him;Female=her} hostage behind the closed door.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We'll need the data repository too.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Yes... My research data. That's more valuable than my life.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: I'll take care of the data transfer. Yinlin, you deal with this person. Be quick!

You speak to the Dollmaker and discover that the two final puppets he intends to make are Yinlin's parents—his former mentors. He captured you to get experimental data, hoping to create perfect puppets with the Fractsidus's backing. Now, with the Public Security Bureau involved, he's rushing to relocate both the puppets and his research data.
How pathetic.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: They're a bunch of outcasts, willing to do whatever it takes to survive. No one would mourn them if they died.
I mean you.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Oh...? Me?
Your Forte could have saved many, but you...

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: I could save them, I'm sure, but who's going to save me?

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Ugh… Yinlin! What are you doing?!

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: No! Don't you dare!
The Exiles... He just let them in?!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Careful... Those people don't look right! They've all Overclocked!

The Dollmaker confronts Yinlin after learning of her betrayal. She asserts that, like her parents, she has always been a Patroller and has never forgotten her true identity and duty. She declares she cannot accept the Dollmaker harming others to recapture the warmth of the past.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: It all ends here, Dollmaker… You're going nowhere.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You of all people should know why the Fractsidus offered their help!

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Yinlin… You... How dare you betray me!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I have never forgotten who I am. My bloodline is one of Jinzhou's Patrollers. I will always uphold my duty, just like my parents before me.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: They fought to the last minute of their lives, trying to save the innocent.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Everything I've done... I did it for them!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: No... you did it to relive the kindness you once felt.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But my parents are gone. So are everyone else's loved ones... It's time we wake up from this dream you've been spinning.

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Ánh Mắt Trống Rỗng
anh_en: Oh… So you've accepted my invitation, Rover.

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Absolutely, my dear. We will stay together... Nothing can take you from me again...
She was taken from you?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Ah, yes... Once we were separated by an unfortunate turn of events... But now I have her back, thanks to the Séance Society's help...

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Truly a miracle, is it not?!

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: And you… Yes, you too can be reunited with your loved ones... Just come join us...
So... Your daughter had died?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: No! She didn't... She was never gone!

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Can't you see? Yuanyuan, she... She's still alive! Alive and well!

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Daddy!? What's happening…? You're scaring me…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (He seems off. Is he Overclocking?)
Are you from the Séance Society?
Calm down! I'll get you a doctor!

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: No! No doctor! I don't need anything!!

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: I am not leaving her… You're not leaving daddy, right Yuanyuan?

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Wah... I...
He might hurt the girl... I must act fast!

An anonymous email leads you to Lirong and his daughter, Yuanyuan. Lirong is a member of the Séance Society, a group that claims to reunite members with their loved ones. He invites you to join, but becomes agitated when asked about his daughter's fate, refusing to accept that she is no longer truly alive.

speaker: Người Đàn Ông Ánh Mắt Trống Rỗng
anh_en: Well, yes. My name is Lirong.

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Since you are here, you must have lost someone, too.

speaker: Cô Bé Nhút Nhát
anh_en: Daddy…

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Now, Yuanyuan, no need to be afraid… {Male=He;Female=She}'s not one of those evil Patrollers. You're safe with me.
Is this your daughter?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Yes, my daughter… Her name is Yuanyuan. My only precious.

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: I am Daddy's precious?
Where are we…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Lightning has destroyed the control panel and hologram projectors. This is what the factory really looks like.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: This thing...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: The Fractsidus... You got this from them? In exchange for being their pawn?

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Me? Their pawn? Hah! I'm the one pulling their strings, sweetheart!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: It's over, Dollmaker… Surrender now.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But the present is mine to control. I can still bring justice to those who caused their untimely end...

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: What's wrong with doing what I can for our happiness? Laws and principles are just tools for those in charge!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Is that why you must deprave others of their happiness? Using them as your pawns?

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Ha! Suddenly justice matters to you? Don't tell me you still think you're a Patroller?

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: I already wiped your data from their records. No one knows you were a Patroller. You can't prove it to anyone now.
Yinlin…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes, they may never allow me back... Doesn't matter now. It's a small price to pay to stop you and the greater evil you serve.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I don't need a recognized identity to do what's right. I can do it my way.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: You… Gah… *coughs*…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I should get going. I'm leaving the rest to you, Rover.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: Ugh… Gah… Yinlin!!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Please... keep it secret from the Patrollers. Until it's all over. One day, I'll tell them everything myself.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Next time we meet, I'll explain all, and I'll thank you properly, I guess.
Yinlin! Wait!

speaker: Tuần Úy
anh_en: Quick. Over there!

In the face of the Dollmaker's twisted obsession, Yinlin argues that puppets cannot replace real family and that it is wrong to take advantage of others' happiness to cope with one's own misfortune. The Dollmaker retorts that he has erased her Patroller records, making it impossible for her to prove her identity. But Yinlin asserts that even without this identity, she will continue to fight evil. That is the spirit her parents instilled in her, and the one that motivates her to pursue her goals in her own way.

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: How could you do this to me!?

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: I created this home for my followers. They found salvation through my puppets. I am their savior!

speaker: Thợ Làm Búp Bê
anh_en: You too, Yinlin! You had the chance to reunite with your family! Why are you doing this to me?!
Puppets can never replace real family.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I never met my parents, but my actions are guided by their beliefs.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: As a child, I bemoaned my misfortune, but I knew better than to harm others to make up for it.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: The dead deserve peace. My parents are gone, and I can't change the past.
You activate the switch to let Chixia and the other Patrollers into the inner chamber.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Rover! Are you okay?!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Uhh.... Yeah, she's a slippery one. Unlikely we can track her down.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Also... Something about her seems.... not so evil? No, can't make assumptions. She's still a suspect!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Uh, we'll table that for now. Rover, you're a crucial witness. Please, come to the Bureau for a statement when you can.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I'll see you there!
