After the Patrollers secure the scene, Chixia updates you on the Séance Society's other members, but by then, Yinlin has already disappeared. You promise Chixia that you will go to the Public Security Bureau to provide a formal statement of what happened.
I'm fine. What about the others?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: We've sent those civilians back to Jinzhou for medicals.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: But they weren't super excited to leave for some reason. They didn't want to be separated from those puppets, no matter what...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: There was really not much we could do about it...
They'll need some time to process.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, where's that woman who kidnapped you?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Don't tell me she's already gone... Quick, we're going after her!
I don't think that's necessary at this point.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: So that's what the Séance Society was up to... Thanks for your statement, it really helped!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, so the missing cases led to an illegal cult-like organization AND a bunch of other twisted plans!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Unbelievable... We'd be toast without your help.
Actually, I couldn't do it without someone else's help.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Huh? And who's that?
An emissary of justice, hidden in the shadows.
An honorable companion.
I'm not sure whether she's a friend or foe.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: What? Come on, you need to be more specific… Whoever they are, sounds like they'll make for quite the Patroller.
I'll be sure to tell her that.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Well, that's it for now. Ring me up when you find something unusual again. I'll catch you later!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Somehow the Fractsidus was involved too! Who could have thought… Luckily you were there to stop them in time!

You learn from Chixia that the injured are recovering, but the Dollmaker still refuses to cooperate. She thanks you for your help, and you hint that the real thanks should go to a mysterious partner. However, you make sure to keep the partner's name a secret.
How's the Dollmaker?
How are the Séance Society people doing?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: The man's still not saying anything... Guess we'll have to keep him under custody for now.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Nothing about that suspect lady either. We still have zero info on her.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Most of those Resonators have varying degrees of Overclocking. They need urgent care, the professionals from Huaxu Academy are already on it.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: A guy named Lirong had it worst, didn't wake up from his coma until yesterday.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: He's still recovering from some really bad aftereffects, but at least he's making progress.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (A letter without a signature. It can only lead to one thing.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Yinlin. She's waiting for me.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Same as last time, she said... Must be the wolf markings. I should look around.)

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Splendid view, right?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hehe… Oh, really? I even upped the voltage for the best effect. Was that just a zap to you?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: No wonder our Dollmaker took so much interest in that body of yours.
So he couldn't recover my memories?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Unfortunately, no. He tried but couldn't gain access.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: According to him, you possess a power beyond his understanding that prevented him from prying into your mind. You might be more special than you had thought.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Said he couldn't read your mind without risking his own sanity, let alone retrieve any information... I can't imagine what the hell is going on beneath your skull.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Who knows? Maybe you helped some strangers again only to mess with the wrong person, and ended up with your memories gone.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I say you should stop playing hero and take better care of yourself. You'll live longer that way.
Are you worried about me?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't think I need to, since you can handle yourself just fine. But... if you ever need my help, just let me know.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: As promised, I owe you a lot of explanation.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We have a lot in common. Both alone in this world.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Maybe I'll keep you in my thoughts. A reminder that I'm not the only solitary soul out there.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: And eventually, we'll both learn to move through our lives with loneliness.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Perhaps the same loneliness was too much for Dollmaker to bear... That's why he gave up everything to resurrect my parents.
He had companions, he just never cherished them.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes… After my parents' death, we all became chess pieces to him, myself included.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Raised me to be a Patroller for his own agenda. He needed a mole in the Public Security Bureau.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: In the end I did become a Patroller, but failed to stay by his side as he desired.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Maybe I'm indeed a heart-wrenching betrayer to him...
He dug his own grave.
Had you been planning to get me involved?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes... We all have to face the consequences of our actions. I don't plan to defend him.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But if I had acted sooner, this whole mess could have been avoided. Why didn't I do something?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Perhaps… like everyone else in the Séance Society, I too held onto that naive pipe dream.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: The dream of finally meeting my parents and having a real family... I indulged in it more than I care to admit.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Deep down, I knew my dream was built upon the sacrifices of innocent lives... but I couldn't bear to shatter it.
In the end, you still fulfilled your duty. As a Patroller.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hmph... because I met you. A total outsider risking {Male=his;Female=her} life for me and for all those people...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: A lot of it still remains unresolved. Dollmaker was merely a cog in the wheel. A bigger shadow lingers.
The Fractsidus…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes. We must stay vigilant until we expose the true culprits and destroy their plans for good.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: No, I wasn't expecting to meet you.
We?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Don't tell me you're pulling out at this point?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: If you are, I may have to wipe my true identity from your head by force...
Please go easy on me…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: It was a joke. Anyway, I should thank you... Because of you, I was able to accomplish far more and save many more lives than I imagined.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You feel different. I have the feeling I can always trust your words, whatever you say.
Do you mean it?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hehe... Well, take a guess?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Oh, and lastly… There is another thing I should thank you for. For trusting me all the way till the very end.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Until we meet again, Rover… Perhaps I'll meet you under an entirely different identity next time.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: My order was to oversee our deal with the Fractsidus.

When you meet Yinlin again, she tells you that the Dollmaker attempted to extract your memories but failed. The cause of your memory loss is far more complex than you thought. She thanks you for your help and coyly suggests that your next meeting may be under a completely different guise.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: You were just a pawn in my plan to find where Lirong kept the puppets.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: But I didn't expect him to try and escape with them. Couldn't risk exposing myself yet, so I had to track him down and retrieve the puppets.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Around that time, Dollmaker caught wind of your special abilities. He asked me to bring you to that safe house.
You zapped me a little too hard back there.

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: You there… You're not one of us. How did you sneak in here?!

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: But Master Dollmaker, he… he told me to protect this place at all cost.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: That won't be necessary... Master Dollmaker's not coming back. I'll be getting rid of everything here.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Master Dollmaker's ultimate goal is near, and he won't need them anymore... Neither will I.

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: But…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Enough… You heard what I said. Stay put, I'll go fetch some first-aid for you.
Yinlin heads off to retrieve some medicine from Dr. Wu Sheng.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Quxiu, are you injured?

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: Miss Yinlin!? You're back!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Easy there. You need to rest…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: This is Master Dollmaker's guest. You're safe with {Male=him;Female=her}.

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: It is my duty to protect our people... I'll be fine.
Those are no small wounds.

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: I'm fine... Ugh...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: No more duties if you died from those wounds... We no longer need you to protect this place, remember?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Yuanyuan!
Do you want to lose your daughter again?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Urgh… Gah… No, I... Fine, I'll leave it to you.
Do you know him?
Now, hand over the girl…
You see, that man is her father. Why do you want to separate them?
He is dangerous…
Oh well, whatever. Yuanyuan? Come over here please?

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Yes...
Good girl. Stay here, Yuanyuan.
What did you do!?
Stop, you're going to injure her.
And why would you be concerned? Smart {Male=boys;Female=girls} know how to mind their own business.
Oh? You're quite the fighter… Hmm, how about…
We're not fighting now? I can go on if you want.
Shh... They're coming… It's the Patrollers. We can't let them find out about Yuanyuan.
Now if you don't want to get into trouble, better do as I say... I'll explain everything later.
Including what's happening with the "Séance Society"…
Fine.
No.
Smart choice...
Oh, don't be so pigheaded. What if I pinned the blame on you?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Shut up! Take your hands off her NOW!
Say, for trying to abduct this little girl? You'll have a real time talking your way out of that... Right, Yuanyuan?

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: Yes, Miss Yinlin...
(Guess I'll have to do as she said, for now.)
Good. Now come give me a hand. We'll need to hide the traces of fighting here.

A mysterious woman arrives and convinces Lirong to leave. After he departs, a fight breaks out between you and the woman over Yuanyuan. The confrontation only ends when a Patroller shows up. To uncover the truth about the Séance Society and the missing persons, you decide to cooperate with the woman, starting by cleaning up the scene.

speaker: Viên Viên
anh_en: No! Daddy! *screams*
That's enough, Lirong.

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Urgh…!?
She'll be safe in my care. You still have other things to do, remember?

speaker: Lễ Vinh
anh_en: Huff... Ugh... No! Don't! Yuanyuan!
Lirong!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This should deactivate the alarms on the lower levels…

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Good. Those Exiles can't reach us now.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Master Dollmaker's chamber is right up ahead... Don't die on me now.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: So many prototype puppets... How many secrets does this factory hold?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Here, record the physical status of these puppets. Master needs to know for his research.

speaker: Con Rối Cơ Khí "Huyền Ty"
anh_en: (These are his prized achievements. We need photos of them to prove what he's been up to.)
As you wish.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Hmph. That's more like it. Remember to capture every detail. I'll be watching you.
Yinlin reminds you to use your Terminal to record the prototype puppet data.

speaker: Exile Commoner
anh_en: Intruder!! Kill her!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Tsk… They can't even recognize me now.
What's the plan?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Plan? We take them out, of course.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We can't stay here too long… Make it quick.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (I should check this place out while Yinlin's gone. Might find something about that Dollmaker.)

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: Urgh… Damn those monsters...

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: Anyway... I'll still be keeping them safe. Miss Yinlin said she'll get rid of everything here, but I believe they still retain some importance to her and Master Dollmaker.
Did the Tacet Discords injure you?

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: We've fought off quite a lot of them lately. I just got a bit careless.
Do they come at your camp often?

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: Some of us said they could be attracted to the puppets…

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: I don't believe that though. I'll defend this place, no matter what.
Why are you guarding this place?

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: I don't know... This place sounded super important to Master Dollmaker. He told me to protect it with my life.

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: But... Indeed, he hasn't visited this place for a long time now... Maybe Miss Yinlin was right...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: That should do the trick…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Is it the handiwork of one of the children back there?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Or… a memory of an adult member's youth?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (This... It reads like the writing of a Patroller undercover.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (But why is it here? Is the Dollmaker doing business with one of the Patrollers?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (The Dollmaker has been delving into his Forte, trying to make a certain puppet.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Whose puppet is he trying to create?)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (What did she want to tell the Dollmaker... Guess I'll never know.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (The message is still here, which means it probably never reached the Dollmaker.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Yinlin will be back at any moment now.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (I should go back to Quxiu.)
After a while, Yinlin came back with some first-aid supplies to treat Quxiu's wounds.
No, I haven't.
You seem to enjoy meddling in other people's business...
You're really not a good liar, I'll give you that...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: On second thought, the past can't be erased anyway.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Burning these makes no difference, and the flames could attract Tacet Discords.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Still, Quxiu, you should leave this place. We don't need you to protect these anymore.

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: What if those monsters come at us again? We'll have no one to stop them!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Your safety matters far more than these objects of the past. If you're okay, go help those who aren't.

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: Understood!

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: This should do it. If it still hurts, go to Dr. Wu Sheng for a detailed checkup.

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: Thank you, Miss Yinlin! It's just a scratch... Nothing to worry about.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Go find somewhere safe to rest. You're relieved of your duties.

speaker: Khúc Tú
anh_en: But Miss Yinlin...

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: We're burning it all. Stand back, I'll use my thunder to start up a fire... No trace will be left.
You sure you want to do this? I think you may regret it.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Oh? So you've read what's written inside?
Yes, I have.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Yes?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Should I ask Yinlin about it?)
You found anything?
(Nevermind...)

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: See those flowers? Don't you think they look out of place here?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Try counting them. I have a feeling that may be the passcode. (4, 1, 2, 3)

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I just remembered there's another place we need to visit. Come with me.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Relax. Nothing's going to happen to you... Not yet, at least.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Looks like a child's diary...)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (There's a crude drawing folded inside, with some scribbled words on the back.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Everything's back to where they were before…

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Found a piece of paper inside one of the boxes. Seems like a transaction record.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Date of transaction... It says today. Items... 4 Reincarnation Puppets. What are those?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Signee... "Lirong". Probably forgot to take it with him.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Done... Here's hoping they'll get my message.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Now, how do I get out of here...)

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Oh, you're awake? Come out then.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: That's the total number of prototype puppets... Imagine what would happen if they're all activated at once.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: All puppets are powered by these metal canisters... That's why non-Resonators can activate the puppets.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Military-grade mechs... How did they get their hands on these?

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: Strange. The path is blocked. That thing should open it back up. I'll handle it.

speaker: Ngâm Lâm
anh_en: I can't get through here. But "Zapstring" should be able to get under it.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Daddy, are we waiting for someone?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yes, honey. We're expecting a new member...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: There, Yuanyuan... Are you hurt?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No, Miss Yinlin. My body is fully functional.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I will not let those puppets fall into Fractsidus hands!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I think I've lost them...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: No signs of injuries on Yuanyuan. That woman wasn't controlling her through Resonance Abilities, either.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Then why is Yuanyuan obeying her commands...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I should be safe at this point.

speaker: Hà Xương
anh_en: No need to tip-toe around me, I know I'm a puppet. I'm just happy to see Jinlu again.
You're surprisingly open-minded about it.

speaker: Hà Xương
anh_en: Well, as a dead guy, I try not to overthink things anymore.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Greetings, Miss Yinlin. Back already?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Yeah, just bringing this {Male=boy;Female=girl} in.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey, bud... Wanna grab a drink tonight?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Haha, nah, I know you can't handle much.

speaker: Tấn Lục
anh_en: Want one?
I'll pass... Go easy on it, okay?

speaker: Tấn Lục
anh_en: Don't worry. I don't drink when I'm on duty.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Don't wander off on your own, okay?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I know, Mom. I'm not going anywhere.
Come help me cover up the traces.
While you don't look like the typical upstanding citizen, I doubt you would want any extra trouble.

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: We're old and no use to anyone. And we can't run anymore...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I'm Zani, from Averardo Vault.

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: Run...

Hubert is convinced that Talos is unstoppable: the miserable fate of the Black Alley residents has been sealed, and this place will continue to be a haven for criminals like Talos. On the contrary, Colleen believes that you and Zani hold the key to bringing about change. Determined to avenge its residents and eradicate the criminals dwelling within once and for all, you head out towards the depths of the Black Alley.

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: That's...that's where little Colleen was supposed to go...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Yes. It was Ms. Colleen who reached out to us. That's why we're here.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: According to the Employee Manual, Protocol 8, we're obligated to help members with any problems they run into while onboarding.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Since Ms. Colleen passed the assessment, but can't begin her duties because of outside factors...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: We're required to activate Protocol 8 and help her solve the issue at hand.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Ms. Zani...

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: Little Colleen, is this true?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Huh? Y-yeah, it is.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Ms. Zani is incredible... She... she could flip over a Gondola with one finger if she wanted!

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: It's not so bad, lying here... easier than getting up and finding help.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: She showed us some wild stuff during the assessment.

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: But Talos's Echo is not something to be taken lightly...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'll be there too.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: That's right! The Laureate is here too! Hubert, you missed it before!

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: {Male=He;Female=She} took down Cetus the Tidebreaker singlehandedly! Sent it right back where it belonged! Even stronger than the Blazing Nightwalker!

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: Thank you... Thank you so much...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Colleen, I'm leaving this in your hands.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Use my Terminal to contact the Montellis and get them here. You'll be able to track their location with it as well.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: {PlayerName}, looks like I'll have to go back on what I said.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I was planning to do just enough to get it done...

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: Life here hasn't been easy...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But now, I've got no choice but to go all in.

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: If it weren't for Talos, you'd already be long gone from this place.

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: You passed the Vault's hiring test. It was those thugs that forced you back.

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: It's always the same. One Talos goes, then another takes its place.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Another one...

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: Leave this place... You deserve a stable home.

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: ...Who a—
You move the injured individuals to higher ground, where Colleen administers emergency aid to them.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Which one should I pick?
I thought they promised you a vacation?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Yeah... Still about the stuff from last time.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Actually, a lot of the family's staff have been running into the same kind of trouble as that night.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: They're not anything special on their own.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: What matters is... a lot of the family's employees have been running into the same kind of trouble as that night.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: A vacation is like an ad. Only the ones dishing it out have the power to make it real or fake.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: And recently, a lot of the family's employees have been running into the same kind of trouble as that night.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Guess my vacation will just have to be postponed again.
What if I help you apply for it next time?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Hmm... Maybe that could work.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Hmm... I'll take all of them. One of each, please.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So, where should we start?
First, tell me what you need help with.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: As I mentioned before, many people working for the Montellis have been victims of attempted thefts, like last night.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The family has tightened security, but just sitting here waiting won't solve anything.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: As for the ones we caught... they haven't been chatty. Plus, they've only committed a few small-time crimes.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So it would be tricky to use... more extreme methods on them. If we do, it could give the wrong people a chance to twist the situation.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: You mentioned someone asked for your help earlier, right?
You want to locate her?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: We've been trying but haven't found anyone who matches her description yet. She's probably keeping a low profile.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But right now, she might be the only lead we've got.
A bit hard on digestion, no?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So, might I ask you play your face card one more time?
Seems it's up to me again.
For the ice cream, I guess I can't say no.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Much appreciated.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Maybe some more then?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: We'll do it tonight. It will be in your hands.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Feel free to rest until it's time. I've already made arrangements at a hotel.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: You know what. I'll be here for a while. If you have any questions, just ask away.
Do I need to prepare anything?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Everything is taken care of.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}, you made it. Let's sit over there and talk.
You ordered too much.

You meet Zani near the ice cream cart in Ragunna. She shares with you that many of the Montelli family's staff have previously run into the same kind of trouble as that night. Zani asks for your assistance in locating the help-seeker, which is crucial to resolving the deadlock in this complicated case.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I wasn't sure what you liked. It was too hard to choose, so I just got one of each flavor.
I took you for more of a coffee person.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Work is bitter enough as it is. Why drink something bitter on top of that?
Things not going well?
Those two thieves give you more trouble than expected?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Should I head straight for the hotel, or dig a little deeper first?)

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Something you wanted to talk about?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: To make things worse, they forced a lot of vagrants into their ranks, using them as tools for their dirty work.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Their eyes and ears were everywhere. The Order tried several times to wipe them out, but each time they came up empty.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Then one day, the Chamber of Discipline managed to catch the ones pulling the strings—they were found tied up and served on a platter. That's when the Black Alley taken down.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: As for the Blazing Nightwalker... and Talos, that's the names the Black Alley gave them.
I have another question.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Talos... that was what the Black Alley called their leader.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Word is, Talos might not even be a single person. Whoever is on top gets the title of "Talos."
There must have been quite a few "Taloses" over the years.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: That's right. They had a brutally efficient way of picking the leader. Whoever was the strongest got the crown.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But this title should have died with the Black Alley.
Ask about the Black Alley.
I have another question.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The Blazing Nightwalker was just one of many dramatic titles around Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ragunna once went through a hell of a time. The Order was hit with major losses, including many of their best. The chaos lasted for quite a while.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Back then, nights weren't as quiet as they are now. There were always some poor civilians getting hassled by criminals.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Then someone elusive gradually caught people's attention. They took down those criminals and disappeared right after saving the civilians.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: They never revealed their name, so the people started calling them the Blazing Nightwalker.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The last time anyone saw them was when they took down Talos and the rest of the Black Alley higher-ups.
I have another question.
Ask about Talos.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Best to get some rest now. Work starts later.
Before getting some rest in, you decide to inquire Zani for more information about the case. Seeing that she has experienced past events, she might help you piece together some parts of the puzzle.
Ask about the Blazing Nightwalker.
That will be all.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ragunna once went through a hell of a time. The Order was hit with major losses, including many of their best. The chaos lasted for quite a while.
You mean... the Second Dark Tide.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Yes. The Order is by no means above reproach, but you cannot deny they keep Ragunna stable.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The Black Alley was born when that stability fell apart. Criminals from every corner banded together, and law-abiding citizens paid the price.

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: Hello there, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName}

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: I had an entire month's earnings on me!
What does the Blazing Nightwalker look like?

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: Well… It all happened so quickly, and it was dark, so I didn't get a proper look.

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: All I saw were a pair of blazing eyes. Guess that was where the name came from, eh?
I see.

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: Very well, I'll show you to your room.

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: Of course. You are always welcome to stay with us.

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: Ms. Zani has already reserved a room for you. Ready to check in?
Have you heard of the Blazing Nightwalker?
I'm ready to check in.
I have other matters to attend to.

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: You've come to the right person.

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: I was once saved by the Blazing Nightwalker myself. Ragunna wasn't nearly as peaceful back then as it is now.

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: I was heading home later than usual when I ran into some Black Alley brutes.

speaker: NPC #200117
anh_en: If it hadn't been for the Blazing Nightwalker, I'm sure they would have robbed me blind.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Any nibbles you're hankerin' for today?
Have you heard of the Blazing Nightwalker?

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Oh, I've heard some of the patrons talkin' about em'! Sounds like someone who can really give a good thrashin', eh?

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: But those who got a beatin' were bullying thugs, taking the weak for a ride. Honestly, they probably had it comin'.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: But that's all from ages ago. Ye know, they say the Blazing Nightwalker only frequented the dodgy areas anyway.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Since the city's been safer, I don't hear much about 'em anymore.

speaker: NPC #200118
anh_en: Honored Laurate, may I be of service?

speaker: NPC #200118
anh_en: It was a special time in the city's history. What the Nightwalker did still stirs debate to this day. Everyone has their own theories.

speaker: NPC #200118
anh_en: Some of my brethren believe their actions overstepped the bounds of the Order's teachings.

speaker: NPC #200118
anh_en: But when you look at the results, they clearly align with the Sentinel's will of salvation.
Have you heard of the Blazing Nightwalker?

speaker: NPC #200118
anh_en: Ah, yes... I remember the stories from long ago.

speaker: NPC #200118
anh_en: Back then, the Order had yet to recover from the devastation of the Second Black Tide, and our peacekeeping forces were stretched thin.

speaker: NPC #200118
anh_en: In those neglected corners of the city, crime took root and chaos spread like wildfire.

speaker: NPC #200118
anh_en: That was when this righteous figure first made their presence known.

speaker: NPC #200118
anh_en: The Chamber of Discipline received criminals bound and left at our doorstep every day. However, the Blazing Nightwalker vanished without a trace.

speaker: NPC #200118
anh_en: I suppose, once the situation improved, they faded into the shadows. May the Sentinel bless them.
You seem to hold this figure in high regard.
So, you leave the hotel and decide to wander around before the operation starts.
The family's approach this time.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: A lot of people were targeted, but in the end, they only sent you to handle it?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: If we send too many people, we risk tipping our hand.
Why not tell The Order?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Well, the Chamber of Discipline did catch a few perps, but they're not quick to act without solid proof.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: And... some of the higher-ups in the Order might just be happy to see the Montellis having a little trouble.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The biggest issue I find is...
You actually volunteered for extra work?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Really? That's the biggest issue you find?
There's probably something you're not telling me, isn't there?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: {PlayerName}? It's not time yet. Aren't you going to rest a little longer?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Alright, alright... You've got sharp instincts. Spending too much time with you, and I'm running out of secrets.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I was the one who delivered Talos and those Black Alley leaders to The Order.
What?!
I knew it all along.
The Blazing Nightwalker... So is it the Rinascitan tradition to have a moniker?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Yeah, that's me... the Blazing Nightwalker. But honestly? I really don't want to keep repeating that name.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: By tradition, shouldn't you have revealed your true identity at the end?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Oh, you're talking about the stories where, after a lot of hardship and misunderstanding, one side lets the truth out with their last breath, leaving the other to regret it forever?
Where did you read that?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I've got my own ways to keep entertained.
Aren't you?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Hiding my true identity got old fast. Since you were curious, I might as well just tell you.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: After all, you're not someone I can't trust, right?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Well, as you have already known, I am the Blazing Nightwalker... though I really wish I didn't have to keep repeating that name.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Honestly, it's a bit of a burden...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Oh, and by the way, after you became the Laureate, they're giving you all sorts of monikers too.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The family sent me to handle this, partly because they didn't want a big operation to stir things up, and partly because... well, it was a strategic move.
Hard for me to imagine you all fired up like that once.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I have to say it again, I never called myself that.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Back then, I was just doing what needed to be done. Never planned on picking up a fancy nickname.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It's hard to imagine that name suiting you now.
Can't sleep anyway.
What happened?
Did work change you?
You seem to have lost a spark.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Well, that's what work does to you...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Do you think this "Talos" is the real deal then?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: ...Not sure. Could just be the same old story repeating itself.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's call it a cleanup job.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: If things go smoothly, maybe we can grab a late-night snack after, hmm?
I'll go all in then.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I don't think this is serious enough to give it your all.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I am resting, alright?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Just do enough to get it done. But keep some of that enthusiasm for the snacks later, hm?

You wake up in the middle of the night and find it difficult to fall back to sleep, so you decide to take a walk. To your surprise, you run into Zani, who also struggles to fall asleep. As you chat away, you uncover her identity as the Blazing Nightwalker. Zani was the one who once defeated that formidable gang.
You take some rest in your room. By the time you wake up, you realize you haven't slept much.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I'm afraid I can't help you with that.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Insomnia and I go way back.
I have a few questions.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: What about?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: It's almost time. Let's split up and prepare for the ambush.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's see if we can catch them in the act.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Zani is clearly doing more than just "enough to get it done," but I'll hold off on mentioning it for now.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Someone's making moves. But they just seem to be petty thieves.

speaker: NPC #50071
anh_en: Got it. You're clear to act when you see fit.

speaker: NPC #50071
anh_en: I'll watch your back and keep an eye out for anyone trying to shadow you.
You wait on the roof for some time. As you anticipated, several suspicious men begin to appear.

speaker: NPC #200113
anh_en: What's taking you so long?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A flurry of panicked sounds echo in the distance, and the sense of being watched fades.
Zani?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: {PlayerName}？

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Do you know what these two were up to?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: They were babbling about "hostages" and "feints," and then they came at me.
They were trying to break into someone's home.
Let's just say they forgot to bring their house key.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: And they just ran after taking one look at you, hm? Seems about right.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Thieves, you mean? I can imagine why they were fleeing like that.
They said it was "Black Alley" business.

speaker: NPC #200113
anh_en: If we don't bring back the goods, the boss will have our heads！
Have you heard that name before?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I have. But that name… it's already...

speaker: NPC #800260
anh_en: You there! What's going on here?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Just two thieves. Took care of them. I was about to deliver them to the <te href=800005>Chamber of Discipline</te> myself.

speaker: NPC #800260
anh_en: What about {Male=him;Female=her}?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Same as you, drawn here by the sound of a scuffle.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I know the rules. I'll go with you, make the report, and be done with it.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let me handle this. You'd rather not deal with their questions, hm?
Someone else was also there. She asked for my help.
But she ran away.
Am I interrupting something?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So there was somebody else...

speaker: NPC #800260
anh_en: Right, you'll come with me to the Chamber then.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: This might be more complicated than it looks. Will you wait for me?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: This won't take long.

In the streets of Ragunna, you come across a group of thieves who claim to be from the "Black Alley." Before you catch up to them, Zani appears and stops them in their tracks. She proposes escorting the thieves to the Chamber of Discipline with the patrolling Acolytes and making a statement. Meanwhile, you decide to stay behind to investigate a mysterious person calling for help.

speaker: NPC #200113
anh_en: Ugh... Oi, best keep your nose out of our business. We're with the Black Alley.

speaker: NPC #200114
anh_en: Idiot! {Male=He's;Female=She's} got the stance of a skilled fighter. We need to move!
Who's there?
Excuse me, I… I need your help.

speaker: Giọng Nói Quen Thuộc
anh_en: Hey, what's got you two running scared?
Huh?!

speaker: NPC #200119
anh_en: Figured someone was waiting for us. But you walked right into it, didn't ya?

speaker: NPC #200119
anh_en: Alright, boys! Let's put 'em down!

speaker: NPC #50071
anh_en: Need a hand?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I've got it covered.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Right, let's get this done quickly.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: This way.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Uh-oh, things just went south. Looks like we've got a fight on our hands.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Watch out.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Well done.

speaker: NPC #200119
anh_en: Ugh... You hit harder than I thought...
Stop resisting. Just surrender!

speaker: NPC #200119
anh_en: Well, my boss gave me this—!
Zani.

speaker: NPC #50071
anh_en: Let's move in. Now!

speaker: NPC #200120
anh_en: Blimey, how the hell are you movin' so quick?!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Looks like we'll have to drag him back. We'll get answers sooner or later.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: A shame this one's only good for squealing. He's not the one we're after.
Is it... me you're looking for?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: My name is Colleen... Please, help me and my friends.

After defeating the gang members, one manages to escape and takes Bakie from Trattoria Margherita as hostage. Just when the situation seems dire, Zani arrives in time and takes him out. And the mysterious help-seeker finally reveals themselves.

speaker: NPC #50066
anh_en: *Beep*—*Beep*!
Put Bakie down. Now!
Stop this pointless resistance!

speaker: NPC #200120
anh_en: Not a chance! It's my hostage now... This is an Echonapping, you hear!

speaker: NPC #200120
anh_en: Ha! Ain't no way you'll do somethin' stupid while I'm holding this Echo!

speaker: NPC #50066
anh_en: Beep! Beep!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Hey! Don't be causing trouble for folks who need their breakfast bright and early.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Alright, start talking. Where's your hideout? Who's the one really calling the shots?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Before we go any further, shouldn't you explain who you are first?
What did she do to you?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: She came in claiming this place was hers since they owned it before.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Told us, if we wanted to stay, we had to follow her rules. No other choice.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Steal, lie, cheat, rob... same as the old days. Give her your tribute, or... or you get a beating.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: A fish that slipped the net...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Sounds just like how the Black Alley ran things... But do people actually accept her as the acting Talos?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Some people did. They wanted to, you know? The ones with the dirty hands already. They were easy.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: But the main reason is that no one can stand up to her...
Is she that strong?
Why?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I'm from the Black Alley...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Colleen doesn't answer your question, instead she looks at Zani with a conflicted and wary expression.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I'll wait outside.
No.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: {PlayerName}？

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Colleen, if you can't trust my friend, then I can't offer you my help.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Trust goes both ways. You can't ask for help with one hand while holding a knife with the other.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The operation is a wrap. Bring the ones we caught in and then everyone can call it a day.

speaker: NPC #200121
anh_en: Got it, Ms. Zani. Any leads on your side?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: No, nothing to report.
So you are one of them too?

speaker: NPC #200121
anh_en: Ah, looks like we'll have to try again tomorrow.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: It's just us now. Anything else bothering you while I'm at it?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: A Terminal... Talos also has a Terminal. It lets her transform into a powerful Echo.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So that's it. You are worried the Terminal was supplied by someone from the Montelli family, aren't you?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: That's why you doubt us and prefer to put your faith in a wayfaring Laureate, hm?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I'm sorry...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: There's no need to apologize. You're a victim in this, with every right to be suspicious.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So then, {PlayerName}, what do you think we should do?
What's your take? It's your job, after all.
I can't ignore someone who's asking for help.
You don't exactly look like you're in the same business.
I want to see how powerful this Echo really is.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: *Sigh*... Who told everyone to call it a day again?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: As an employee of the Montelli family, I have an obligation to stop any Terminals from being misused.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I'll just have to ask the boss for double overtime pay and an extra vacation after this.
Great, but have you spent the vacation you got last time?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Are you really bringing up something so depressing now?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Thank you, thank you both!

The mysterious help-seeker, Colleen, admits she is from the Black Alley, a place that was once home to the homeless but is now seized by Talos and her gang. Colleen warns that Talos possesses a Terminal of unknown origin. You and Zani are determined to stop Talos from exploiting its power.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: No, no, no... The Black Alley is more than just the gang! It's the place too.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The entrance to the Black Alley is shut. It's done.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: You're right, Talos destroyed it. But there's another way in...

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: It used to be a home for vagrants like us. A few scraps, a couple of jobs... just enough to get by.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: But then she came, and it all went up in smoke...

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Talos has us blindfolded whenever we leave the Black Alley. Keeps us from knowing the new entrance. A runner takes us to the meeting spot.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I'll take you to him.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: That's his hideout. Over there.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: He's a slippery one. One wrong move, and he'll be gone, off in a Gondola before you can blink.
We can use that to our advantage.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Looks like we're thinking the same thing.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I'll cause a distraction up front. Leave the show to me.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: And you'll move to checkmate.
Following the plan, you move to the rear of the hideout. You signal Zani to initiate the operation once in position.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Same as usual. Just another day's work.

speaker: NPC #200122
anh_en: Wait, wait! Wait, wait! You're after the Black Alley's entrance, aren't you?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The family is almost on site. They can handle the cleanup.
I haven't said a word yet...

speaker: NPC #200122
anh_en: I know my value to people.

speaker: NPC #200122
anh_en: Now that you've got me, no point in resisting. The longer I hold out, the more pain I'm asking for.

speaker: NPC #200122
anh_en: Smart people know when to give in. It's how I stayed alive.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: {PlayerName}, have you got him?
Yeah, and he's already talking.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So we won't need to "help" him talk after all.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Once he coughs up the entrance location, we'll head straight there from here.
With the description the runner provided, you find the Black Alley's entrance.
The Blazing Nightwalker is no joke.
Giving someone a lecture? Are you sure you're Zani?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ugh, don't call me that.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Believe me, I'd kill to be in a bed right now instead of standing out here.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's get this over with.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I'm praying it doesn't reek in there.
Please don't point that out right now.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Don't worry. It may be an underground waterway, but it's been abandoned for a long time now.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: It's not exactly clean, but it's livable. We did some work on it.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: The pipes are a maze, though. They split up the territory by rank...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Might be a bit late to ask, but… Colleen, you did what Talos asked, didn't you?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Talos is holed up somewhere deep in the waterway.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Demons always live in hell, like the Primus always stays in the Cathedral. Yeah, that's about right.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Oh, and {PlayerName}, masks on.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The mask makes things a lot easier.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: It's better if neither of us gets recognized too easily.
Fair point, but...

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: H-hey… I'll pretend I don't know who you are!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Guess I don't need to spell it out for you.
Following the runner's route, you locate the hidden entrance to the Black Alley and confront Talos to put an end to this once and for all.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I didn't...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Did you forget what {PlayerName} said? Trust goes both ways.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I… I didn't have a choice! If I didn't, they'd... they'd...you know, hurt me!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Then when the time comes, make sure you tell the Chamber of Discipline everything. No lies.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: But… but I…

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Don't excuse yourself by saying you were forced into it. Can you do that?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Fine... I get it.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (While I wait for Zani, maybe I should search the area where that voice came from. )

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The way ahead should be under the cistern.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: ...Wait, we're swimming down there?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I think there's a drainage switch in the next room.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let's check it out then.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What's this?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: It's a Sequence Mechanism. You need to hit it hard to get it to work.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Vagrants like us aren't much for heavy lifting, so... it's been stuck like this forever.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: If we turn the statues to face the right direction, it'll open up the water lock.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: How do we know what's the right direction?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Uh… never actually been here before, so…

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Let me think… I know there must be something that can help.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: If we've got nothing else, we'll go with gut instinct.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Statues are usually meant to be appreciated. Turning them to face a wall? That's just wrong.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's try pointing them all toward the center.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Worth a shot.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Remember anything yet?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Oh, yeah… After the water lock opened last time, I heard them talking when they left…

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: They said it felt really weird with all those eyes watching them.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I hope that helps.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So all we needed to do was make them face the center... so simple as if it were a joke.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Well, looks like we found the way. Let's move.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Watch out.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Ugh...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You good?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Yeah, thanks. You saved me there.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: It's been a while since I've been down here... Forgot about that part.

speaker: NPC #200123
anh_en: Who—who's there… *Hic*!

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Not just to make sure we don't run, but to search us, check if we're carrying anything valuable.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Some got caught with stuff after a few rounds of searching, and... well... let's just say their fingers didn't stay intact.
If only we found this place sooner...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Don't waste time on what-ifs. Talos has a debt to pay for all of this.
While in the Black Alley, you meet a drunken thug, but he ignores you completely. Colleen explains that Talos has being extremely cruel to her men.

speaker: NPC #200123
anh_en: One, two, three… four, five, six… seven, eight, nine… so many unfamiliar faces...

speaker: NPC #200123
anh_en: You win, I give up... No, I didn't see a single thing...

speaker: NPC #200123
anh_en: Ugh… hhh… blech...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So this is who Talos is hiring now?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Heh... He's probably one of those who don't actually buy her story. That's why they tossed him out here.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Still... this place usually has more than just one person on guard...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: More than one, you say?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Yeah, they usually keep a few posted around here.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: This place was supposed to be abandoned. Why's this thing still running?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'll just go smash it.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Be careful. There might be an ambush waiting for you.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Plus, with this wind? You won't stand a chance if you're not heavy enough to hold your ground.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Luckily my shield should do the trick. You two, get behind me.
Talos has fixed up a device in the tunnel and uses it as a barricade to stop intruders and punish anyone who opposes her. Zani raises her shield as protection as you navigate through the tunnel.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Talos's people fixed it up.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: To keep people out?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Not just that...

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Talos doesn't stop anyone from challenging her. In fact, she tells them that if they beat her, they get to be the new Talos.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: The ones who try always lose to the Echo she transforms herself into.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Then she freezes their bodies and dumps them in this tunnel.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: She says it's to "calm them down."

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: That's... humor I don't understand.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: This thing should be able to turn off, right?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Yeah, the switch to stop it is up ahead.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Normally there's always someone guarding this. Strange... it's just like earlier...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: While I didn't exactly expect them to be model employees, I did expect a bit of crisis awareness.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Something is definitely off.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's pick up the pace.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Here it is, the switch to stop the blades.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Less explaining, more button pressing.
The ventilator has been turned off.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Right above is the Black Alley living quarters.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Not a soul in sight?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: This doesn't feel right... Even if the guards are slacking off, they should be getting their drink on somewhere around here.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: And the old folks like Hubert, they'd be stuck here, too.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So none of this has been normal from the start.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's check the area. There could be some traps.
Upon arriving at the living quarters of the Black Alley, you discover that it is empty. You begin searching the nearby areas for the residents.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The wine glass still has some cloudy liquid in it, and the water stains on the ground have not fully dried. It appears it was shattered not too long ago.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The stew still has a bit of warmth to it, and it seems like the person who was eating it only had time for a couple of bites.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: There are some drag marks on the floor, with a few faint fibers stuck to them. They appear to have come from someone's clothing.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: {PlayerName}, how's it going over there? Let's regroup and go over what we have.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Looks like they left by Gondola...)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The trail's gone cold. I'll wait for Zani to return.)

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The conclusion I've come to is simple. Everyone here was dragged off somewhere.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: And where did they go?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Pft, the Order toots their horn over every achievement, big or small.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: This quiet, low-profile approach isn't their style.
What about...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: That's an optimistic guess.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But those footprints would look a lot less orderly.
What about...

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: Ugh... Finally. Just a couple of old timers, but still a bloody weight.

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: When the rest of the boys are back, we'll get 'em shifted.
Looks like we have a new lead.
Same on my side.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Indeed we do.

After gathering clues from the area, you realize that the residents of the living quarters was likely taken away against their will, to which you suspect by Talos. Out of nowhere, several gang members show up, and you decide to confront them for answers.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I found a sign my friend left behind... I think it's telling us to run.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: They must've been in real trouble!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But what kind of trouble are we talking about?
Talos.
The Chamber of Discipline.
What if they just took the opportunity to escape?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: That's probably the best guess. But why would Talos move them in the first place?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Where is everyone? And where is Talos?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: And the others who were here?

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: I don't know...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Tell me.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The people...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Where did they go?

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: I... I can't!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: He'd rather knock himself out cold than talk?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: We'll have to get answers from Talos herself. Any more delays could spell trouble.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Colleen...

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I... I'll lead the way.

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: Who the hell are you lot?!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: No. You're staying here.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Why?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: We didn't meet much resistance to make it where we are now.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: If they haven't left, then we'll be up against a lot more enemies ahead. It's risky for you to keep going.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This is what you're thinking, right?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I... I need to find Hubert and the others. And I have to lead, or else you might go the wrong way.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: No. The stakes of these two things aren't the same.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Hubert and the others... they've always looked out for me. The only way I can help them is to get you to Talos as quickly as possible.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: I've never been powerful, but I've got my ways of making myself useful.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Even if I can just buy you a little more time, it'll be worth it, right?

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: Colleen? Yeah so the boss was right. You lot are pathetically useless!
I'll keep her safe.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Taking everything on yourself will wear you out eventually.
You're right, but not today.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: ...Guess there's no point trying to change your mind.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I'm counting on you.

You defeat the gang members and extract Talos's current location from them. However, they refuse to disclose the whereabouts of the residents and even go as far as to knock themselves out to prevent giving you further information. Sensing there might be danger, Colleen decides to search for the residents despite Zani's objections.

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: Didn't think you'd be so quick to sell your master and go find some little helpers.

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: Got a short memory, eh? Now that your nails are back, you think you're so tough?

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: Just wait till Talos gets her hands on these two. We'll see how many lives you've got left, ugh!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Perfect timing. Why don't you tell us where she is?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: We'll spare her the trouble and walk right into the net ourselves.

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: She's... she's in the storage area behind the trapdoor.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The wind is stronger than before.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Again, stay behind me.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Watch your step.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: No worries, I've got this...

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Ah!

speaker: NPC #200125
anh_en: Watch out!
...Zani?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I should have known...
Is that... little Colleen?

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Hubert!

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: Run... They said we might be exposed... Wanted to deal with us before everyone left.

speaker: NPC #200126
anh_en: Run...

At the end of the tunnel, you and Zani discover the residents taken by Talos. Though unconscious, none of them are seriously injured. Hubert explains Talos's motives for taking the residents: She was planning on escaping Black Alley before you could reach her.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Keep Colleen back there.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Huh, what is it?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Still breathing.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: This one too...

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: What's she doing over there?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: You can come over now.

speaker: NPC #200001
anh_en: Ah!!!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: They've all been thrown down here. Still breathing, but they need immediate treatment.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's get out of here first.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: It appears we can drain the water through the outlet on that spiral column.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But we'll need to open the hatch first... Let's smash it open. I'm not wasting any more time.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Did you take off your mask back there just to make them feel better?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Yes, or my words wouldn't have meant a damn thing.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Didn't think you'd bother with something like that.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Today is an exception.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So, Protocol 8 from the Employee Manual? You were lying through your teeth, weren't you?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Obviously. Who would do something so thankless and exhausting?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Isn't that what you're doing right now?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Just doing what you've been doing.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So, let's give those idiots a lesson they won't forget.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Make sure they never cause trouble for anyone else again.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Here. Sorry to keep you waiting.
Do you think those two were just a few stragglers?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Maybe. Or maybe they just wanted to spook you... but they picked the wrong person to mess with.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: You're still thinking about that person who asked for help, huh? Got any leads?
(Tell Zani what you discovered.)

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: You think she's in the same boat as those vagrants in the past? Forced into something they didn't choose?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}, you're the type who can't turn your back when someone asks for help.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: It's not too late. Got time for a detour?
Is it far from here?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The old entrance to the Black Alley.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: If they're crawling back from the ashes, we might find a clue or two at their old haunt.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Mmm... those Chamber of Discipline folk are as difficult to deal with as ever.
I've got time to spare, so where are we going?

You uncover some clues, but none lead you to the mysterious help-seeker. You decide to wait for Zani to return before continuing. After her return, she shares stories about a lone hero who single-handedly wiped out the Black Alley, a known criminal gang. This makes you suspect that the person might be connected to the Black Alley.
How did it go?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Well... you know how they are with the Montellis these days. No surprise they didn't share any interrogation details.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I told them the thieves claimed to be with the Black Alley, but the Chamber doesn't bother with rumors without solid proof.
What exactly is the Black Alley?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: A gang made up of criminals, although how many joined willingly is anyone's guess.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: A lot of vagrants were pressed into their service. Pawns in a game of crime.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The leadership got wiped out a few years ago by someone working solo. The leftovers? They were screwed. Some are still rotting in prison.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Come, follow me.

speaker: NPC #1588
anh_en: Keep alert.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: {PlayerName}, can I ask you for a favor?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You want to be the one to take down Talos?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Yes...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Alright. You do have an obligation to make sure the family's Terminals don't end up in the wrong hands.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: ...Making up the excuse for me, hm? Yeah. I've got a score to settle with that fish that slipped the net all those years ago.
Guess that means I'll get to see the Blazing Nightwalker in action.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Heh… Don't you start doing what the Ragunnesi do.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Not here.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Stick to the plan.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I've got this. The rest is on you.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: On to the next.

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: ...Looking for me?

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: Seems my men have gotten quite the beating from you.

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: That uniform and crest... You the dogs the Montellis sent?

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: Anyway, none of that matters.

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: Heh, you just keep relying on that weapon!

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: How can this be... even Talos... has fallen?!

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: The strong will always prey on the weak. That will never change!

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: The Black Alley has its own rules, and I'm simply following them to keep things running smoothly!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Before you talk about rules... first learn not to make my life harder.

Zani defeats Talos, yet she attempts to justify her actions by asserting that she was merely adhering to the rules of the Black Alley. Using Talos's self-proclaimed rules against her, Zani then announces Talos's final judgment.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Look at me, coward!

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: No... please...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The strong prey on the weak. Isn't that what keeps the Black Alley running?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: What, never been on the brink of death? Too weak to beg for mercy?

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: Please... have mercy...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Shut up.

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: Wait, the blazing white hair... the scars all over you... No, it can't be...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let me tell you...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Weakling.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: If you've lost respect for the law...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Then fear me instead.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I'll be watching you.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: You can seek revenge or attempt another comeback... It doesn't matter.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: You will fail. I will make sure of it.

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: Ah... Ugh...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Now, what do you say?

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: I... I give up...

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: That hair... You're the Blazing Nightwalker, aren't you? Didn't you disappear years ago?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (No wonder she earned that name. The change is quite remarkable.)

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Funny. Talos should've disappeared years ago too.

speaker: NPC #200124
anh_en: Run... RUN!!!

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: Hey! Tch, you damn bastards!

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: Wait, wait! Blazing Nightwalker, I—

speaker: NPC #200127
anh_en: You know how it was back then. You should understand!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Thanks for the help.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's be on our way then.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Hmm... I'll ask my supervisor about that later.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: No uniform left... Guess I'll need to file for that too...
Head out now?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's go.
With everything settled, you and Zani leave the Black Alley behind.
I'm sure you'll return the favor one day.
It was worth it to see the Blazing Nightwalker with my own eyes.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The family's people should be here soon.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Want to slip away before they bombard us with questions?
What about the Terminal?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I've now got a good excuse to ignore my supervisor's calls.
Without a doubt.
Not applying for time off right away?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Protecting the rich...

speaker: Nữ tử
anh_en: Thank you! Thank you!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Thank you...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Have I ever thanked anyone so earnestly before?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: What was I thinking back then?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Wishing someone would stand up for me...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Right?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: ...I'll walk a little longer.

speaker: NPC #200129
anh_en: Who are you?

speaker: NPC #200129
anh_en: Mind your own damn business!

speaker: NPC #200129
anh_en: It was you yesterday...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Is not exactly the work I find meaningful.

speaker: NPC #200129
anh_en: Err...

speaker: NPC #200130
anh_en: Have you heard...

speaker: NPC #200130
anh_en: About that one?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The Blazing Nightwalker...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: How overdone...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Huh... time to work again.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But I get to slack off

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Nothing to complain about...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Late again...

speaker: Nữ tử
anh_en: Help!

speaker: NPC #200128
anh_en: Heh heh heh...

speaker: NPC #200128
anh_en: You're all out of luck, sweetheart!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Hey.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Anyway, that's the real story behind that ridiculous name.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Most people got it wrong, slapping that big name on me.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: It's just part of my routine. Like snoozing, eating, or keeping my hair and horns in check.
So, is taking down an entire gang also part of it?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I was alone back then. I didn't even bother hiding who I was.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: And that's when the trouble started to find me.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I thought, why wait for it to get worse? Better to finish it quickly.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But of course, I made it worse... Too fast, too soon.
So how did you deal with it back then?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The Montelli family reached out to me and offered to clean up the mess. Even said they'd back me up in the future.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So, I changed jobs. The work is the same. No difference.
I thought it would be a more elaborate story.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Disappointed?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Your instincts came from a good place. A fist might not be as sharp as a blade, but it can still break through deeply rooted problems.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And up close, it's gentle enough to protect what's important.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: So don't let today bother you.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: No, I'm not letting it bother me.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Cleaning up simple scum doesn't weigh on me.
So what you said back there...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Just reliving some old memories, that's all.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But you're right about something...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: What you said just now applies to you, too.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Not everything needs to be turned into some grand tale.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: The difference, though, is that you are a blade. A weapon that can break the cycle.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But you don't seem to realize it. Seeing you has brought some old feelings back to me.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Don't you see? Ever since you helped make the Carnevale happen, Ragunna's been different.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Things are busier now. There's more work, more opportunities.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I told you before that these routines are fragile. One bad move and they're gone, right?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: So... a stable environment is the only way to reduce the bad moves. That's the way we get to keep our routines.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I tried to do that for a long time, but you're the one who made it happen.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: With fewer bad actors on the streets these days, <ano=The Blazing Nightwalker>I</ano>... am increasingly irrelevant.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Perhaps one day, I'll finally be able to sleep through the night.
So, a few nights ago, you were also...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: In this city, it's mostly the same routine every day.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Of course. It was all part of the routine.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I've been thinking... It's a relief that someone like you is willing to step up.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Your potential is probably beyond what anyone can imagine...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Yet, you still insist on being responsible for everything, no matter how big or small.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Thank you. You've done well.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Ah, sorry... It's just a habit...
It's okay.
I'll take it if I can return the favor.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Hmm... Okay.
Ruffle her hair.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: How long can I snooze before I'm late...
Touch her horns.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Alright... that's enough.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Hey, you didn't say you were going to do that...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: By the way, this is for you.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: It used to be my weapon.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: You can take it as a token of silence, or as part of an agreement.
An agreement to do just enough to get it done?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Oh, as if I'd do that! That would just be getting in your way.

What made an ordinary Montelli employee become a hero with a dramatic alias? Was it for fame, a commitment to justice, or a desire for excitement in a ordinary life? Perhaps the truth lies deeper beyond...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Which time's best to line up to get a fresh wrap...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: How to sleep without lying in bed for hours...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: These little routines are fragile. One bad move and they're gone.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: But likewise, just one bold move is enough to bring them back.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: This is it. Just hit the right spot, and the trapdoor should open.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: What's on your mind?
How come you're so familiar with this?
You're not quite the same as you were during the daytime.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Mmm... I have some past experience...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: After all, it's not work hours now.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Let's focus on what's in front of us first.
The runner's men rush out in an attempt to overwhelm Zani with their numbers.
Meanwhile, you intercept the runner attempting to flee.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Aside from a few broken rocks, only silence greets your efforts.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Strange... my memory shouldn't be failing me, should it?

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: Who's causing trouble here?! Don't you know this is the Masked Brothers' turf?

speaker: NPC #200116
anh_en: B-Brother... they look tough...

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: What's there to be afraid of? We are the ones rebuilding the Black Alley!

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: Now, how about you hand over some coin, eh?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Well, that was a wasted trip.

You and Zani reach the entrance of the Black Alley, and attempt to unlock the trapdoor, but it won't budge. Right at that moment, two masked thugs confront you and announces their plans to rebuild the Black Alley before they attack you.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You pick up the drink Zani left behind. It's an energy drink you rarely see, advertised as capable of providing lasting energy.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: From what you know, most Vault employees rely on strong coffee to stay fresh.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This drink tastes fine and isn't bitter at all. Maybe Zani drinks it because she doesn't like something that's bitter. Or maybe...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A shocking thought crosses your mind: What if... it's because even the strongest coffee has no effect on Zani?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: No, no. That's not possible.
You board the Gondola and enjoy a pleasant day in Ragunna.
As night falls over the city, you get off the Gondola and notice two suspicious figures nearby...

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: Wait, mercy! We were blind. Please just let us go this time!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Perhaps... but the real question is why.

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: Then... everything's good now, right? We'll just be on our way.

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: Quietly...

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Is that all the nerve you've got? And you call yourselves the ones to bring back the Black Alley?

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: Well you got to have something to make folks fear you, right? One of you looks soft, and the other looks halfway worked to death... I liked my chances.
Shame you picked the wrong one.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: How many times have you pulled this off?

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: Not even once!!!

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Save the rest for the Chamber of Discipline.
Zani swiftly subdues the two would-be escapees.

speaker: NPC #200116
anh_en: Told you, didn't I? Told you they were tough! Why do you never listen to me?

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I'll keep digging into the Black Alley and what happened today.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: I'll let you know when I have something.
Okay.
You seem surprisingly motivated? That's not normal.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Well, after handing over those other two thieves, I learned they were targeting Montelli staff residences.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: Providing a safe working environment is part of my job description too.

speaker: NPC #1477
anh_en: It's getting late. We'll pick this up tomorrow, once I've got more to go on.

After defeating the masked thugs, they reveal that the entrance to the Black Alley was destroyed by a ruthless woman weeks ago. Zani escorts them to the Chamber of Discipline and will reach out to you in the following day.

speaker: NPC #200116
anh_en: Is this place cursed? Every time something happens, it's never good news.

speaker: NPC #200116
anh_en: Just like the last time...
Hold on. Last time?

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: Yeah, weeks ago. There was one hell of a racket. We thought the whole place was falling apart.

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: Turns out, it was a bloody terror of a woman. Saw us, didn't say a word, just pulled a blade on us.

speaker: NPC #200115
anh_en: We were lucky to get away. Took us two weeks to come back.
She's the one who wrecked the entrance, then?

speaker: NPC #50071
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I've got some updates on the situation.
