You receive contact from Zani, informing you that the thugs are led by a woman named Talos, who was believed to have vanished with the Black Alley years ago. Zani also mentions that the rumored hero behind Black Alley's takedown is referred to as the "Blazing Nightwalker." She then suggests you meet her in the city. You can sense her hesitation when mentioning that name.
You order some late night snacks at Trattoria Margherita and looks for a place to rest.
The next day, you get a call from Zani as you're wandering on the street.

speaker: NPC #50071
anh_en: The name of their leader—Talos.
I don't know that name.

speaker: NPC #50071
anh_en: Mmm... that name should've died along with the Black Alley years ago.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: You mentioned before that someone single-handedly wiped out the upper ranks of the Black Alley. Any idea who it was?

speaker: NPC #50071
anh_en: Well... the rumors call them... the "Blazing Nightwalker."
Come again?

speaker: NPC #50071
anh_en: The Blazing Nightwalker. Ugh, don't make me say it again.

speaker: NPC #50071
anh_en: If you're free, come by and we'll talk. There's something I could use your help with.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: The client has received the mine investigation report. We can wrap up this case. Thank you once again for your contribution!

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Now that you mention it, she seems perfect for this job! If she takes it, the client will be very pleased.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Thanks for bringing this up! We will make sure to contact her.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: But before you go, we have an art project that may be right for you if you're interested.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: The client seeks an artist to capture a few scenic spots, both photos and paintings will do.
Landscape painting... reminds me of someone.
I remember doing landscape paintings with Zhezhi.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: I met a painter called Zhezhi during the Moon-Chasing Festival. We had a blast at the festival.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: The first time I saw her, she was busy sketching scenery, so absorbed in her work that her mind was still on it when we talked.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: At the Moon-Chasing Festival, we worked together on a painting commission. Her brushwork was so exquisite and expressive.

speaker: Speaker_201_Title
anh_en: Oh, right! She helped out at the fan drawing stall during the festival. Her artwork was so popular, I couldn't get one myself.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Hey, Zhezhi! Long time no see! You need more pigments already?
Well, that's a bit too much...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes... Mr. Shilang is right. Rover, I've actually been meaning to tell you something.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hello, my name is Zhezhi. We have met before, but I'd like to make this a formal request. I would really like for us to become friends!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Of course, I'd be happy to.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Hey, what are you waiting for?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Eh? I... um... Okay! I can do this!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Um... Rober...

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: (That was a pretty obvious slip of the tongue...)

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Ahem! Nice to meet you, my name is Zhezhi. I'm... a painter. I take art commissions and strive to create beautiful paintings.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: And this must be the Rover! Nice to meet you. Heard a lot about you. Didn't realize you and Zhezhi knew each other.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I... I'm not being very articulate... b-but I hope we can be friends!
Hello, I'm {PlayerName}.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Haha, how sweet! I must say, I've never seen Zhezhi this nervous since she first became one of my cherished patrons.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: W-wait, Mr. Shilang! We're actually here today to talk about the tale of the Arcane Artist.
We met during the Moon-Chasing Festival.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Oh, I know the tale, but I've never come across this mystical maestro myself.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: If such an artist truly existed, I'd be the first to know, without a doubt!
Anything suspicious about the pigment buyers?

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Hmm... pigments aren't flying off the shelves these days. Just a few regulars, you know?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But I've never had the chance to introduce myself properly...

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: They bought heaps of leftover ore—the cheapest type—and told me not to let anyone know they got the ore here.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: People don't usually buy that stuff. Oh wait, Zhezhi, didn't you buy some once? A long time ago, right?

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: I remember you saying you couldn't afford the fancy pigments, so you made your own. That stuck with me.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: So when those guys asked for leftovers, I paid extra attention.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Are you sure you can tell us this? I thought they asked you to keep it a secret...

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Pft, they turned out to be thieves who stole from me during the night! When I found out, I reported the theft to the Patrollers and that was the end of it.
May I have a look at your transaction record?

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Of course. Help yourself.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: I supply ore to pigment manufacturers, and sometimes serve as their sales proxy, so most painters in Jinzhou come to my shop to buy pigments.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: N-no, not yet...

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Great moment for it! Here's the thing, Rover. I can't say I know Zhezhi very well, but I do know she's got this quirk where her courage tends to crumble right when it's crunchtime.
We're already friends.
What makes you say that?

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Oh... but those ore buyers from a while back, they seemed a bit suspicious.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Thieves don't deserve my business or respect.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Hello? Zhezhi?

With the merchant Shilang's encouragement, Zhezhi drums up the courage to ask to be your friend and is relieved by your response. To shift the conversation away from Shilang's friendly teasing, she mentions the Arcane Artist. You learn that some suspicious individuals had purchased heaps of leftover ore and even stole from Shilang at night. To confirm the details, you check Shilang's transaction records.

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: So, when it comes to introducing herself to you, I'd bet money on it she's been mentally rehearsing it for forever before she got the guts to take action.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: No, it's not like that!

speaker: Speaker_1285_Title
anh_en: Zhezhi, you can't keep avoiding things! You've got to take action, or you'll never get what you want! You only live once, right?!
That does make sense.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: If this is the situation...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Uh... but we're still investig— I... O-okay.
Are you sure we can go now?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Hmm? {PlayerName}? Hey! {PlayerName}!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Investigate? About what? A new case?
Yes, about the Arcane Artist tale.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, I get it! In that case, it's probably not the best time for a get-together.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Sorry...
Thanks. But why are you here, Chixia?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: I'm here to support the Patrollers. There was an assault near the mine recently, and they're short on people to investigate.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: What's odd is those monsters haven't caused any more trouble since we got here. Right now, we're talking to witnesses and trying to figure out what triggered the incident.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Did something just happen over there...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Don't tell me it's a Tacet Discord... Hold on, just got a message... Seems like they really are stirring up trouble again. Sorry, but I gotta go check this out!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: What brings you here? It's been ages since we last met! The Patrol Station's been pretty busy lately, so I haven't had the time to catch up with you.
We'll go with you.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: S-should we go as well?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh? Are you alright? You don't look well... Do you need help?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Wait, how bout' coming to the station with me today? Are you heading back to the city?
Wait, we have a case to investigate.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Oh, is this not a good time?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: That's okay! Just tell me if you need any help!
Why not? Maybe we'll find some clues useful to our case.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: You could be right, but there's one other thing...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: And Zhezhi's here too! Hiya! Do you remember me? We met at the Moon-Chasing Festival.

Your discussion is interrupted by Chixia's arrival. Zhezhi, feeling shy and a little awkward, is unsure how to decline Chixia's invitation to return to the city. Just when she is about to give in to Chixia's friendly insistence, you politely excuse both of you from the gathering. Chixia mentions she is also investigating the Tacet Discords that have been acting strangely. Just then, a loud noise nearby interrupts your conversation and you all decide to check it out.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: H-hello... No, it's not... uh... no, thank you...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: The painting we had you do for us during the festival is awesome! Everyone loves it, so we put it up on the wall!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Really? Hehe, I'm glad you all like it...

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: We'd also like to invite you to our station, so we can formally thank you in person!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Thank you...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Phew... Sorry to trouble you, {PlayerName}.
Why are you apologizing all of a sudden?
Don't worry about it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Thanks... Uh, wait, I haven't said why.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: What I'm trying to say is...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: If I had been clearer, you wouldn't have had to explain things to Chixia for me.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: She's really nice. It's just... we're not that close, and I'm not sure how to respond to how friendly she is... I didn't want to be rude, so I... I couldn't bring myself to turn her down.
It's okay. I got you.
Her friendliness is infectious.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I'll do my best not to trouble you and express my feelings properly next time...
I'm sure you will.
No trouble at all.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Then both of you decide to ask people around about the situation.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Zhezhi seems to be struggling to tell what she couldn't express earlier, but eventually stays silent.
Regretting her earlier hesitation, Zhezhi promises to speak up more decisively as you make your way to the scene.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: After {PlayerName} and I bumped into each other, we decided to investigate the surroundings and follow Patroller Chixia to the scene of the incident.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It was there we learned about the details of Mingyan's offense and the truth behind the tale of the Arcane Artist.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: (Once Zhezhi has the paintbrush in her hand, she begins to speak calmly.)

speaker: Rover
anh_en: (She'll be fine making the statement on her own now.)

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Thanks for your help, {PlayerName}! We caught the culprit before anything worse could happen... We were lucky to have you here!
Can I check on that painting later?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: You sure can!
So she is the Arcane Artist.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Thanks for all your help. We'll take it from here!
What's the situation with the artist?

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: She fessed up when I first started talking to her, but clammed up when I tried to dig deeper.

You learn from Chixia and a researcher that the Tacet Discords had gone wild due to a frequency fluctuation from a painting scroll found at the site. The scroll's power came from the artist's nearly Overclocked Forte.
What was the cause of the incident?

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: According to the preliminary examination, we suspect that these Tacet Discords were agitated by the Frequency Fluctuations from a scroll painting found at the scene.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: The energy remaining in the painting was generated by its creator's Forte nearly overclocking.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: But rest assured, we've calmed her down and contained the energy.
It's a Forte. Just as I suspected...

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: The painting needs to be thoroughly examined to identify its connection with the monsters and eliminate any potential risk it still poses.

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: Well... honestly, she seemed a bit off to me, but we don't have time for that now. We've got to clean up the scene and get the damage under control.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Why...
Why did you do this?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Mingyan appears to be done talking about the matter.

While investigating Mingyan, the artist in question, you discover she had once studied art alongside Zhezhi. Although Mingyan's fragmented speech suggests that she may be guilty, her expression hints at a more complicated story. However, she is unwilling to reveal more.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Mingyan? Why are you...
Do you know her?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes, we used to take painting lessons together.

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: You! I... I didn't...

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: I... I hurt them... it... it was a mistake...
You mean... you hurt those people?

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: I... I'm alone...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Mingyan appears to be unwilling to talk with you.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The painting becomes slightly blurry when you stare at it, and for a moment, the scene in it seems to come to life.

speaker: NPC #1353
anh_en: Thank goodness I wasn't hurt. It was so close...

speaker: NPC #1353
anh_en: I saw that painter... She looked like she was losing it—I'm talking shouting, waving her paintbrush around like she was sweeping the sky!
Did you hear what she said?

From the witness Su, you learn that Mingyan appeared lost, waving her paintbrush moments before a swarm of Tacet Discords emerged from nowhere. It also seemed like she had tried to stop the monsters from harming anyone.
Did you see what just happened?

speaker: NPC #1353
anh_en: Part of it, I guess?

speaker: NPC #1353
anh_en: I might be off here, but I swear those things on her scroll started squirming around before the whole swarm of monsters exploded out of thin air...

speaker: NPC #1353
anh_en: They started to whack and thwack people all over the place. I was terrified and ran away as fast as my legs would take me...

speaker: NPC #1353
anh_en: Not super clearly, but when I was running for my life, I heard her screaming at all those creatures, all like "Stop! Don't do this!" I think she might've been trying to stop them from hurting people.
A vivid description. Thanks for your help.
Can you brief us on the situation?

speaker: NPC #1347
anh_en: {PlayerName}, it's almost time for the dispute hearing.

speaker: NPC #1347
anh_en: I... I still hope you'll come with me.

speaker: NPC #1347
anh_en: I don't mean to burden you, but if you'd like to come, please meet me at the Public Security Bureau entrance.

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: My head... it hurts...
Did you hear what that artist said?

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: Only a bit. It looked like she was arguing with someone right before the weird visions appeared.

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: It's a good thing they caught that painter. Can't imagine what could've happened otherwise.

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: I've met my fair share of artists, but none that would gamble with lives for the sake of their work. That's a first for me...

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: I heard stuff like "Don't stop me!" "I've... I've already won!" and "Who doesn't want fame and fortune!"
Yinfeng, another witness, claimed that Mingyan created the dangerous painting purely for personal gain.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: That's strange... Eh? Oh, {PlayerName}, you're back.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: So she was there at the same time we were... I didn't even notice her presence...
Any leads on your end?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: She kept squeezing my hand and trying to tell me something, but I couldn't understand what she was saying...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I think she wants me to continue the investigation. Maybe there's more to this story than I thought...
Count me in.
It's linked to my case as well.
I think I've figured out the truth behind the Arcane Artist tale.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Huh? A-are you sure? I definitely won't say no to your help! Actually, I... I've wanted it since we last met at the mine!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Then... if you're up for it, I hope you can join me in the investigation. Consider it a formal invitation, {PlayerName}!
Where should we start from?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: You want me to decide? To be honest, I haven't really thought it through...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hmm... I remember meeting Mingyan in an art studio in Jinzhou before. I wonder if she kept going there after I left...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The painting blurs the line between reality and illusion, causing whoever sees it to experience hallucinations.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I've never tried to investigate anything, so I'm not sure if this is the way to go...
I think it is. After you, then.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Okay, let's go.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Y-you've figured it out already?
I checked out that painting.
I talked to the witnesses.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: In fact, I had sensed something odd at the mine. But after we met, I thought it was coming from you, so I didn't give it much attention.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Come to think of it now, it might've been Mingyan's Forte fluctuation.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But... what could have driven her to create such dangerous paintings?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: They repeatedly describe witnessing bizarre, otherwordly visions.
One witness said she probably did this for personal gain.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: From what I know of her, she doesn't seem like someone who would take such risks for personal gain.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Besides, I don't recall her having a Forte before...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Maybe this has something to do with me...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Should that be our first stop? She may have left some of her artwork behind. That could be a good start...

After piecing together the clues, you uncover the truth. Mingyan used her Forte to create temporary phantasms in her art that attracted Tacet Discords. The "monsters" reported by witnesses were merely distorted phantasms seen by frightened people in the dark. Zhezhi insists that Mingyan was not motivated by personal gain, and asks that you continue to search for evidence to clear her name in her art studio.
The researcher indicated they were created by the artist's Forte.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: So... Mingyan channeled her Forte into the painting, creating temporary phantasms.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: People saw her abilities and spread the rumor, believing she was the Arcane Artist from the tale.
And the Tacet Discords were being drawn to her Forte.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: The monsters described in the rumors were probably just exaggerated phantasms seen by scared people at night.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: After learning about the details of the assault, we decided to push forward with the investigation to get to the truth.

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: Pointless! The witnesses on the scene made it clear that it was all because of Mingyan's greedy ambition that she...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I haven't finished my statement, Mr. Baici!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes, this is the art studio. My memory did serve me right. Looks like she's been painting here.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Let's find the clues.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Okay.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Some pieces of paper are put beside the desk. They appear to be softer and lighter than ordinary paper.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Different papers result in different artistic effects. Real artists can always spot these differences, and choose the right paper to showcase various styles.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I can't pass up a great deal, so I stock up whenever I can. It usually takes a whole day to carry all the boxes home, but I must say... it's worth it!
I can help you carry the boxes.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Really? Then... I'll count on you next time!
How did you know about Mingyan's habits?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: We have the same painting style, and the quality of our finished works is remarkably similar.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Once a painter holds a paintbrush in their hand, they won't stop until every detail meets their standards. It becomes an obsession... I guess this is true for most painters.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Even if we use different brush techniques, our similar styles mean we should finish a painting in about the same time.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: This paper...
Discount?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: White Jade Paper is my absolute favorite, but because it's so expensive, I can only afford to buy it when there's a special sale.
How do you know so much?!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Buy three, get one free; buy five, get two free; and then there's the additional weekly coupons—I know everything there is to know about the discounts! Hehe...

In Mingyan's studio, you discovered pieces of "White Jade Paper." Zhezhi introduces its unique qualities with an artist's keen eye. Drawing from her understanding of the paper and Mingyan's habits, Zhezhi begins to build a theory about what happened prior to Mingyan's incident.
Anything wrong?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: This "White Jade Paper" has a rich history. Its smooth, fine texture holds ink beautifully, exactly what you want for more delicate brushwork.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Countless masterpieces, both old and new, were painted on this paper. Like Qinan's "Voyage to Yun Mountain" and Yilin's "Qixi's Dawn of Spring," both two good examples.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Oops, I got carried away... Wait... there's a discount sticker on the wrapping, and it looks quite new...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes, White Jade Hall runs a yearly sale. I attended it two days ago and bought paper with this same packaging.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Mingyan likely bought her paper there too... Half of the stock has already been used, which means she was painting day and night until the incident.
It's amazing that you can tell the difference.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: She painted so many...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: This artwork is titled "Serenity of Xiehua Village." It captures the scenic landscapes seen from the village itself...
Wait, your clothes...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Ah, the pigment! When did it get on my clothes...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Huh? It came off with just a little wipe... Hmm... It shouldn't come off the fabric so easily...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Zhezhi stands stunned before the painting. Words hover on her lips, yet remain unspoken.

Among Mingyan's drafts, Zhezhi recognizes copies of the "Serenity of Xiehua Village," each painted in subtly different ways. As you examine the details, Zhezhi notices pigment stains on her clothes and quickly realizes that the quality of the paint is lower than usual.
Why do these paintings all look the same...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: There is a difference. The brushwork on this one, see how heavy it is? You can tell Mingyan was in low spirits. And this one, the strokes are light and fluid. That tells me she was happy when she painted this.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The feelings a painter has during the process of creation often linger in the brushstrokes without them knowing. They're present in every line, even if the artist tries to hide it.
You can understand the painter's feelings through their work?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes. To me, painting is like a window into the heart of the artist. When words fail, these feelings can be depicted through brushstrokes instead.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It is strange, though. She keeps reproducing the same painting over and over... using techniques that aren't her usual style.
Something's written on the painting. Waters and... what is this?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain. Colors of vanity washed away. The painted world fades, forgotten today.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You see an old garment, tinged with stains.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: After all, fabric used to be a common art material. Besides, using clothes does help to seize fleeting inspiration, don't you think?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It's a shame the clothes are stained forever, but it's worth it to see how different inks behave on fabric.
A find a stained piece of clothing, prompting Zhezhi to recall how she used to use her clothing as makeshift canvases. She suggests that Mingyan might have done something similar.
The colors look unusual.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hmm... Looks like they're stains from ink and paint that have been washed out over time.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Mingyan could have improvised her clothing as... a canvas for her ideas?
How did you know this?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I used to do this as well.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Whenever nature inspired me and I was short on paper, I'd paint rough outlines onto my clothes.
That's new to me...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: How could this happen...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But I have some other thoughts about it...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Being picky about one's work is second nature to an artist.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I'm no exception... There's never been a moment when I saw my art outshining someone else's. I've always admired my fellow artists, hoping that one day I could be as good as them, perhaps even surpass them.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: This needs to be refined, it's not quite there yet... "Still short of perfect... Will my client be disappointed?"

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I had these kinds of thoughts every day while I painted. It started creeping into my daily life too...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It's true that one might find motivation in these thoughts, but they can also lead one astray.
It seems she hit a bottleneck during her creation.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I felt trapped for ages... until I finally figured out the path I ought to follow.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Embrace my emotions fully, and create the art my heart yearns for. This is of the greatest importance to me.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But if I found myself in the same situation as Mingyan, perhaps... perhaps I'd react similarly and lose my way...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: She was forced into this and was looking for a way out... I can't just turn a blind eye and let them charge her! There must be a way to uncover the truth and save her.
Yes, we should continue our investigation now.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I kept painting and improving, but no matter how hard I tried, I always felt it wasn't good enough...

You find Mingyan's notes that reveal her struggles as an artist and the pressure she felt while painting against her true desires. Zhezhi reflects on how common this feeling is among creators. Having once faced the same confusion, Zhezhi expresses her determination to uncover the truth and help save Mingyan.
It seems she's copying someone else's artwork.
What is this Shanyun Art Exchange?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: That's why there are so many copies of the original artwork.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But I have some other thoughts about it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The Shanyun Art Exchange is a renowned institution that manages the exchange of calligraphy and paintings in Huanglong. For an artist to have their work selected is a great honor, bringing with it immense prestige.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: According to Mingyan's diary, the Art Exchange had been collaborating with her... until some terrible mishap occurred...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I didn't expect such a big crowd at the hearing...

speaker: Rover
anh_en: We wouldn't want my lack of artistic expertise to give the Shanyun Art Exchange a chance to turn the hearing against us.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: You're right... Then... I'll... I'll do it myself...
Relax, I'll be here if you need me.
Hi, Zhezhi. I've made it.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Don't worry, I've got your back. Just remember, you're the only one who can lay out the truth—the whole truth— for everyone to see.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: ...You're right.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I'll give it my all, I promise. Let's go.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hmm... S-should I take the stand myself? What do you think, little kitty?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Ah, maybe we can do a little show of... um... paws. Raise your left paw if you think I should testify, or your right paw if...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: W-wait! You raised your left paw before I even finished my sentence... No, that doesn't count. Let's try again.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Okay, if you raise your right paw, I'll... let someone else handle it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hmm... right paw, huh? Well... I did actually want to tell everyone the truth myself. Let's give this another shot.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: {PlayerName}, oh, you're here! It's... it's really nice to see you! And... I appreciate you coming.

speaker: NPC #1349
anh_en: Ms. Zhezhi, the hearing is about to start. If you would, please join us.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Now? Y-yes, Madam Juyao! I... I'll be there in a minute!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I just handed over all the evidence we gathered from Mingyan's studio and the Exile's camp to the Patrollers.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Now the Shanyun Art Exchange can't deny the fact they were producing and trading art forgeries.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But... there is one more thing. The Patroller said we still need someone to testify in the hearing.
Do you want me to testify?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: You're really kind, but... um, I'll be fine to do this myself. You've already helped me so much, even just having you here is a huge relief.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Some things, I've got to face on my own.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: That said... I, uh, didn't... didn't expect there would be so many spectators coming to watch...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: If I get nervous and mess up any details, could you please help to remind me?
You can do this. I believe in you.
No problem.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Thank you! Having you here helps, more than you know.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It's about time. We should probably go in, huh?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: H-how about... you do the talking, and, um, I'll add details... if, if I have to?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I was the one who chose to uncover the truth behind this case. I can't back down now, not when it matters most.
You meet Zhezhi at the entrance of the Public Security Bureau. Relieved to see you, she gathers her courage and decides to speak the truth about the art forgery case during the hearing.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Eh? B-but... I've... I've never spoken in front of so many people before...
You know this case better than I do.
Actually, I kind of forgot the details...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hey {PlayerName}, have a look at this...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Did she use a new recipe I'm not familiar with...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Sorry... I'm just not very experienced.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: My family always brought me remedies and soups. I never thought about how they were made...

You stumble upon medicinal herb residue. Zhezhi, inexperienced with such materials, initially thinks it is just leftover pigment. Finding this makes you realize that Mingyan had not been feeling well before the incident.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Seems like this pigment is homemade... but why are there herbs in it?
It doesn't look like a pigment. More like the medicinal herb residue to me.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Medicinal herb residue?

speaker: Rover
anh_en: She must have been making medicinal remedies recently. This must be the leftover residue she didn't get around to cleaning up.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: These herbs were used for medicine... Oh, so those plants I saw in the pharmacy weren't just for decoration!
...Haven't you seen someone brewing this before?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I-I've never tried myself... When I get sick, I usually just wait it out.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Fragments of a vase scatter across the floor.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The scrolls and papers are in disarray, as if they've been rummaged through.
What happened here...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I think... Hmm... No, I might be wrong...
What are you thinking?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Nothing, it's just a thought. I might be wrong.
This is a discussion, there is no right and wrong.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Then... I'll share it with you...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (The vase must've been on that cabinet, judging by where it fell.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Looks like the cabinet used to be over there, but... something bumped into it, and that's why the vase got knocked over.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (I bet the water on the floor is from the fishbowl... Huh? Why is that water mark in the shape of a Gulpuff...)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (Okay, I've figured it out! That must be the reason. {PlayerName} will definitely be impressed with my deductive skills.)

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: A Gulpuff jumped out of the fishbowl, knocking over the vase and causing it to shatter on the floor. Then it landed on a pile of paintings. Realizing it was in trouble and afraid of getting scolded, it slipped out of the window.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Is that so? I-I'll practice more often!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I see... I guess I jumped to conclusions. I'll do better next time!
By the way, was that your Forte just now?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Oh, yes, these are... phantasms I can create with my brush. They only exist for a short while.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I haven't done this for a long time. I'm a bit rusty now...
Haven't done this for a long time?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes, I rarely need to use my Forte in daily life.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: An artwork created with Forte is indeed mesmerizing, nearly flawless, but that's not my goal...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: So, I've used this ability less over time.
Do you think Mingyan's case has something to do with you?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes. It could be related to my Forte...
We'll talk about this later. Let's look outside now.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: My family used to have an aquarium at home with lots of Gulpuffs. I thought it was a popular trend...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: When it comes to painting, I prefer the traditional way. It helps me to understand my progress and improve my skills.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But it's fine to use it for the investigation.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Zhezhi seems a bit upset and unwilling to continue this topic.

Zhezhi speculates that a Gulpuff might have escaped from the studio. While the theory seems questionable, you appreciate her effort, spurring Zhezhi to try again. Impressed by her Forte use, you learn that Zhezhi rarely uses her Resonance abilities. Zhezhi confesses that her Forte, which closely resembles Mingyan's, may somehow be connected to Mingyan's uncharacteristic outburst.
Who keeps Gulpuffs as pets?
What a... creative deduction.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Ah? Why wouldn't they?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Sorry, I need to improve my investigation skills...
It is a logical explanation.
It's okay. You just need more clues.
Someone left these tracks.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Mmhmm.
They could be the missing piece in our theory.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hmm... Someone broke into the studio looking for something... or trying to steal something? Probably something tied to Mingyan's paintings...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: However, they were startled by something unexpected and, in their panic to escape through the window, collided with the cabinet, causing the vase to fall.
That makes more sense now.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: This might be related to the Shanyun Art Exchange and Mingyan's breakdown... Let's follow these tracks and see where they lead.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The clues from the studio led us to an Exiles' camp.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: There, we found new clues that pointed to a hidden player behind all of this...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Some ore residues are scattered beside the trolley, with color stains on it.
Looks like pigments...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The trolley is worn... Maybe it carried something very heavy.
Maybe the Exiles used it to transport ore and pigments.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Could it be they transported ore, made pigments from them, and then moved the pigments elsewhere?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Could the buyers Mr. Shilang mentioned be the ones who stole the ore?
Let's see if we can find the evidence.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A large pile of fragmented ores is mixed with the pigment, unmarked and unpackaged.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: They are similar. Did she... buy these low-quality pigments from the Exiles? But why did these people break into her studio...
Someone's coming this way.
Seems you're right.
Was the pigment in Mingyan's studio the same as this?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Did she... buy these low-quality pigments from the Exiles? But why did these people break into her studio...

At an Exile camp, you find piles of ore fragments and handmade pigments. The amount perfectly matches what you saw in Shilang's transaction records. This confirms that these Exiles were the ore thieves and that Mingyan had purchased their low-quality pigments.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Scarletthorn, Indigoite, and other ore... these match the raw materials for pigments listed on Mr. Shilang's transaction record.
They're the ones who bought the leftover ore.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I took a look and noticed that these pigments were handcrafted from these specific ores...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Standard pigments adhere well and last a long time, but these makeshift pigments smear with the slightest touch.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: It's just... I'm not sure why her mood is, um, reacting to us...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Maybe... could it be because I'm here?

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: Did you really think we'd let you just walk away after you destroyed our warehouses and interfered with our business?!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Business... Why is everyone so obsessed with making money...?

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: Fellas, whaddya say we grab that compensation from our friends here for all the trouble they've caused us?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: A creator's passion... Does it not mean anything to you...?

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: That's it for today. Time for a break! Oh, hey there. Need something?
Could it be related to the Arcane Artist?

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: Hmm, maybe... But unlike Tacet Discords, they didn't attack me.

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: Do you think they're related? Did Gupan tell you about that old folktale?

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: The light was flickering in the wind, so I couldn't make out their faces. But I knew something was weird with the scrolls they had in their hands. Every time they moved, more monsters appeared.

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: Later, I told everyone about it, and Gupan was there. She freaked out, saying it was just like the tale of the Arcane Artist.
They? There was more than one person on the scene that night?

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: I'm not sure... but I overheard them talking. No, actually, "arguing" would be more accurate.

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: Anyway, I got worried those monsters might attack me, so I bolted and didn't catch what they were arguing about...
Do you remember where you saw them?

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: I do remember... Wait, you're not seriously thinking of going there, are you? Whatever those monsters are, they're unidentified and dangerous. If you have to go, be really careful, alright?
Tell me about the recent event at the mine.

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: You know, I did see some people standing nearby. Just some shadows, really, 'cause it was so dim.
Could it be a prank?

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: No way... Those monsters showed up in an empty field at midnight, so there was no one around to prank. Besides, what's the point of tricks if there's no one to see them?

Huaijin reveals that the monsters lurking around the mine have been acting strangely, and hints that they might be linked to some painting scrolls. Huaijin also warns you that there is likely more than one person involved in the case.

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: You've come to the right guy. I was actually the first to see those weird things.

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: I was playing chess with the old miners until midnight, then headed home alone. On my way back, I heard these strange moans, like some kind of monster was out there.

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: At first, I thought they were Tacet Discords and I was ready to bolt. But then I realized they were different. These monsters... they were being drawn to something.

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: Curiosity got the better of me, so I took a step closer...

speaker: Huaijin
anh_en: ...And saw that they had these strange features. Gleaming eyes, gnarled horns, and dark green bodies covered in slimy liquid...
Could it be a new variant of TD?

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: You... who exactly are you people? You don't look like you're Patrollers... What do you want?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I...I can't remain silent about this any longer. This is the only way more people can learn about the truth...

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: You'd better think this through! The Shanyun Art Exchange is not a group you wanna cross...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I never painted for the Art Exchange's approval. If no one else dares to speak up, then... then I'll be the one to do it!
I might have just the plan.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: First, we keep these guys on close watch. Then, we need to catch them off guard, and the best way to do that is...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Forcing people to make copies like a factory line... it's disrespecting the creators' dignity.

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: Oh, it's just a couple of stones and trees on a piece of paper, for crying out loud. Even I can draw one with a flick of the wrist, who cares if they're real or not...

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: For the amount of paint and ink that goes into them, I'd even go so far as to say paying those painters 20 credits each is a rip-off.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: How could you measure the value of creation in such a way...?

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: If it's the paintings you're after, take as many as you want! We can always make new ones.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: That's not what I meant.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The way you coerced the painters... a-and put their lives at risk for profit... I'll expose it all!

Yinfeng dismisses the value of an artist's passion and tries to silence you with money. Outraged but resolute, Zhezhi stands her ground, determined to expose the dark side of the Shanyun Art Exchange and save all the artists who are been coerced into producing forgeries.

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: Oh, so you're also here for the money? Look, name a figure, we'll pay double if it'll make you shut up! How does that sound? Take it and scram!

speaker: NPC #1354
anh_en: Then what the hell do you want from me?!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: ...I-I want to expose everything to the public.
What?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Aside from reporting you to the Patrollers, I want to let the public know about all the forgery and smuggling you've been doing.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I-Is something wrong...?
I like the idea. You have my support.

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: That's quite the story. At best, this merely proves our involvement in the incident at best, yet the real culprit remains unknown. Your accusations are groundless.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I do understand that... if her own heart hadn't wavered, none of this would've happened... But there was already no turning back by the time she wanted to quit.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: So, saying she was the mastermind behind it all... that's just not fair.

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: Even so, how is forgery a valid accusation? Nothing like that was mentioned in your recording, now was it?
We found the original painting in the hidden warehouse.
We found evidence of forgeries being bought and sold.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: This evidence clearly shows that these paintings are no ordinary copies, but your way of making a profit.

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: Heh, there's no such thing as real or fake paintings. You're not fooling anyone.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: ...Mr. Baici, do you recognize this painting?

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: Well, of course. It's "Serenity of Xiehua Village," the work of the Arcane Artist.

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: Allow me to remind you, she was the one who created those paintings, insisted on selling them, and concocted the entire terrifying incident.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Then can you tell the difference between this one and the others?

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: Of course, this piece possesses a lifelike quality unmatched by any other, all thanks to the Resonance ability of the Arcane Artist—Mingyan.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: However, judging from these paintings, it seems Mingyan's ability never stabilized successfully, except for this original piece.

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: What does this have to do with anything? Do you have solid evidence to prove the differences between these paintings?

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: What you're saying is all speculation. There's no guarantee a painter won't make mistakes, is there?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Artists seeking perfection always choose the highest quality pigments for their most important pieces.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The original paintings had pigments that were purer and brighter, able to blend more naturally and retain color for longer.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: In contrast, the forgeries used pigments made from mineral scraps. These don't hold up the same, smudging at the slightest touch.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: We can distinguish the real paintings from the fakes simply by analyzing the ink used.

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: Doing so only proves the so-called "original painting" is created differently from the others. Are you implying that Mingyan is only allowed to use a single kind of pigment throughout her work?

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: Do you honestly believe her paintings would've earned a single penny without my intervention?

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: How is this supposed to prove that we are behind the forgeries?!

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Because the original creator of "Serenity in Xiehua Village" is me.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: No... Mr. Baici, you're changing the subject.

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: How ungrateful. She ensnared us in this debacle, and now you dare to lay the blame at our feet?

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: For it to be forgery, there has to be another original artist. These paintings are all the work of Mingyan. Even if she made dozens of identical copies, it wouldn't be considered forgery.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: During our investigation of the studio, I accidentally got paint on me and discovered something interesting about the materials used in these paintings.

In the hearing, you present the evidence—the recording, art forgeries, and the low-quality pigments—to prove how the Art Exchange coerced painters into producing counterfeit works. However, Baici defends himself with different excuses. At that moment, Zhezhi gathers her courage and reveals a hidden truth: she is the original creator of "Serenity of Xiehua Village."

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: B-Before we proceed, I wish to present this audio recording to the court.

speaker: NPC #1363
anh_en: Ugh, Mr. Baici stopped by again, grumbling about the delay in getting Mingyan's paintings to the Shanyun Art Exchange...

speaker: NPC #1363
anh_en: If Yinfeng hadn't pushed her, she wouldn't have gotten hurt. Now she can't even paint, and our order is gonna be late.

speaker: NPC #1363
anh_en: She's been rebellious and a bit too smart for her own good lately. I just wanted her to keep her head down and work. Who knew she'd crack and cause that mess.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Mingyan was initially only making copies. Everything changed after you stepped in.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Trickery, misinformation, and later on even threats... She was led down the path of forging artworks for you.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: When I was a child, painting was the only way I could express myself freely.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: After I realized this...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: My parents scolded me for it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: After the family business fell apart, my parents vanished without a trace.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Xiehua Village was my first stop upon arriving in Jinzhou alone.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: A poem I wrote, inscribed on "Serenity in Xiehua Village."

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: And that painting, well... it became the "Arcane Artist's" final piece of art.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Ever since that day...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Whatever I thought, I painted into reality.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Everything I did and didn't understand... it all flowed through the tip of my paintbrush.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Tales of the Arcane Artist spread far and wide.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I discovered, to my dismay, that my parents were using my creations to turn a quick profit.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Using the paintings as a distraction from reality.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: To inflict torment upon those they desire.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: They were being exploited, and everything was spiraling out of control.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I began to fear holding a brush.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I tried to paint without relying on my abilities, but...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: They called anything painted without using my abilities worthless.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: They may have left behind a considerable mess...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But freedom has also been returned to my brush.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: All that I saw, lived within my paintings.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Colors of vanity washed away; the painted world fades, forgotten today.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I know it's not that well-written.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But it's proof of my decision to stop everything I was doing.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Paintings with special abilities gradually faded from everyone's minds.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: And I never used my abilities to paint again.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: This power to turn fantasies into reality gradually caught the interest of many.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I took great joy in my skills improving, however...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: They were sold at unbelievable prices.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Some sought beauty in enchanted worlds...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Others resorted to hellish nightmares...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: My own abilities had led my paintings astray.

speaker: NPC #1350
anh_en: Well, that was certainly a touching story. But I'm afraid your words alone won't be enough to prove you created this painting.
Zhezhi faces her past and takes control of her Forte, preparing to use it to back up her claim and embrace the responsibility that comes with her talent.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: ...Madam Juyao, to prove my statement, I request your permission to use and paint with one of these copies.

speaker: NPC #1349
anh_en: Granted.
Are you sure you want to do this?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Yes. Mingyan's experience has made me realize something.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The paintings I drew in the past... they were heartfelt creations, pieces of my life. They formed my past and shaped who I am today.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It's not just about proving a single painting... it's about so much more...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: If my Forte is the cause behind all this, then I must take responsibility... I can't just let this go on and hurt others.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: To create art that truly resonates, I must first accept myself.

speaker: NPC #700013
anh_en: So the rumors are true...

speaker: NPC #1364
anh_en: It's all right. It's okay, she's gone now. Soon... I'll be an even better painter than she ever was!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Watch out!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Zhezhi?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: That voice...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: This place must be a manifestation of Mingyan's mind when she created it...

speaker: NPC #1364
anh_en: So why is everyone still praising her work...?

speaker: NPC #700012
anh_en: Th-these paintings are really coming to life?!

speaker: NPC #700011
anh_en: What's happening?!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Why is the world inside this painting so distorted?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Spectacle is born from the mind.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Wait, did you hear something?

speaker: NPC #1364
anh_en: Why...

speaker: NPC #1364
anh_en: I've painted it exactly like hers...

speaker: NPC #1364
anh_en: You... It's you... I've already done everything I can... Why are you still better than me?!

speaker: NPC #1364
anh_en: You were just lucky... If it weren't for your parents holding your hands... You'd never have what should be rightfully mine!

speaker: NPC #1364
anh_en: Still... I couldn't do it...

speaker: NPC #1364
anh_en: Why... I perfected everything...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: My abilities have nothing to do with it...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: You shouldn't see me as a model to follow...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Only when you connect with your truest feelings can you create an exceptional piece of art!

speaker: NPC #1364
anh_en: It's all because of your abilities...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: You created masterpieces I wish came from me. Bold, free...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I know our paintings have their differences, but the heart and soul we put into them are the same.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: When I learned the truth, I was heartbroken...

speaker: NPC #1349
anh_en: Mr. Baici, do you have anything else to add to your defense?

speaker: NPC #1349
anh_en: Very well. We will re-evaluate Mingyan's charges, determine the Shanyun Art Exchange's involvement in the incident, and conduct a comprehensive investigation as soon as possible.

speaker: NPC #1349
anh_en: This hearing is adjourned.

The painting Zhezhi creates during the hearing, combined with the message you sent to the Patrollers, leaves Baici no choice but to confess. The Public Security Bureau announces they will re-evaluate Mingyan's charges and launch a full investigation. Victory is yours.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I believed that by sealing my Forte, no one would get hurt because of my paintings. I never expected them to continue causing harm after all these years.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: But {PlayerName}'s words made me realize something.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It was never about the paintings themselves, but rather those who sought to use them to hurt others.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Mr. Baici, you run a highly esteemed calligraphy and painting institution, yet you've suppressed the creative spirit and violated these artists' dignity, all for the sake of wealth.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Everything they cherished has now become a tool for profit... The works they held dear are just tools for your gain, insulting to both the original artists and their imitators.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Set before you is the original painting from many years ago and the one I've just completed. Now, everything has been brought to light.

speaker: NPC #1349
anh_en: We received word from the Public Security Bureau ten minutes ago that they have taken the Exiles into custody and found the location where the paintings were hidden.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So everything she said was true. I never imagined the Art Exchange could do such a thing.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Tell me about it. I was even about to stand up for them. Ugh.

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: Uh... You don't look like you work at the mine. Can I help you with something?

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: Anything else unusual? Hmm... Yes there was one thing.

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: Do you mean the mysterious painter who can bring fantastical creatures to life? That could explain it, but a Forte tied to painting is rare.

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: Aside from the blurred silhouettes I saw that night, I remember hearing voices—like people talking.

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: The voices came from where those silhouettes were, but they sounded like... vague muttering.

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: Thinking about it now, if it was a human voice, how could someone get so close to those monsters without crying out for help?
I see. Thank you for the information.
Jifeng elaborates on more key details of the attacks, leading you to suspect that they are not random events, but something far more deliberate.
Tell me about the recent event at the mine.

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: Oh yes, that strange event. It's the talk of the town right now.

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: I've conducted several investigations and found that those monsters tend to appear around midnight. Their locations seem random, though.

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: Fortunately, they haven't caused much harm. I think it's because they always show up and vanish in the dead of night.

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: If you ask me, these monsters are a new type of Tacet Discord. Since they're unrecorded, our Terminal can't trigger an alarm when they're nearby.

speaker: Quý Phong
anh_en: For safety reasons, we have increased our patrols around the mine.
Did you notice anything else unusual?
Could it be related to the Arcane Artist?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Please don't tell me the one I bought earlier was a fake too.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You better get home and check for yourself!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This phantasm is so cool!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Too bad we won't ever see it again...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It's finally over... I didn't miss anything important, did I?
Don't mention it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I want to pay Mingyan a visit. After all, she was involved in all of this, and I want to tell her everything.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: What do you think?
Can I come with you?

speaker: Rover
anh_en: My commission started with her, plus you and I solved the case together. Why don't you come with me?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Is the commission over?

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Yes, I already had it taken care of the day we found out the truth.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: All right, let's go.
You did great.
After the hearing, Zhezhi thanks you for your unwavering support and expresses her relief at the outcome. Together, you plan to visit Mingyan.
You hid your nerves well.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Huh? No, not at all... I was just coming up with things to say as I went. My palms were sweating the whole time...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I definitely couldn't have done it if you weren't there with me... Thinking about the feeling when we were investigating the case together is what kept me calm during the trial.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Wh-what I meant to say is, back then, everything I said felt right, like I could just be myself around you. It felt so good to be that relaxed...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Thank you for helping me through this. You... you helped me find the courage to believe in myself. Thanks to you, look at everything we accomplished.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: The Shanyun Art Exchange is undergoing investigation. It'll be the end of their businesses... And the painters they coerced are finally set free.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I haven't felt this happy in a long time!

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: Zhezhi... It's been a while.

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: Heh. Maybe... I was never meant to be a painter to begin with...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I brought you a gift...
Mingyan accepts a scroll of painting from Zhezhi, staring at it for a long time after opening it.

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: Hehe, see...? Only you can create a painting with such life. I still have a long way to go.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: This is your painting.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: It's the one you gave me when we first met.

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: I... Hehe... How ironic. I've been trying to imitate you for so many years that now I can't even tell my own paintings apart anymore.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Your paintings were never inferior to mine. Just look at this piece, even you approve of its value. It doesn't matter who painted it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Mingyan, I hope you can find your true self, whoever she is. I know you can do it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Your injuries...
Mingyan opens the scroll painting once again and stares at every detail for a long time. She appears lost in thought. Zhezhi and you leave quietly after seeing this.

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: ...Thank you for bringing me this painting... Really.

When Mingyan learns about your efforts, she expresses her deep gratitude and apologizes to Zhezhi. She admits that the incident makes her question whether she is truly meant to be an artist. Zhezhi encourages her to follow her heart, gifting her a painting she had once received from Mingyan. Staring at her own work, Mingyan grows emotional, lost in thought.

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: The researchers have taken good care of me. A chat won't hurt. And you must be... the Rover?
You know me?

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: I heard about everything you did. Thank you for freeing me from those nightmares.

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: You know what, Zhezhi? You may seem soft and gentle on the outside, but if your boundaries are crossed, I think you can be tougher than anyone else.

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: And... I still owe you an apology.

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: Forgive me. Because I was so obsessed with wanting to be you... to be better than you, I've caused you so much trouble...

speaker: NPC #1352
anh_en: ...The pain of these injuries managed to put a stop to my obsession with imitating your paintings.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I think it's safe to say she'll give it some thought.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: To be honest, I didn't just see this case through to correct mistakes or help the artists. Deep down, I...I didn't want to let you down.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I wanted to tell you this back at the mine, but the words just didn't come out right...
It's fine, I understand what you're trying to say.
I'm glad you finally said it.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Thank you for being my friend and helping me through all of this, {PlayerName}.
I can say the same to you.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: While I have yet to uncover my past and who I am, every moment with you is a new and special memory.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Thank you for your help, Zhezhi. This experience has helped me understand you and the world a little better.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: You seem to be pretty slow on the news, {PlayerName}.
So you know how to tell jokes now?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hehe... You've given me the courage to joke around.
Does that mean you can do the same in front of others?

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Hmm... well...

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Let's take it slow for now.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: So... seeing her in so much pain, I just had to help.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: I don't want Mingyan to lose hope and have someone who loves painting so much just disappear...

Happy for Mingyan's change of heart, Zhezhi tells you that solving this case isn't just about helping Mingyan, but also about living up to your expectations. Touched by your reassurance, Zhezhi playfully teases you for the first time. While it may still be difficult for her to open up around others, she has made great strides thanks to your support.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: During the few times we met, she was always passionate about discussing art with me. I think that fire inside her won't just fade away.

speaker: NPC #1348
anh_en: Come to think of it, the deep discussions we had and the painting duels back then felt like true friendship.
