anh_en: Every day, I'm consumed by the urge to see it thrive, trembling with excitement for its bloom, the soft touch of petals unfolding in my palm... This feeling… I can't wait to make it mine!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A part of a broken stone, hidden under the dense veins, faintly reveals itself, bearing some chiseled marks.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It reads… "Petalfall Village".

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Veins are everywhere. Overly dense. The plants here are abnormal.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Many years have passed, and here I am again...

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: But I'm not gonna stay at the Black Shores and live off old memories.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Ugh! My body's giving out... Hah... Need a place to rest soon.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Camellya's illusion disappeared.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Since she mentioned "sealed her memories" and "returned", this must be the cave from twenty years ago.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Did Camellya seal her memories because of my choice?

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: …(Static)… {PlayerName}, can you hear me?
Yes. What happened?

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Something's not right. I'll get you out of the Stellar Matrix first!
The surroundings turn dark, and you feel yourself being lifted out of the Stellar Matrix. You open your eyes, and find yourself back to the Black Shores.
You learn that Lady Flora sealed her memories because of a choice your past self made. Bewildered, you return to the Modulation Hall with Beatrice's help.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I'm sorry. That matrix is more cunning than we anticipated… My mistake.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Due to a mutated Stellar Matrix, you may not reach the destination in one go.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: <color=Highlight>Multiple jumps</color> might be required to get there. {PlayerName}, please stay safe!

Beatrice informs you that Camellya is still trapped in the Stellar Matrix. To rescue her, you must enter the Matrix once again. Beatrice warns you that multiple jumps might be needed to reach the correct timeline juncture.
Camellya and I got separated…
Do you know where she is?

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Camellya is still inside that Stellar Matrix.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: She was trapped inside and started to sink deeper—that's why you couldn't go any further.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Besides, Camellya has found the matrix core. Without her, it might have escaped again.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Now, we'll create a symmetrical Stellar Matrix, and that will allow you to reach the previously inaccessible areas.
What should I do then?

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: There will be various simulated areas. To reach the destination, you need to <color=Highlight>find and jump to the correct timeline junctures</color>.

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: Master, master, m-master...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (KU-Riri is pacing back and forth, seemingly eager to say something.)
All of them…?
No, I remember…

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The previous recording mentioned <color=Highlight>a few survivors from the Tacet Discord Outbreak, but in this Petalfall Village, everyone perished except for Camellya.</color>)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The situation here seems to differ from my timeline.)
When did I bring Lady Flora back to the Black Shores?

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: Two weeks ago.

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: Master, master, m-master...

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: Please calm her down as soon as possible. Prolonged Overclocking will put greater strain on her body.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: KU-Riri turns and looks at the door a short distance away.

Upon crossing the Stargate, you find yourself in a simulated Black Shores from many years ago. There, you encounter a nervous robot, KU-Riri, who tells you that Lady Flora is Overclocking and has fled her medical pod to hide in a nearby room. This suggests you are not in the correct juncture, but rather a distorted version of history.

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: Master, the Overclocked Resonator known as "Lady Flora" has breached containment and left her medical pod.

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: The target is currently located in… located…
Where?
Calm down. Take your time.

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: Target is in the room ahead. Your need to calm her down and transfer her back to the medical pod.

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: Lady Flora is dangerous—her mind and language skills are impaired, making her prone to reckless behavior. She is a threat to the Black Shores' internal facilities.

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: As for the other residents of Petalfall Village, we have confirmed that they have all perished.

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: We couldn't save them in time. The situation worsened too quickly after we received the unusual signal until you arrived.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It's locked... So Camellya, in her Overclocked state, damaged the locked door's security system, when her mind was unclear?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I need to restore the security system first.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The mutated plants have grown so large… Camellya in this timeline has severely Overclocked.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: You… defeated… me.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I seem to… have seen you… much earlier…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: This… is...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: …for you.
You find Lady Flora covered in vines, struggling against her Overclocking. As her condition eases, she gazes at you with a faint smile and offers you a flower.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: It's you…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Restraints… I… AHHHHHH!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Voices… so many noises…!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: It... hurts...
I'm taking you back to the medical pod.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: My head… My whole body... hurts...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Petalfall Village…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I see… Ah, it's over…

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Camellya disappeared… So, does that gate lead to a new juncture?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Lady Flora once Overclocked so much that her mind was heavily damaged, and her language abilities degenerated… Then, the Camellya I know…

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: {PlayerName}, there you are! It's been a while, and you still look great.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: The Shorekeeper is tied up with modulation and can't leave.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: That's why I need your help to recapture it and prevent any more incidents. You're the best person for the job.
What should I do?
How much are you paying?

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Don't worry, I'll make it worth your time.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: The escapee is hiding, but we can use the remnants of its data to track it down.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (…I think I heard something.)

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: What's the matter?
Nothing. Go on.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: While investigating, I discovered that a few years ago, a Consultant accessed these data.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Since you came to the Black Shores, so many unexpected things have happened… Even the Shorekeeper made an appearance.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: She was out in the field recently and just returned to the Black Shores. You should check in with her first.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Alright. I'll call if I get anything.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Thank you. I'm counting on you!
A corrupted Stellar Matrix has escaped and could endanger the Black Shores. To retrieve it, you seek out the Consultant who previously accessed the Matrix's data.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Anyway, let's get to the point. Do you remember what the Error Cell is for?
Yes.
Not really.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Great, your memory is as sharp as ever.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Well, it's basically a "prison" for containing hazardous waste like corrupted Stellar Matrices.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: The problem is, one of the "prisoners" has escaped.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: It's headed towards the Necrostar and seems to be trying to go even deeper.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'm... back on the surface of the Black Shores island?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I should go look around.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: It's really you!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Most of the villagers are safe… and with the way Camellya looks now… It seems I'm in an alternate timeline again.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (But even if the history is changed, we still met each other.)

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: You're the Black Shores leader, aren't you?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I-I snuck in here, but please don't drive me out! I have my own Forte now! I can work for you.
Now? You mean you couldn't before?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I… don't know.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Those Consultants said my Rabelle's Test showed I awakened my Forte. But in the village, I didn't feel anything special.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: … And I don't remember anything before coming to the village.
You don't remember?
You have lost your memory before?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Heard I can find the Black Shores here. Glad I didn't come to the wrong place.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Yes, villagers said I appeared in the woods by their lake one autumn morning.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: That's all I remember. Didn't have anywhere else to go, so I stayed in that village.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Can I stay with you here? At the Black Shores? I-I want to serve you. Make me your Bloom Bearer.
Technically speaking, it's a job, and you'll be serving the entire Black Shores.
And Camellya, you are not "mine". You belong to yourself.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hmm…

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Join us if you pass the assessment. The Black Shores welcomes those who protect the world.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Great! But... I-I still don't know your name. Tell me, please?
I'm {PlayerName}.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Ah... It's a beautiful name. I'll never forget it.
You are…?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I'm so happy, really, really happy that my vines feel so light…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: How strange... This is our first formal conversation, but...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: It feels like I had heard your name before...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Look, this is my Forte. I quite like it.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I want to shadow you, see how a strong person like you moves forward.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: This flower... is for you. I'm looking forward to the days ahead.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Yes.

Crossing the Stargate again, you meet another version of Lady Flora at the Black Shores. Unlike the previous Lady Flora, she appears healthy and slightly bashful, yet her admiration for you remains unchanged. She mentions that meeting you feels familiar.\n\nThanks to your timely arrival, Petalfall Village has survived the disaster in this juncture, even though that is not how it truly happened. Like she did before, Lady Flora smiles and offers you a flower.
(Is this Camellya?!)

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I'm Camellya. Or call me "Lady Flora" if you want. People from Petalfall Village like to call me that.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: You left in such a hurry. We didn't even get a chance to talk.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I felt... off, like I missed out on something important, so I came here alone to find you.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: How's the situation in Petalfall Village?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: The injured have been transferred to other nearby villages. Most of the villagers are safe and sound, thanks to your timely rescue.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: These Tacet Discords… The Stellar Matrix must've noticed us. It's trying to hold me back.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Camellya is trapped deep inside... She must be in danger now. I need to find the correct juncture fast.
Camellya.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I turned into a flower tree due to Overclocking and trapped those feeble creatures in an underground cave.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (KU-Riri's recording mentioned that <color=Highlight>Camellya was found in an underground cave</color>. Looks like this time, I jumped to the right juncture.)
How's the villagers?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Oh, I threw them out of the village when I started transforming. They would have died if they stayed.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Not many survived, but some did. They managed to hold on until you showed up, and they guided you to find me.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: What a surprise. Thought they'd run away when I threw them out.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I have no interest in those crybabies… but since they took me in for a while, I owed them a favor.
It felt good to do good, huh?
You don't need to find an excuse for your good deed.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hahaha! That's a cute way to put it.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Oh? It's you.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: What? I'm speaking from my heart. I don't wanna spare a glance at those weaklings.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I despise weaklings. Myself included. I was a sorry sap when I turned into that plant!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: But you saved me. You pulled me out of Overclocking and brought me back to sanity. I should thank you.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I don't remember anything before I arrived in that village. I don't care anyway. You're the only one who's ever made me feel so excited.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: So, how about making me your Bloom Bearer? You see... who else can keep me from causing trouble elsewhere?
…Well, indeed I can't just let you leave.
You would be a risk to public safety, no doubt.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Right? Making me yours exactly aligns with the interests of Solaris, and as you just said, would make the world a safer place.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Just so you know, when I was doing the Rabelle test, the staff said I'm still prone to Overclocking.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I may have great power now, but I might lose it or fall prey to my emotions again someday.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: If that day comes, then… I'll embrace it as my destiny! Fate's already brought us together, and I'll pay any cost for that.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: It's led me to the most exquisite flower in this world. I'll give anything for it, no hesitation!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Did you know? Climbing plants are obsessed with big, gorgeous trees. Clinging onto them like their life depends on it, sucking up all the energy they can get from the sun.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: They're driven by an insatiable hunger to savor their beloved tree, down to the last bit.

After passing through the Stargate for the third time, you finally reach the correct timeline juncture.\n\nThe Lady Flora you meet resembles Camellya in the real world and, like the others, she does not hide her feelings for you.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Done with the work? You should get some rest.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I've been super well-behaved these past few days! Did everything as you said! Didn't cause any trouble or go to places I shouldn't!

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: KU-Riri reporting in! The infrastructure damage in Petalfall Village is severe. The rebuilding will be difficult in the short term, and it requires reassessment…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: You need some discipline, robot. How dare you interrupt my conversation with {Male=him;Female=her}?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: You wanna know the situation in Petalfall Village? I can tell you. I was there, remember?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: It's been… a few months since the Tacet Discords attacked the village.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: One day, we'll have plenty of time together. You can definitely, rigorously... train me!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: This flower is for you, to express my…

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: It's the correct timeline juncture. Initiating jump now!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hmph, this little troublemaker is clever, having set all these traps.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: They said this matrix contains Lady Flora's information, so… this must be something "I" had experienced in the past.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Sealed memories and this cave… this is where I first awoke.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Seems like this is what Lady Flora last saw before she decided to seal her memories.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: But {PlayerName} already made {Male=his;Female=her} choice. Now I must make my own choice, too.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Ha... I'd rather die than live as a useless nobody.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: …{PlayerName}? So I knew {Male=him;Female=her} before?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hahaha! That's it! {Male=He;Female=She}'s a magnet for all kinds of fun. Now let's see what else we can stir up!

After losing contact with you, Camellya crosses the Stargate and finds herself in the cave from the past. Like you, she has jumped through many simulated worlds and witnessed different possibilities, but her path always crosses with yours.\n\nIntrigued by the Lady Flora illusion in front of her, Camellya decides to follow.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: But now its core is cornered here, it can't run any further. I can handle it easily when I find it.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: It's a pity I got separated from {Male=him;Female=her}.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I wish {Male=he;Female=she} could see what I just saw in those alternative timelines. Can't wait to see {Male=his;Female=her} reactions.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: If I hadn't returned to the Black Shores and become a Bloom Bearer again…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: It was still possible for us to reunite! I saw it! Whether as a wandering traveler or a Fractsidus member, I got to meet {Male=him;Female=her} anyway!

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I've sealed my memories, letting the past fade into nothingness.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: ...Did I make the right choice?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Is that… me?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Guess I'd better not use my Forte, or I'd be at a disadvantage when {PlayerName} catches up later.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Lady Flora's illusion is ahead.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: If this is indeed the final moments before you sealed your memories, let me find out the reasons.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Let me see why you made that choice.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: After all these years, {Male=he;Female=she} still made that choice…

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I never asked {Male=him;Female=her} much about the Black Shores or {Male=his;Female=her} past.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Haha, for the Black Shores, a better future must mean saving Solaris.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Doing all of this for what? A so-called better outcome?

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I don't care about that at all.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Why? Why do I have to lose my only beloved playmate, my most cherished opponent!

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Here at the Black Shores, {Male=he;Female=she}'s the most trapped one... by far.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Ugh, is this an illusion from the past? Looks like I used to be quite… sentimental.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Though I had this guess while in the previous junctures—{PlayerName} was indeed the former Black Shores leader.

Lady Flora explains that the past duties imposed on the one she yearns for led to their decision to leave the Black Shores. Camellya listens to her past self, surprised by her depth of emotion. Through Lady Flora's words, Camellya realizes that you are the leader of the Black Shores.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I didn't care. As long as we were both happy when we crossed blades, I was happy.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: But now, {PlayerName} wants to leave… and even abandon {Male=his;Female=her} memories?

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: Hello, you must be {PlayerName}, right? Beatrice filled me in on what happened.

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: Rabelle's Curve, this subject tends to enter the Overclocking state… currently stable… (static)…

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The Black Shores leader handled the issue {Male=himself;Female=herself}… So I brought this Lady Flora back to the Black Shores?)

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: The recording ends there. I had just joined the Black Shores back then, feeling curious about everything… especially about our leader.

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: Everything about {Male=him;Female=her} was shrouded in mystery, and only a select few had ever met {Male=him;Female=her}.

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: But I didn't give up. I started looking into the other name mentioned in the recording: Lady Flora.

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: The Stellar Matrix you're hunting down contained information about Lady Flora.

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: But… I found nothing. Someone deliberately erased the data, and I'm locked out from any remaining traces.
Someone wiped everything about Lady Flora…

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: Yeah. That piqued my interest, so I asked—well, pestered—my seniors to see if I could get anything.

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: Lady Flora was said to be very close to the Black Shores leader. They were inseparable and carried out many missions together.

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: The reason I looked into that Stellar Matrix is because of this little guy I found in the wild.

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: Unfortunately, Lady Flora has been missing for nearly two decades…

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Missing… Seems like I can't use this clue to locate that matrix.

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: Not necessarily. You're a trusted Bloom Bearer of the Shorekeeper, right?

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: The Hall of Foreign Affairs stores a lot of information about the Black Shores personnel. Try your luck there. Maybe you'll find something.

The Consultant reveals the data was intentionally erased, but it involves the leader of the Black Shores—your past self—and a Bloom Bearer named Lady Flora. You learn that you once saved Lady Flora from Petalfall Village and shared a deep bond, but she vanished twenty years ago.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A small, damaged, and slightly old-looking robot quietly rests at her feet.

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: When I found it, it had been non-functional for a long time.

speaker: NPC #1549
anh_en: I tried to fix it, but I couldn't salvage much data… I only got this damaged recording:

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: …May: Majority of buildings in Petalfall Village damaged from Tacet Discord invasion. Heavy casualties. Survivors have been transferred…

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: Threat level extremely high according to the Tethys System. The Black Shores leader has decided to handle the issue {Male=himself;Female=herself} and has departed to…

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: (Static)… The village's remaining structures covered by highly mutated plants. Rescuing is difficult. More time needed…

speaker: NPC #1412
anh_en: A… (static)… was discovered in a deep underground cave. One Overclocked Resonator named 'Lady Flora' was rescued and taken to Black Shores. Biography pending...

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: My Rabelle Index has worsened. The doctors and the Shorekeeper said I need a rest.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: ...Hmph. They mean well, but… I know myself better.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: But now, thinking about the past will only make my Overclocking worse.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Hehe, was our encounter there a gift from fate… or a curse?

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: {PlayerName} is gone. I can choose to wait, but will {Male=he;Female=she} really return?

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: What if… I'm already dead by then?

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: What if I never see {Male=him;Female=her} again?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Dead is dead. It means the end. There's no point in imagining all this.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Fearing loneliness and death…? These emotions are so unfamiliar… so strange.

Lady Flora's condition has gradually worsened ever since she lost her Anchor. As memories from before her arrival at Petalfall Village resurface, her Overlocking symptoms intensify. Camellya struggles to understand what it means to care about others.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Rest won't help… I've lost my anchor. {Male=He;Female=She}'s no longer here to rein me in.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I've started remembering things from before I came to Petalfall Village.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: What happened? My chest feels so tight, and I feel… a little unwell?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I must be affected by the environment. My body and emotions are…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: This Stellar Matrix is starting to fight back. I'd better hurry up and take it down.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Even with treatment, I'll barely be able to maintain my current state.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: But constant Overclocking and forced corrections will ruin me in the end.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Trapped in my body, needing {Male=his;Female=her} pity for love and attention...

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: If that's how I'll end up, I'd rather die on the spot!

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I will never… become a pitiful… weakling... like that...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Ugh, my body... It's acting up again... Is it the surroundings?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hahaha! Why am I always held back by Overclocking... Dammit...

Lady Flora refuses treatment, fearing it will leave her with nothing. Without her power, she would feel forever inferior to the one she cherishes, a fate she cannot accept. The heavy atmosphere triggers Camellya's own Overclocking symptoms to flare up.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I can feel my energy and power draining away, day by day...

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Even if {PlayerName} one day returns, what will I be able to do for {Male=him;Female=her}?

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: …It's time to go. To where I met {PlayerName}. It will be closure for me, for this cherished connection.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I'll leave the bracelet {Male=he;Female=she} gave me here in the Black Shores.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Sanity is a gift from {Male=him;Female=her}. I would not give it up that easily.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: There is... another way, to keep Overclocking from eating me inside out.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: A way to control my emotions... Stop the past from haunting me. A way to forget it all.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I will abandon my memories like {PlayerName} once did, sealing them away.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I am one and the same with my instincts.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Like flowers thirst for water, and beasts hunger for flesh…

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: With or without my memories, my instincts will still guide me to {Male=him;Female=her}.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: When we meet again, I hope {Male=he;Female=she} remains my worthy opponent. Friends or foes, united and unbound... It's a dream come true!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe, indeed, that's the choice I would make.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Cough… I will bloom to my fullest... follow my desires… till the end of it all.

To put an end to her severe Overclocking, Lady Flora decides to abandon her memories, including all those of you. She believes that her connection to you is intrinsic to her nature and will ultimately guide her back to you. When that day arrives, she hopes to stand as their equal.\n\nWatching her past self, Camellya acknowledges and accepts this choice.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I can't just sit here and rot away, clinging to old memories.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: …I... can't see the road ahead…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: One more step… I can't... die here...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: ...Huff... Ugh...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: …Shut up.

speaker: NPC #1550
anh_en: Are you?

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I passed the Bloom Bearer test!

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: Take me with you next time, please?

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: I'll try my best to control myself for you, dear master.

speaker: NPC #1411
anh_en: You'll abandon all memories and start over? Where are you going?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Heh… Having been there so many times...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I thought I was used to Overclocking...

speaker: NPC #1550
anh_en: All that talk about power, about being free...

speaker: NPC #1550
anh_en: And now? You're just a loser.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: ...I have no plan to drown here.

speaker: NPC #1550
anh_en: Consume and be consumed by power... What's wrong with that!

speaker: NPC #1409
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}, what brings you here?
(Fill him in the situation.)

speaker: NPC #1409
anh_en: Oh? But Lady Flora's item was already picked up by another Bloom Bearer.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Who took it?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: You looking for me?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe, if you want it, try to catch me!
At the Hall of Foreign Affairs, you discover that Camellya has already taken Lady Flora's belongings. Now, you must find Camellya.

speaker: NPC #1550
anh_en: How pathetic. Everything will be forgotten anyway.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Once I joined the Fractsidus, and we met in battle.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I may forget you, again and again…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: But as long as I still have my instincts…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I'll always gravitate towards you.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: And I know...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: You'll find me at the end of it all!

speaker: NPC #1550
anh_en: What is the point?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: What do YOU know?

speaker: NPC #1550
anh_en: You… will never be {Male=his;Female=her} equal. Ever.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Forget and be forgotten...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: So what!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: {PlayerName}...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I traveled far and wide in our time apart. Fate led me back to you every time.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Once I was a nameless traveler, passing you right by.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Ah… Fighting by your side feels sooo good. My heart, my pulse, my frequencies—the vibrations are driving me crazy!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Such weaklings. I haven't had enough fun yet.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hah... Welcome back, {PlayerName}. Glad to see you again.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I saw a lot of interesting stuff… I woke up in that cave a decade ago. Traveled all across Solaris before I ended up back at the Black Shores.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: The matrix showed me several different iterations of my past. Looks like even the smallest deviations can lead to entirely different outcomes.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: But one constant remained—you always saved me, and we always found each other.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Our encounter is preordained in every future...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: My beloved seed, my only… rival.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: And you just helped me with my Overclocking… Hmph, I won't let it happen again.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Gotta make sure to show you my best!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This Stellar Matrix should be temporarily deactivated since its core has been dealt with.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Let's go back. Give the coordinates to Beatrice, and this mission will be over.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Then... can I have the rest of your day?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What do you wanna do?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe, let me keep it a secret for now.
Camellya smiles weakly before joyfully recounting what happened in the Stellar Matrix.

You find yourself reunited with Camellya. Considering the years apart, this reunion has been ten years in the making. In every world, you and she have met, parted, and reunited again. If this is your fate, Camellya embraces it willingly.\n\nWith the Stellar Matrix defeated, the two of you return home.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Anyway, {PlayerName}, where did you go after that? How did you find this place?
(Tell her what happened.)

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: You saw those possible iterations of history too?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe… So you really were the leader of Black Shores.
…Yes.
I'm back.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: No wonder I felt something familiar when I first saw you outside Jinzhou…

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Welcome back! Glad to see you safely return. Thank you for your hard work.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hmm, let me think... To the surface. Veiled Rock, the starting point.
With the Stellar Matrices back in order, Camellya invites you to Veiled Rock.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: A Stellar Matrix is no match for us. Easy peasy.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Have you received the coordinates?

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: Yes, thank you. Leave the rest to us.

speaker: NPC #1423
anh_en: By the way, Camellya, Shorekeeper asked me to remind you. Please use the medical pod in good time.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: What? My symptoms are already gone… Alright, I'll go later. She really worries too much.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: But she helped keep my bracelet safe too. Heh, I owe her that.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: {PlayerName}, shall we go?
Go where?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: When I found those photos, I made a decision.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Photos are great for capturing memories. Take some photos of me.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: In the past, others recorded us, but now we'll have to do it ourselves.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Consider it... a tangible keepsake.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: They last longer than our memories. A moment frozen in frame.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: As the Black Shores leader, a small task like this would be a piece of cake for you, I bet?
Camellya asks you to take a photo of this moment as a way to capture her current feelings.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: {PlayerName}, stay focused. Don't take your eyes off me!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Looks good. I wanna keep a copy of this too.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Excellent composition. Quite the photographer, aren't you? Hehe…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Is it a flower seed on the base?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: The flower seed has unveiled the hidden path. Hehe, this space seems to defy its creator's will to aid me.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I guess I have no choice but to catch up with Camellya first.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: That flower is craving a flower seed. Guess I should place a seed there to unlock the gate.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe, as I expected.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Heh, want to stand in my way? Get lost!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: A flower seed should do the trick.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Good, the patterns are lighting up. Now I can rotate the platform.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: So this is the correct path to take.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A notebook, a stack of photographs, and a portable water bottle are strewn on the ground. The warmth of the water suggests the owner left only moments ago.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The photos depict various landscapes of the Black Shores, indicating the owner's passion for photography. To your surprise, one of the photos is a candid shot of your own silhouette.

speaker: NPC #800076
anh_en: This is odd... Where could they be hiding...?
What's going on?

speaker: NPC #800076
anh_en: Well, a group of newcomers arrived today, but I just got word that there's one more than what was on the list.

speaker: NPC #800076
anh_en: We're not sure if someone slipped in unnoticed, so we're doing a full sweep of the area.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Oh, you're quick! I knew you wouldn't keep me waiting.
Then how did you know you're Lady Flora?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Of course, I did some digging, but… a little accident stopped me.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (If Camellya is Lady Flora, then we were supposed to be close, but neither of us remembers…)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (The fact that I used to be the leader... This should only be known to the Shorekeeper.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Maybe I shouldn't mention it to Camellya until I'm sure she's not a threat.)

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: {PlayerName}, if you want to use that trinket to find the problematic matrix, then play with me! Entertain me, and I'll help you.
What shall we play?
What if I say no?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Well… Then I'll take this and make a run for it!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: You can try to catch me, but be warned, it won't be an easy chase. Or, you could play along and maybe I'll let you have it. It'll be more fun that way!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Were you following me?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Since you handled the Threnodian, a little game of battle shouldn't be too much trouble for you, right?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: As a Bloom Bearer, I need to pick the perfect seeds for the Black Shores and give them my utmost care.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: All these years, I haven't met anyone intriguing—not one person!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: You're MY seed of fate. If I let you go so easily, all my efforts, my yearning, my hunger will not be satisfied.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: If you get taken or killed by somebody else...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: ...I would be very, very, very unhappy.
Why are you so obsessed with me?
Why do you call me your seed of fate?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Why? It's pure instinct!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Flowers thirst for water; beasts hunger for flesh. It's nature, just like my craving for you.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Yeah, is that a problem?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I want it, and I get it. That's how I live.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That fleeing Stellar Matrix might affect the Necrostar’s functioning. Worse, it could threaten the Black Shores.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: So? I don't care! If this island's gonna blow up, so be it. Unless, of course, it ruins my fun.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Are you angry? Hehe, your anger is sooo delicious…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Fight me. I can't wait to see who'll be the winner. I've been itching to get a taste of your blade.
Enough small talk. I'll play.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hahahaha! Fantastic! Let's get started!

After catching up with Camellya, she reveals that she is Lady Flora, but like you, she has lost her memories. She appears indifferent to everything except you and proposes a game in exchange for handing over Flora's items.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I followed you to the cell on a whim. Then I heard something interesting.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Plus, this thing is just finding its way back to its owner. I see no wrong in that.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: To its owner… Are you that "Lady Flora"?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Yes and no.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Just like you, I've completely forgotten about the past! All of it! So, I guess I'm not the Lady Flora you're looking for.
You've lost your memory too…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Found you!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Ah, the breeze here... It feels so perfect against my skin.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: The waves crashing, the light shimmering on the water's surface...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe, don't you think? Maybe we used to sit here like this, together...

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Feeling the wind, watching the night unfold before us, again and again...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Something's on the ground? I need to check it out.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Another camellia... She's never tired of these little games.

speaker: NPC #1550
anh_en: Hahaha, come be my prey, sweet little birdie!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Let's crush this pesky creature together!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Cracked bricks line the room, where massive vines coil through the space, their roots plunging deep into the walls and floor.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As you observe more closely, you notice the vines subtly pulsating, as if they were veins.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Debris and broken equipment are scattered across the floor, the aftermath of uncontrolled chaos.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Unlike the composed Camellya you once met in Jinzhou, her current, uncontrolled state has left her struggling to manage her Forte.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A malfunctioning screen flickers, displaying a log of recent visitors to the Black Shores.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: From the data, you discover that Lady Flora was brought here only recently, and her condition has deteriorated rapidly over the past days.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Before I passed the assessment, I went ask the Gardeners about some key things we should know.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Wow, you really think ahead, don't you?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: While you were handling the troubles at the Black Shores, I was stuck in a medical pod and missed the whole show.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: What a pity I couldn't witness it in person… Show me. Your blade, your strength.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So this whole place has been covered in mist... that explains a lot.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So what, just sit here, doing nothing?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Seems like it. The Gardener mentioned someone might've slipped in unnoticed...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: So beautiful...
You will be switched to Camellya's perspective.
Not long ago.\nIn the corrupted Stellar Matrix, Camellya has already passed through three Stargates, witnessing the possibilities of several different worlds before arriving in an underground cave.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Shall we head to the Modulation Hall now?
Let's go.
No, I've got something else to handle first.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Really? Fine... I'll be a very good girl, waiting patiently for your return, hehe.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe, you should always stay focused in a game.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: The fresh, pulsating despair from my enemies is always delightful...

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Back again, are you, Unwritten?
Next time... Are you leaving already?

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Eh? Wh-what's with that knowing, smug tone of yours?!

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Just so you know, I'm not the type to always stay in one place, and it's not that I have nowhere else to go… I just... happen to like this place a bit more, for some reason.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Ahem! It's possible you'll come here next time and… find no one waiting.
Will you let that happen?

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: ...I'm not sure.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: What?! The future's unpredictable. No one can see all of it, not even a Priestess… Not that I am one anymore.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Stop looking at me like that... Alright, fine! Even if I do end up somewhere else, I'll let you know where to find me.
So you've made plans for the future.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: The future? I have—

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: I know I've told you what makes this place special. I even shared the moonlight with you... but visiting this often? It's a little...

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Absolutely no idea!

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Someone who longed to catch the moon kept trying, over and over again… until finally, what seemed impossible became reality.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: But once that brief joy faded, what came next was just uncertainty... Is this where it ends? Is that all there is?
Once again, you have what you wanted.
Once again, you did what you set out to do.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: What, you too…? That's just the usual praise people give to the so-called "prodigy."

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: I'm nowhere near true completeness. I can never achieve that.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: But you're not entirely wrong. To do or to get anything, you must know what you truly want. Only then will you see where to go.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: So… come a little closer.
Eh?

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Don't tell me you just like staring at the moon?

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: That kind of want can't be rushed. Until then, it's fine to stay here a little longer, isn't it?
It's because you said you like this place.
It's because I knew I'd find you here.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Oh? So you're only here because I like it?

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: I only mentioned it once, yet you remembered so clearly... Maybe you know me better than I thought, Unwritten.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: I suppose next time I should tell you about all the other places I like, too.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Normally I prefer chance encounters and surprises. But with you... even a planned meeting can be surprisingly fun.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: That's how I feel now. Life at the Academy is peaceful. The students can be a handful sometimes, but I'd never change their vibrant spirits. To be able to share a casual conversation with you like this... I couldn't feel more at home.
I'm glad to hear that.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: Yes... It's a long life. A new season is only beginning. So many possibilities lie ahead, within reach. Sprouting trees, melting snow. Little changes like these... They're signs.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: By the way, I'm usually here. Whenever you're tired, bored… or just need someone to talk to, come find me.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: After all, even when we're talking about such small nothings, we'd find ourselves healing.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: I hope you have a happy, fulfilling day, {Male=golden boy;Female=golden girl}.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: {PlayerName}? What a rare guest. Are you just stopping by... or did you come seeking an old friend?
I was just stopping by.
I came to see you.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: Your timing couldn't be better. I've just filed the week's medical records and was mulling over what to do next. A book or my student's suggestion—It's sprouting season, you see. Perhaps a stroll would be nice?
Before coming to the Academy, where did you travel to?

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: Before this? Quite a few. There was an observatory up north. Freezing cold at night, but the view of the river of stars stretching across the dome was not to be missed for the world.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: I also stayed in a coastal city, where salty breezes blew through the year. I learned how to brew wine with golden berries… Unfortunately, it turned out far too sweet for my taste, so I gifted the entire batch to my neighbors instead.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: See? You have to see the world before you find your stops.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: {PlayerName}? How are you doing? Still busy saving the world?
I'm doing fine. Not too busy.
Too many things on my plate…

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: That's good to hear. Keeping your own pace matters.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: Then it sounds like it's time you gave yourself a proper break.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: In fact, you're not alone. I meant to tidy up my room once I wrapped up my work… but somehow, one thing after another kept getting in the way.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: I suppose that's just life. Plans rarely keep up with change. All we can really do is find a way to breathe comfortably in the spaces between the chaos.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: ...Gravitational field... Orbital parameters... Fusion reaction...

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: ...but my lights... will one day...
Good evening, Mornye.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: M-Mentor?!

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: I should be awake now... But I remember I came here alone. Why are you here?
I thought I'd see the stars.
I thought I'd see you.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Mm, if you came to stargaze, this place does provide an optimal vantage point. That's why I'm here.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Oh?!

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Did you seek me out to discuss something? Was it about the Spacetrek Collective, Helios, or...

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Distance in light years...

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: ...Or is it because you, like me, have been reminiscing about our time beneath this sky?

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Do you... want to sit with me for a bit? Like... like before?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Is Mornye... sleep talking?)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Should I wake her up? But this place is safe. Maybe leave her be for a while.)
(Wake her up.)
(Wait quietly.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Mornye, wake up.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: ...Progress may be slow...

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: The Sky Projection Array has no precipitation scheduled for today. We can expect a clear sky.
You seem a bit lonely.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: ...Perhaps it's because of the dream I just had.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: In it, I became one of the stars.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: At first, I was just an infinitesimal speck of dust adrift in the dark, silent expanse of space.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Then came a day. Gravity tightened its grip on the nebula around me. In that collapse of matter, unstoppable fusion made my core searingly hot. And I... began to shine.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: I realized I had become one of them. Among millions of stars, I too had my own light.
So distant.
So bright.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Yes. And then, I sent my light on a journey.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: It passed through nebulae curled like silver foil, felt gravitational tremors ringing through galaxies. I witnessed black holes warping space, exploding stardust swallowed by silent roars.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Look, see the brightest star in the dome? If you connect the stars surrounding it, the shape resembles a lighthouse.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: And then... I finally saw this place.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: It may take time. Even at light speed, this journey may take years. But my light... One day, it will find its way into Lahai-Roi's sky. It will shine here, alongside all the others.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: And it will... reach your eyes.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: In reality, their positions are infinitely far apart, yet their light is so intense... it feels almost within reach.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Just like my dreams.
The New Solar Ceremony was a success.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Yes. I am very happy.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: This brings the Spacetrek Collective one step closer to its goals. To reactivating the Exostrider in the frostlands, and to reaching beyond this starry dome.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Mentor, Lahai-Roi is moving under its own power now.
You seem happy.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Hello again, Mentor.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Have you come... to see the stars as well?
I came to see the stars.
I came to see you.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Please, have a seat beside me.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Oh, that's... To know you were thinking of me here, under this sky... I feel happy.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Here… please, sit beside me, Mentor.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: The stars seem especially bright tonight, don't they?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: For my thesis acknowledgments, I'll include my advisor, my parents, and {PlayerName}.
Wouldn't that be a bit too much?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: I'm glad you think so. I'd be happy to write about it. And I really do owe you a formal thank-you.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Hmm... I don't think so.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Without your help, I never would have made it back to the Academy. So... yes. I owe you a formal thank-you.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Life at Startorch is good. Demanding, but fulfilling. I don't have to wear a mask here. Every day, something new fills me. I never felt this before. Not in my hometown, not in Honami.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: And... when I come home now, my parents are there.
They're not too busy with work anymore?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Mm-hmm. During the years I was missing, they moved to Lahai-Roi and took up Academy positions offered by President Lucilla.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: I think they wanted to stay. To keep searching for me. For twenty years, they never gave up.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Remember that radio broadcast in Honami? The new Academy uniforms? My mother designed them. The inspiration... was a pattern I cut out when I was little.
Good afternoon.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: They were here, waiting for me all that time. And now, I finally get to be there for them, too.
I'm really happy for you.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: By the way, after I told them about you, they've been insisting on thanking you in person.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: I did say you're probably very busy... But please, let me know when you have a free moment.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: My father makes the best Ashinohara dishes.
What are you up to?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Oh, {PlayerName}. Good afternoon. What a coincidence, I was just about to message you.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: I finally finished my thesis for Synth Armament Studies. Thought I'd rest my eyes for a bit while figuring out the acknowledgments section.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: It's the only part of the paper with no format to follow. It requires emotional honesty, not methodology or logic. And somehow, that's the part I have to think about the longest...

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: There are so many people I want to thank. My advisor, my classmates, my parents. And... you.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: So I was wondering, if I included our experiences in Honami, would that be okay with you?
It would be my honor.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: If we ever end up in the same class, come find me. That'll be nice.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Once my classmates found out my father makes my bento, they started asking for a bite during lunch. Ever since, he's packed extra portions.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: We could share a meal together sometime. Just the two of us, like in Honami. Or with more people. Both are great.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: I think... this is it. This is what "being young" is supposed to feel like.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Hehehe, look who's here... Now be good. Pats incoming!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Are you looking at where <ano=the Exostrider>Lahai-Roi</ano> disappeared?

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Yeah... I don't know. I feel a bit conflicted about it.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: It's still out there, beyond the Stridergate. Guarding this world all alone, day after day. It's gotta be wearing down. Who knows how much longer it can hold on.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Can't help worrying... What if it just breaks down one day?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I think, before that day comes, the people of Lahai-Roi will find a way to cross the Etheric Sea.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: We already promised "Lahai-Roi" we'd meet again in the boundless sea of stars, right?

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Haha. When you put it that way, I do feel more confident. That's our Savior of Solaris for you.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: You're right. We will meet again someday.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Aemeath tilts her head in thought, then smiles at you.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Since you're here, why don't we head back home to rest for a bit?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You see Aemeath crouching near some Snowfluff Seals. Her smile is soft as she reaches out to ruffle the fur on one of their heads.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: I'm fine, obviously. But you're probably freezing in this wind.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Come on! A quick nap does wonders, I promise.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Snowfluff Seals look dazed, their eyes squinted as they remain still, as if knowing resistance is futile by Aemeath's aura alone.
Are you messing with them again, Aemeath?
They don't dare budge an inch...

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Puh-lease. This is just how we get along!

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: By the way, why didn't you message me on WavesLine before coming all the way here? I could've picked you up.
Just felt like dropping by.
I'll message you next time.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Head back home together, {PlayerName}?
Sure, let's go home.
I want to stay here a little longer.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Great! Let's go!

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Okay! I'll be waiting for you here then.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Us lounging on the couch, doing nothing, listening to the snow fall outside... It's nice, isn't it?
That'd be great, Aemeath. Thanks.
(Close your eyes)
With Aemeath's gentle humming nearby, you drift into a light, peaceful sleep.
In your dream, the spring sun warms the windowsill of your home. Your family is there beside you, and for a moment, everything is as it should be.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: I come back every now and then to tidy up. That's why it always feels kinda lived-in.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Soft couch, fire crackling in the fireplace, neat bookshelves... See, I haven't just got my saving the world thing under control. I'm taking care of my home life, too.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Pretty impressive, right?
Yeah, our Aemeath is something else.
I'll give you credit for that.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Hehe...

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: I think this little place is perfect now. When you're tired, you've always got somewhere to come back to.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: See? You're already looking sleepy.... Nap for a bit? If you're worried about missing something, I can wake you up later.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Welcome home!

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Besides, that's exactly what road-trip movies are all about. Looking forward to the next stop, but always soaking in the sights along the way.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Next time, bring me a souvenir? Hehe, I want something YOU picked out yourself. Something you think is worth keeping!

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: ...Really? Someone actually upset you that much?

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Well, I'm committed to this whole savior thing, but I can drop that for you.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Whenever you need me, I'm here. So... {PlayerName}, do you want me to take care of those annoyances for you?

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: I see... So that's what happened.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Like I've said before, you're just like everyone else. You don't have to carry more than your fair share... even though you always do.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: If you're hurting and need a shoulder to cry on, that's okay. I'll be right here. Always.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You share your joys and sorrows with Aemeath, and her expressions shift with your words—delight and anger, excitement and concern.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The sights from your journey become easy conversation. In this quiet haven, the noise of the world fades away.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: I came back to spend the night, and here you are! Talk about being in sync, huh?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Outside, snow drifts down in whispers. Inside, spring has made its home.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: No matter how nice other places are, there's nothing like sleeping in your own bed. If you'd come any later, I'd already be asleep!

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Since we're both awake on a snowy night like this, wanna... tell me a bedtime story? Just like old times.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: What kind of stories have you picked up on your travels lately? C'mon, tell me! I really wanna hear.
(Tell a story of joy.)
(Tell a story of anger.)
(Tell a story of sadness.)

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Aww, that's how it should be! Gotta be enjoying the view, no matter where you go. That's what counts.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Hm. Interesting strategy. Don't usually see that from a new team. No wonder they're racking up points.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: That's the spirit! That's my partner!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Hey, Lupa, waiting for your turn?

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Oh, hey, fellow warrior! Come on over. This spot's got the best view.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: I'm not fighting today, but it never hurts to study the competition. As a professional contender, you have to know your enemy, right?

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: On days without post-training banquets, I always stay in the arena.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: ...That was a sharp move. Got my blood pumping. Makes me itch for a fight.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: So, what do you say? Spar with me once this match is over?

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: It's been a while since we crossed blades. I bet you've picked up some new Echo companions, haven't you? Show me what you've got.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Sure, why not?

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: If you're up for it, what do you say we go another round?

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Honestly, I didn't get enough out of our last spar.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Delicacies aren't meant to be tasted just once. Same goes for good fights.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: But... as much as I love crossing blades, nothing beats fighting side by side with you.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Remember when we teamed up and took the championship? Looking back, it still shines. The glory and the joy.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: It's beautiful...

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Look at that. This scene... It's just like the dusk on the day we reunited. Breathtaking.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Septimont, my city, my soul's harbor.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: It's endured the trials of fate, shielded by the heroes resting here.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: If this city's immortal, it's only because of its people.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Yes, yes... No, I promised I wouldn't overdo it this time. Really!

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Whenever she called back then, I'd just say "I'm good," or "Everything's fine."

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: I thought I was protecting her, you know? But the more I did that, the less I actually had to say. Isn't that strange?
You needed to make a change.
But it's better now, isn't it?

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: That's exactly what I thought!

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: It is. We talk a lot now.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: All the things I used to keep to myself... I actually let them out now.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Like how difficult my coursework feels, how tired I get, and how many things I still can't get right...

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: I never used to tell her any of that. But the moment I finally did, it felt like a shadow lifted.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Sounds like everything's moving in the right direction.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: I've been trying to say no to requests I can't handle. I'm fine. Don't worry, okay?

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Yeah! And I haven't slowed down either.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: There's so much I still want to do. And I'm gonna do it. One thing at a time.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: I think this is the answer I've found for myself!

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Yes, I'll keep in touch—Ah, my friend is here. I'll talk to you later, Mother. Okay, bye-bye.
Sorry to interrupt you.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: That's alright. I told Mother I'd call back later.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: We'd already been talking for a while before you showed up.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: I told her all about our adventure in the Dark Side, and what life's been like at the Academy...

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: We talked so much I completely lost track of time...

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: ...Oh, Senior. It's been so long since we talked like that with her.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Senior, if you're free sometime, would you like to visit my home?

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: I told Crackle all about you, and it's been so excited to meet you!
Who's Crackle?

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Oh, that's my pet bird. A Kronapuff.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: You have to be careful when you hold it, though.
Why?

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Because it's gotten a little fat!

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Senior! That's my diary!

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: There's... not much in there. But you can look, if you want.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The diary is filled with dense, overlapping schedules. Looking at them is enough to steal your breath. But on the most recent pages, many tasks are crossed out.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What about these ones you crossed out...?

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Oh, those? Just stuff that wasn't super urgent.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: I turned them all into... rest time!

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Oh, it's you.
After we dealt with that troublemaking Stellar Matrix…
You were here too.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe, you must really care about me, don't you? Well, noisy places irritate me, but here… it's perfect. Quiet.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Every time I watch the sea… it makes me feel happy.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: No thoughts, no distractions… just silence.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I've never shared my little haven with anyone. But you? You're different. You're special.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Camellya hums a tune as here eyes drift back to the sea. The melody stirs a sense of familiarity in your heart.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Hehe, you caught me again.
Here for the sea again, huh?
This is just a coincidence.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Mmm, my secret haven in the Black Shores… And guess what? You're the only one I'd ever allowed here.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Oh? Reall? After all the times you've "accidentally" bump into me? Hehe, how cute…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Sit?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: The warm light…

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Look at that, the morning sun over the sea… It's always that beautiful.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Rising silently, cutting through the darkness… It's the only time it's glow is tender and soft.
So, you come here for the sun?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Flowers thirst for light and water. It's their instinct.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: I'm no different.

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: But I can't always linger here. Being a Bloom Bearer means I have my own responsibilities.
Like what?

speaker: Xuân
anh_en: Oh, you're curious? But that's a secret, hehe.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: What brings you here?
I changed my mind.
Well, now I suddenly feel like giving it a try.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Aha. You turned me down without a second thought earlier... Yet, here you are now, and I'm glad for it.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: You came back of your own accord—that alone is enough to make me happy, at least for the moment.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: In Ragunna, there's never a shortage of secluded corners untouched by the masses. Yet somehow, you found me here. What a...

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: But at least when I came here, I simply wanted some fresh air.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: The day is beautiful. The performers' melodies drift from the opera house, and the streets are alive with chatter and shouts of people.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: The city and its people shimmer—golden, vibrant, precious.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: In this fleeting moment, I can forget about the troubles.
It seems family matters have been weighing on your mind?
What's troubling you? If you need to talk, I'm all ears.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Oh, you know how it is—endless deliberations, meticulous planning. There are a lot of things to consider.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Like... My new dress from Nyarla's? What to wear for the next ball? Or perhaps which treasures to bid for at the auction?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Haha, okay, I'll cut it.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Capollo... He has been disowned and dealt with. It's left me with a tangle of new challenges to manage.
A fortunate coincidence, Opal.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: My priorities remain the same: doing whatever that benefits the family. But now, with this new role entrusted to me, I carry new responsibilities—and with them, new strengths.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: As the next head of the family, it's my duty to face these responsibilities head-on, and to shape myself into the leader this position demands.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: But before this fleeting moment of peace is stolen away by duty, on an afternoon like this—

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Will you sit with me, Cat's Eye? Share a drink, share a bite?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Let's set aside the "codes" hidden behind every glass for once. Like ordinary folk, we'll just savor the flavors for what they are, as they were meant to be.
(Nod in agreement)
(Shake your head)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Thankfully, you have no pressing matters to attend to. On such a peaceful afternoon, sharing this moment with Carlotta feels like the right choice.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Drinking during the day? You hesitate, questioning whether this is wise with your other commitments. Though you must decline her offer this time, perhaps you'll accept the next.
I had a gut feeling I'd find you here.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Hehe, fate has a funny way of leading us exactly where our hearts want to be, don't you think, Cat's Eye?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: It seems I'm not the only one who finds our time together hard to forget, am I? What do you say, Cat's Eye?
Were you expecting someone?
Or perhaps, you already have plans with someone else?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: My answer is no to both questions.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: If someone were to approach me with a special drink right now, I wouldn't decline a conversation.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: A peaceful afternoon like this is always a delight, gilded in golden sunlight.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Of course, you could also order it to flaunt our bond. It'll grant you the protection of Montelli.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Why? Because its recipe is a secret known only to me and a select few Montellis.
Will you share this secret with me?
Your secret is safe with me.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Hehe, there's no need for promises. I've already placed my trust in you, completely.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Alright, then. Here's the recipe—listen closely. White rum, rose nectar, pomegranate juice, a pinch of black pepper, and a touch of fritillaria powder.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Got it?
(Recite it back to her.)
(Ask her to repeat it.)

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Alright, I'll repeat it for you. White rum, rose nectar, pomegranate juice, a pinch of black pepper, and a touch of fritillaria powder.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: To match this serenity, would you care to try a special blend?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Be sure to remember it well.
What would it take to create a special blend?
I'd like one for myself.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: You mean a signature drink named after you, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Let's come up with one, then. Feel free to choose from any flavor or color, or select a symbol that resonates with you.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: No limits—let your creativity shape your perfect beverage. You'll find it in the bars once you make your choice.
Something icy and clear, sharp enough to focus the mind.
Something daring and strange—something no one else would try.
What kind of beverage am I to you?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: ...You've always felt a bit distant to me, whether you're making decisions or fighting. It fits the first impression I had of you.
A special blend? How special are we talking?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Oh? I didn't expect you'd go for an unusual blend. It might actually work pretty well as a "code."

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: My opinion? Hmm, that's hard to say... Maybe something with a base of herbs and fruity flavors, rather than a pure grain spirit.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: It reminds me of the quiet kindness tucked away beneath your remarkable strength.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: But there's no need to rush. You'll have plenty of time to decide what kind of blend embodies you best.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: And before that, shall we savor this moment?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You understand her unspoken message—some questions aren't meant to be answered right away.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: She wants to preserve this moment of tranquility, untouched by worry or haste. By your side, she feels at peace, and she hopes you feel the same.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Time seems to pause between you. Without exchanging another word, you hold each other's gaze. In this silence, you and Carlotta become what she just described—a golden shimmer, vibrant and fleeting, yet infinitely precious.
I think I've seen something like that on the menu before.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Oh? Are you referring to the "codes" scattered around our usual meeting places and open-air bars?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Those are certainly impressive, but not quite what I had in mind. I'm referring to a blend inspired by my codename, "Opal."
Like the "Scarlet Velvet Ribbon" tied to Scarlet Velvet?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Precisely.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Opal is more than just a drink—it's your key to reach me. Order it at any bar in Rinascita, and the Montelli network will ensure your message finds me.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Such a peaceful, warm afternoon... It's spent well enough simply basking in the sunshine.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Good to see you again, Cat's Eye.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: You've found me in my little corner once more.
Just like every other time.
The sunshine is as pleasant as ever today.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: It seems you've mastered the secret of finding me.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Then stay and share another afternoon with me, won't you?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Yes. Like I said before, a peaceful afternoon such as this is always soothing.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: So stay with me.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Let us savor this serenity together.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: You've come to this Sonoro Sphere once again. What is it this time?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Thus, I must be their envoy.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: But Ragunna has seen so much change...

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: There is so much I've never seen before. Food, dance, music, and...

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: So many new faces.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Truly... Much time has passed.
Cartethyia...

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: That means every day is filled with possibilities!

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: That is a feeling I do enjoy.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Knowing where you want to be and where you'd like to go is a wonderful feeling to have.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: On a request? Procurement of a rare plant species...? To remember the past?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Do you mind closing your eyes while I take you somewhere?
Can I keep them open?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Do as I say, just this once. Let's make the journey special.
What if I didn't need a reason?
Why don't you tell me your reason for being here?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Then I take it our meeting is nothing more than a coincidence?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: I am here to share with them... what has become of Ragunna.
Them?
You mean those who've passed away?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Yes. Unlike me, they are forever trapped in this Sonoro. Unable to witness the changes in the world they protected.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Well, do you accept my invitation?
Doesn't hurt to try, I guess.
I need to think about it.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Now, close your eyes.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: There's still plenty of time. Take your time to consider it.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: All right, no peeking.
You are slowly lifted into the air. After landing, Cartethyia takes her hands off your eyes.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Listen.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: They are responding... Responding to you and me.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Just as you said, they hear everything... They can even feel.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: The world can be cruel, but it's not completely without kindness.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Those who seek kindness give kindness in return. It has always been this way.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Thanks to you, I won't have to abandon such feelings.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: You're here.
What are you watching this time?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: The places I've been before, and places I've yet to visit.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: What about you?
Another chance meeting like last time.
I'm here because of our last chance meeting.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Then how about you stay a little longer, same as before?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: ...Then how about we let it last a bit longer?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Hmm... Is this the kind of story that's popular these days?

speaker: NPC #50074

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: I'm afraid I might not be able to stop myself from standing up... I hope you don't think it's because I can't afford a ticket.
Admissions are free by the way.

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Really?!

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: No... I must resist!
Why not sit with the audience?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Eek!

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Phew... It's you. For a second, I thought someone noticed me.
Can you really hear and see everything from here?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Actually... It's fine...
Your Tacet Mark is glowing...
You're not using your Forte, are you?

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: I can't exactly reveal myself just yet. Besides, in the past, the audience was never allowed to offer their opinions after a performance...

speaker: NPC #50074
anh_en: Hmm... Interesting.
Don't you want to be closer?

speaker: NPC #50074
