speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: How fortuitous, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: With peace returning to Ragunna, I've finally found time to explore the city.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Taking one's time to choose an afternoon tea like this... is quite delightful.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Such peace is hard-earned. I would like to share it with you. Might you join me for a cup of tea at Porto-Veno Castle this afternoon?
Sure.
I'll drop by when I can.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Heh, I shall be waiting.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Heh, I know the weight of your responsibilities well. But do ensure your own needs are met before you extend yourself to others.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Please, try the tea I've just brewed.
It tastes different from before.
A refreshing flavor. Is this a new blend?

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Oh? You have a keen palate. I procured this tea from Ragunna City.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: We Fisalias used to drink only Velvet Dream leaves to resist the Threnodian's whispers. I've always been curious about the taste of ordinary tea beyond our estate.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: The delicate sweetness and subtle fragrance of this tea remind me of a breeze sweeping the countryside, or the dew on leafy buds...

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Thank you for sharing this moment with me.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: I hope such an afternoon brings you as much tranquility as it brings me.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Rest well.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: A pleasure to see you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: What brings you to the estate today?
Just needed a little break.
I wanted to see you.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Hehe, so you've made the Fisalia estate your haven of rest, have you? An honor, to be sure.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Ah, I must say... I'm rather touched.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Well, with you here, this afternoon will be made all the more pleasant. Even the sunlight streaming through the window feels a little softer.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: Please. Make yourself at home.

speaker: NPC #150009
anh_en: After all... we've already agreed, no need for formalities.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Oops. Busted.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Hey, I'm not taking the bad rap for this. What about all my good qualities? You could've picked up any of those, ya know...

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Plus, we're in the same class now—Ta-da! Check out my official acceptance letter!
How does it feel to be re-enrolled?
How'd it feel when you got the letter?

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: I knew I would pass the test, but it still felt surreal to actually get the letter...

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Remember I told you that this spot always chills me out?

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Guess it's the merc in me. I hate dark, cramped spaces. Prefer being up high. Better view, harder to pin down.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: I used to hide out up here all by myself, just feeling the breeze and looking down over all of Startorch. It made me feel like...

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: As long as no one found me, everything I could see was mine. Like I was finally in control of my own choices. All the confusion and anxiety would just... blow away in the wind.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: But even back then, I always knew... in the sunlight, every shadow fades. Nowhere left to hide.
Figured you'd be here.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: But now, being back here, seeing the Academy bathed in the sun's warmth... I don't know, I just feel...

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Everything I have now is so alive and real, and all my past worries seem so minuscule and pointless. Did something inside me change?
At least your "character" never changed.
At least your "intentions" never changed.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Hehe... I've already taken all these courses. The professors cut me some slack on attendance, as long as I show up for the finals.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: And get this, all the demerits I racked up for unsanctioned vehicle modding and reckless driving were dropped after I re-enrolled!
Congrats! Try to keep your record clean this time.
Knowing you, you'll burn through your credits in no time, right?

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Whaaat? As a new student, of course I'll be on my best behavior. Probably. Maybe. I'll... try?

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Whaaat? As a new student, of course I'll be on my best behavior. Probably. Maybe. I'll... try?
Skipping classes again?

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: ...Yeah. I love this place. The life here, the people I care about...

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: I'm still gonna protect it all, in my own "Lynae" way.
This time, be sure to own what you see in the mirror.
This time, be true to yourself.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Phew... You're right! It's time to leave those masks and all that fear behind!

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Phew... You're right! It's time to leave those masks and all that fear behind!

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: All in all, I'm still me. Still chasing what's right in front of me. That never changed. The only difference is now I can face it all, no regrets.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: But, enough of this. Try some Jiggly-Giggly All-Flavor Beans. I heard each bean has a unique flavor.
Yeah, I'll try one!
That name alone is suspicious enough...

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Guess you know me well enough to pull off such a "targeted operation." Not many people know about this spot.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Open your mouth! Catch—

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: I see an opening! Catch—

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (As soon as the bean hits your tongue, competing flavors go off in your mouth like fireworks—sour, spicy, bitter, salty...)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (You're sure this is exactly the kind of funky-flavored candy Lynae would enjoy.)

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (But as the flavor riot quiets down, all that's left is a kind of... fruity sweetness.)

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Judging by your face... we got the same flavor! Not half bad, right?

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Now, the only question I need to think about is how to spend the next few years here.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: But then again, maybe I've always known the answer...

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Seize every fleeting moment, bitter or sweet... and paint it in colors of my own.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: This moment will be no exception!

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: What's your excuse, then? Shouldn't you be in a class right now?

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Ah—Good times never last! My next class is with Professor Mornye. Can't skip that...

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Hey, let's go for a joyride next time we're both free, whaddya say?

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Oh, I heard the Royan Market got a new shipment. Lots of cool stuff, from toys and paints to game consoles and motorbike accessories. So many are going on my shopping list…

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Also, don't forget, you promised me we'd go taste-test the convenience store's signature meals!
Wouldn't dream of forgetting.
I'll see you there.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Heh! That's a deal!
My schedule is clear right now.
I learned from the best.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Really? If you get caught, better keep my name out of it!

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: After all, we're in the same class now—Ta-da! Check out my official acceptance letter!

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Hey, you! And just so you know, I'm not skipping class this time.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: I really hope peaceful days like this could just… last forever, you know?

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: No matter when you look down from here… Startorch is just so beautiful...

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: You got class soon?
Nope.
Yes, actually.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Great! Stick around for a while? Gotta catch you up on all the latest campus drama, heh…

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: We can think about what to get for dinner while we're at it... Or, we can just wing it as usual!

anh_en: Aww, bummer…

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: We meet again, Unwritten... Hmm, yes. Unwritten.
You seem to enjoy this place.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Enjoy it? Perhaps a little.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Before I faded away completely, I fired Moon Arrows across the wilds, anchoring the Dark Tide's creations wherever I could. Each time, I felt more of myself slip away.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: People's impressions of me blurred, too. They started forgetting where they'd seen me last. Over time, rumors spread that I never left Tetragon Temple.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: But I've always hated rules. All that order, that dull obedience... suffocating. So whenever it became too much, I'd come here. To watch the moon.
So what makes this place different?

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: There's more than one moon here. There's one above… and the one in the water. Tell me, which one do you think is harder to reach?

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: I know it's impossible. But still... I try. Again and again.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Can't help it. I am a genius, after all. Refusing to lose just comes with the territory… so does winning.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: As for this moment... Stay and watch the moon with me. I'll share a little of its light. Consider it my gift to you.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: So? Did you come all this way just to gaze at the moon, or to steal a glimpse at Septimont's most brilliant Priestess... me?
Another one...? I thought that was what the bracelet was for.
If you're the one requesting, how could I say no?

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: I told you, I'm quite generous. Especially with you. One gift? Hah. That would hardly be enough.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: ...Eh? What are you talking about? I absolutely wasn't requesting anything! You... do you even understand what... Ugh, never mind!

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Anyway... the moon is especially beautiful tonight, don't you think?
You always seem to follow the moonlight.
I had a feeling I'd find you here.
Unwritten... It's been a while since anyone called me that.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Who's to say it isn't the moonlight that follows me?

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Where one thing ends, another begins... Clever of you to find me here.

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Do you not like it? Aw, how tragic! Unwritten, Unwritten. Oh, Unwritten...

speaker: NPC #250024
anh_en: Well, I'm the only one who calls you that, so.. too bad for you! You'll just have to grin and bear it, won't you?
Yes.
Sure thing.
I haven't had the time.
